motif_gloss: Another sun, usually less benevolent and/or powerful, existed before the present one
The world was (almost) burned when several suns had (will) appear(ed) simultaneously. (Texts with "Moon was equal to Sun" without "the burned earth" motif not mentioned)
Other suns or moons besides present ones had been in the sky and were later annihilated
Two or more suns shine in the sky. When the extra suns had been annihilated, there was a risk of the last one being destroyed too

motif_title: Extra suns are children of the present one
motif_gloss: Extra suns who almost burned or could burn the world are children of the present one
Different suns illuminate different worlds or will appear successively in the future
The Moon is female or bisexual, the Sun is male
The Sun is female, the Moon is male or (much more rare) also female
Modest Sun-woman dazzles (usually pricks with needles, i.e. the sun rays) eyes of those who look at her

motif_title: The Sun is afraid of the night
motif_gloss: Being afraid of the night, the Sun decided to travel across the sky only at the day time

motif_title: The Sun and the Moon are males
motif_gloss: The Moon is male, the Sun is also male or (much more rare) asexual

motif_title: The Sun created from the Moon’s swaddling clothes
motif_gloss: The younger brother (usually the Sun) is created from urine and swaddling clothes of the elder brother (usually the Moon).

motif_title: The Sun and the Moon are females
motif_gloss: Both the Sun and the Moon are considered to be females (incl. cases when the gender is not directly specified but both emerge from parts of the body of a female person)

The Sun and the Moon are persons of different sex. The man pursues the woman or vice versa. Details of pursuit usually explain why the luminaries are not equally bright and/or why there are stains on the lunar disc

motif_title: The Sun, the Moon and the Star are three siblings
motif_gloss: The Sun, the Moon and the star (stars) are three sisters or three brothers
Female moon does not permit her husband or son to destroy people
The sun gets his bright eye or eyes from an animal

motif_title: Eyes of the Sun and the Moon: coolness and night
motif_gloss: Visible sun and/or moon are the Sun's and/or the Moon's eyes. If these eyes were not injured, light and heat would be more intense
The Sun or the Moon have only one eye (the Mundurucu: they are blind)

motif_title: The Sun, the Moon and monster’s eyes
motif_gloss: The Sun and the Moon kill a monster whose eyes are unequally bright. The Moon takes the brighter eye but gives it back to the Sun
Some creature or creatures regularly (sunrise and sunset, summer and winter, lunar phases) or irregularly (solar and lunar eclipses, eschatological events) attack the luminaries or shade their light
During an eclipse or at the sunset the Sun or the Moon are attacked by a predator animal (a bear, a feline, a canine, a racoon)
During an eclipse or at the sunset the Sun or the Moon are attacked by a frog or toad
During an eclipse or at the sunset the Sun or the Moon are attacked by a reptile (a snake, a lizard, a dragon, a crocodile) or a fish
A bird or birds attack or shade the Sun or the Moon during an eclipse or at the sunrise and sunset
A spider produces the lunar eclipses
A creditor comes from time to time to the Sun or the Moon to claim back his money producing eclipses
Raven steals (hides) the Sun or tries to do it
Raven obtains the hidden or stolen Sun
During an eclipse or during the first night ants shade or shaded the Sun

motif_title: Eclipses: relations between the Sun and the Moon
motif_gloss: Coming together of the Sun and the Moon is the reason of their eclipses
An eclipse happens when the Sun or the Moon turns to a wrong path or when their paths cross
Every night the Sun and/or the Moon passes by creatures or objects which try to destroy them

motif_title: The Sun’s relax at the midday
motif_gloss: After passing half of the its way across the sky (in the day time) or in the underworld (in the night time), the Sun stops to have a rest
The Sun and/or the Moon regularly travel across the sky or the underworld in a boat. (Voyages by boat of the mythical persons who eventually become the Sun or the Moon not included)

motif_title: By horse in the morning, by ox in the evening
motif_gloss: During its everyday travel across the sky, the Sun changes its draught animals (usually in the morning the Sun rides a slow animal and in the evening a quick one)

motif_title: By snail in summer, by bird in winter
motif_gloss: For its sky voyage, the Sun chooses draught animals according to the season, riding a slow animal in the summer time and a quick one in the winter time

motif_title: Childhood of the Sun and Moon
motif_gloss: The Sun and Moon are two siblings who live on earth and then ascend to the sky. Their (birth and) childhood are described

motif_title: Luminaries thrown up into the sky
motif_gloss: The sun and/or the moon are inanimate objects thrown up or put into the sky

motif_title: To the sky from a bonfire
motif_gloss: After getting into the fire or boiling water, one or two persons ascend to the sky and turn into the Sun and/or Moon

motif_title: The hot Sun and its cold companion
motif_gloss: After two persons burn up, one turns into the present Sun and another into a less important sky object
Person who becomes the Sun burned up in a hot fire while his companion burned up in the less hot fire or threw himself into the ashes. He (she) turns into the Moon or a star which gives no warmth
To make the Sun rise above the horizon, to send him to the right distance from the earth, to make him move across the sky, etc. a person has to be sacrificed

motif_title: The burned up persons turn into constellation
motif_gloss: The burned up persons turn into a constellation or into the dark spot on the Milky Way

motif_title: Elections of the Sun to be
motif_gloss: The primeval ancestors come together to choose the best candidate to become the Sun and/or to send the Sun to the sky or to see how the Sun rises to the sky for the first time

motif_title: Who will see the Sun first?
motif_gloss: Two persons or animals argue about who of them will be the first to see the rising sun. One who seemed to have less chances wins

motif_title: First beams on the tree tops
motif_gloss: Two persons or animals argue who would see the rising sun first. One who looks not to the east but to the opposite direction gets to see the first beams on trees or mountain tops and wins
Birds argue who of them will fly higher. One who seemed to have less chances wins (he hides himself in feathers of a strong bird using it as a vehicle)
In the beginning it is dark. When the Sun first appears on the sky, primeval beings or part of them perish or turn into animals or spirits

motif_title: The first day or night: transformed into spirits
motif_gloss: At the moment when the first day or the first night come, (some) people turn into supernatural beings
When people see light of day for the first time, they are prohibited to look at it immediately. Those who break this taboo are ruined
A bird incorporates the Sun or the day light. It can be caught, let free, killed

motif_title: Crowns of the Sun and Moon
motif_gloss: Light and/or heat of the Sun and/or Moon originate from their crowns, necklaces or clothes (of feathers, of animal teeth)

motif_title: The Sun and a demon compete for the hero
motif_gloss: Two persons one of whom is connected with the upper and another with the lower or middle world, both are eager to possess another person and pull him or her to his or her side. One or both rivals are female. Person connected with the upper world and/or the object of the competition are luminaries – the Sun, the Moon, or Venus

motif_title: Torn in half by two wives
motif_gloss: The sky wife and the wife from the earth each pull the man to her side tearing him in half
Person, connected with the upper world and another person connected with the lower world or the earth both are eager to possess a hero or heroin who is associated with the Moon
Moon descends to earth to eat children, corpses or bones of the dead
As a result of some intimate contacts and/or love affair, the Moon acquires its present appearance (often, the stains on his face) and/or ascends to the sky
When a woman gets know that her husband or lover did something against accepted rules of behavior, she cuts off her breast and shows it to him
A figure or an imprint of some being or object are seen in the Moon. (For statistical analysis motifs A32A – A32J are also included into A32)
Rabbit or hare are seen in the moon
Frog or toad are seen in the moon or the Moon is associated with them

motif_title: A man and a dog in the Moon
motif_gloss: A human being and a dog together are seen in the moon
Human being or imprint of human being is seen in the moon
Person who carries a bundle of brushwood or firewood is seen in the moon.

motif_title: Person with an object in hands
motif_gloss: Person who holds some object in his or her hands is seen in the moon
Person who went to fetch water and/or holds in hands a container for liquid is seen in the moon
Person who had been carried up to the moon took hold of a bush or a small tree and is seen now on the lunar disc together with this bush
A tree or bush is seen in the moon
A shepherd or herdsman (alone or with a girl, with his herd, dogs) is seen in the moon
A shaman with his drum ascends to the moon and remains there, his figure is seen in the moon

motif_title: First to the Sun, then to the Moob
motif_gloss: Person seen in the Moon initially had to get to the Sun or the Sun and the Moon argue who of them should get the person
The Sun has appearance of one a hoofed animal (bull, ram, pig, etc.)
Jackal, coyote, or fox are connected with the Moon (usually with the origin of spots on the lunar disc)
Dark spots on the lunar disc are dirt, blood, paint, traces of beating, burning, scratching, etc. on the Moon person's body or face (Kiliwa: spots on the Sun) and do not form any particular figure
Spots on the lunar disc are dirt thrown into the Moon's face by his/her sister/brother or mother

motif_title: To smear the Moon with pitch
motif_gloss: To make the Moon less bright, some person tried to smear it with pitch
Moon, unlike people, revives or rejuvenates every month; or those who live in the Moon are immortal; or the Moon makes decision if people should die forever or regularly revive
Person attacks the Sun (or several suns if they were many) with weapon
Small animal (marmot, rabbit, mole, toad, frog) or person who turns into this animal tried to hit the Sun with arrows and since then has been hiding from the Sun in underground holes or in the water
Small animal (marmot, rabbit, mole, toad, frog) or person who turns into this animal tried to hit the Sun with his arrows but remains without thumb as a result
Person prepares a snare, loop, noose, etc. to catch the Sun and/or the Sun is caught in a snare, tied by a rope, etc.
The Sun is caught into snare made of the pubic hair of hero's female relative
After the Sun is caught into snare only mouse, shrew or other small animal is able to cut it open
A boy or a girl has a cloak. The Sun spoils it or gives instead a better one
Because the Sun does damage to a person or animal (spoils, burns his cloak, skin, etc.), the person or animal kills him or catches him in a snare
Every one of the months of a year is a separate object or creature

motif_title: The Sun or Moon marry toad
motif_gloss: Frog or Toad is a wife of the Sun or Moon

Two persons have children (younger siblings, mothers). One of them proposes to another that they should kill (eat, bake, etc.) their children (mothers, etc.) but hides his or her own. The opponent actually kills his or her own kin. One of the persons or/and the only survived child is the Sun

motif_title: Phaethon: false Sun fails to fulfill his duty
motif_gloss: Person comes to the sun, attempts to fulfill the sun's duty but intentionally or because of a lack of skill does it wrong and the earth suffers from heat etc.

The Moon-person runs out of the lodge and flies up. He forgets to put his footwear on one foot, or somebody attempts to seize him grasping his foot or cuts the foot off. Now the Moon-person lacks one foot or footwear on one of his (or her) feet

motif_title: Person with a shoe on one foot
motif_gloss: While being transformed into a bird or ascending to the sky a person was in a hurry and put a footwear only on one foot, or somebody attempted to seize him grasping his foot. Now the corresponding bird or a sky-person is believed to have different feet
A woman tyrannized by her husband or an orphan girl or boy asks the Moon to take her or him to the sky. The request is granted and the person is seen now on the lunar disc
Person who teases or insults the Moon is punished

motif_title: The Sun and Moon from eyes of a being
motif_gloss: The Sun and Moon (Rig-Veda: the Sun only) appear from eyes of a person or creature
In the beginning of times two companions or brothers compete in producing things. Usually one of them is or becomes master of the underworld

motif_title: Three worlds: the universe divided between gods
motif_gloss: Anthropomorphic persons agree to divide between them levels of universe (upper world, earth, lower world)
In the beginning of times two supernatural females compete in producing things. One has positive, another negative characteristics

Two creators agree that whose object will be found in a certain condition (usually: whose tree or flower will grow or blossom first) should be recognized as a senior one. While one of the creators sleeps or is absent, another replaces the objects and so achieves the priority by deceit
Two persons are creating the world, one is a good and and another a bad worker, that’s because separate parts of the world look differently
The earth is a female being or associated with a woman
The earth devours bodies of the people when they die and are buried

motif_title: The earth as a child’s body
motif_gloss: The earth as a whole or fertile soil is the body of a child, has been born by a woman

motif_title: Marriage of the sky and the earth
motif_gloss: The male Sky (the Sun, the Thunder, the creator of the sky) marries the female Earth (or its female creator) or the female Sky marries the male Earth
The earth or the world as a whole is a male person
Initially the earth is absent or liquid. Zoomorphic person buries his relatives in his own body or flies carrying the coffin
Initially the earth is a swamp, water and dry land are not separated from each other
Water is the original element, the dry earth appears later
Original earth was small and later increased in size or the fertile soil grew from a small amount of original substance

When dry land is created, Creator takes a rest and sleeps. His antagonist decides to drown him and drags him to the edge of the earth. The dry land grows in size as long as the antagonist drags the Creator's body, the edge never reached
A worm obtains the earth (from the underworld), it emerges from the worm's excrements, is extracted from inside of the worm

In the beginning there are only air and water. 1) Person descends from the sky, creates the dry land or a hard support created for her or him grows into the earth. 2) The earth is sent or dropped from the sky, put on the surface of the water. 3) The earth is brought from somewhere (not from the underworld) and put on the water
Islands or continent are fished out of the ocean or pulled to their present place by rope
In the beginning of time, a male and a female persons meet each other and become engaged into the dialogue
Woman (alone or with her companion) gives birth to or creates not only people but also different creatures and objects

motif_title: First man and woman meets each other
motif_gloss: The first or the only survived man and woman walk or run to each other around a post, a hill, etc. When they come together they marry each other
Somebody is the only possessor of water or certain beverage. Another person drinks it, escapes and spits out making it available for the people
Sea, river, waters of flood flow out of a small container
Person or creature possesses all the fresh water. Another person splashes it out of a container or pond making it available for everybody
Water flows from a broken bone (of a bird) producing a flood
Frog hides all the water but other person makes it available for everybody
There is enormous amount of water inside a trunk of a tree or a tree turns into water
Person drinks a lake or all the water in the world or all the water is originally inside person's belly. When a hole is made in it, the water pours out
Mammoth described as an underground creature moves across the earth while it is still wet creating the present landscape
A stream of water (with a monster in it) pursues person who tries to escape from it
Rivers, fountains, ocean, waters of flood, rain, etc. emerge from somebody's tears
A river flows from the body of a female person
Initially there is no sea, it is produced from some person's urine
Wolverine or fox bathes in the sea making the water salty
Magic mill is ordered to grind salt but not ordered to stop. It sinks into ocean and continues to work making the water salty
Darkness is a particular object that can be carried (usually brought from its original owner in a container)
Day light (also warmth, the sun, the moon) is kept as a particular object in a container, under a cover, etc.

motif_title: The night and the married life
motif_gloss: People had trouble making love before night came into being

People regularly ascend to the sky for hunting, fishing or gathering; do not give honey, fish or proper meat to the old person remained below; she or he makes their return impossible, they remain in the sky
People ascend the tree to hunt, fish, or gather food in the sky. The tree is destroyed, people fall to earth or remain in the upper world
People who have climbed up a tree do not share food with a person who remained below. He or she revenges on them destroying the tree. The events have cosmic dimensions
Boys climb a tree to eat fruits. Tapir asks them to give some fruits to him, they refuse to do so. Tapir tries to kill the boys
God prohibits making fire for cooking and punishes breakers of this taboo

motif_title: Transformation of kinsmen into wild pigs
motif_gloss: Person transforms into wild pigs his kinsmen or children
Person makes a circle of bird feathers around a group of people or throws feathers into their dwelling, people turn into wild pigs
Persons climb a tree or liana and fall turning into wild pigs and other game animals
Person who follows the wild animals turns into one of them or into their master
Persons ponders over what object, feature, or creature it would be appropriate for him or her to turn into. When the choice is made, the persons transforms himself or herself
The transformer walks along coming across different persons, transforming them into birds, animals, stones, shrines, etc. and introducing cultural norms
Person who have been transforming people into animals or stones is pierced to the ground with a pole
Hero comes to a country where inhabitants are afraid of objects or plants who attack them. He easily overcomes these objects and transforms them in what they are now

motif_title: Lice grasp a man and pull him into the sea
motif_gloss: Lice grasp a man and pull him into the sea

motif_title: Man transformed into deer, his knives into antlers
motif_gloss: Unrecognized Transformer meets a man who tells him that he prepares knives (a spear) to kill Transformer. The latter transforms him into deer, his knives or spear into deer antlers
People turn into animals, birds or stones at a feast, after the feast, after performing a ritual or after a victory over dangerous enemy
Fish emerges from remains of a killed person or creature

motif_title: Murdered person turns into game animals
motif_gloss: Different game animals emerge from remains of a murdered person
After a conflict with a man or remaining alone, a woman turns into water mammal
After a conflict with their husbands women turn into fish
Female person is incarnation of wind, mother of winds, etc.

motif_title: One dies of cold in the spring
motif_gloss: Believing that a winter is over, an old woman (rare: a young girl, a man) goes outdoors (usually to graze her animals) without a proper clothing. It becomes cold again and she dies of cold
Person teases, offends March or other month and is punished
In the late winter or early spring a bird (usually a thrush) flies out before time and dies of cold or her nestlings die of cold
When the winter ends and the spring begins certain mother (usually March) borrows several days from a neighbor month to preserve its strength and produce a short period of a very cold weather
Old woman is incarnation of winter or there are several cold days between winter and spring (or fall) associated with a certain old woman
When night escapes from container where it was originally preserved, men surprised by the darkness turn into birds or animals
Being in a hurry, the bear puts his left shoe on his right foot and vice versa. Now is lumbering

motif_title: Tree fulfills wishes and then transforms into bear
motif_gloss: Tree grants a man the fulfillment of his wishes but ultimately transforms him into a bear

motif_title: Color, voice, form: one divided between many
motif_gloss: Because the integrity of some creature or (rare) object is ruined, different beings get their present colors, voices and other anatomical traits
Birds or fish obtain their colors after smearing themselves with liquids extracted from the body of some being or dividing among themselves its bright skin or dress
Birds obtain their voices after pecking big reptile and smearing themselves with liquids from its body
Animals get meat and fat extracted from some original creature or created otherwise. Some get a lot, some remain lean

Person paints two or more different birds (rare: fish) or they paint each other, smear themselves with paint, decorate their bodies with pieces of bright skin or fabric. Since then feathers, beaks and feet of the birds (skin and scales of fish) are of different colors
Person paints birds or animals or they paint each other. It is made not according to the original plan
Two birds paint each other, one becomes worse than it was before

motif_title: Raven and loon paint each other
motif_gloss: Raven and loon paint each other
Person kicks loon or other water bird. Since then this bird has flat tail base and it walks on dry land with difficulty

motif_title: Raven and owl paint each other
motif_gloss: Raven and owl paint each other
A bird with white or bright feathers marries a bird with black feathers but flies away after getting know that his or her marriage partner eats carrion or excrements

Insect-person knows the source of food (cultivated plants) and water but does not share his knowledge. To make him speak, ancestors tie a rope around his waist and pull it till the waist becomes narrow (origin of narrow place between breast and belly of insects)
Hare or rabbit is a false deer or it was deer in the past or a close kin of the deer or had horns or antlers or missed opportunity to get them, its ears are the false horns
Animal who has no horns now had them before or missed opportunity to get them
The horse exchanges some parts of his body with the cow, usually gives her horns and/or obtains teeth
Dogs could speak. To prevent them to spread information, the dog is deprived of this ability or the dog rejects it itself
The dog or other domestic animal speaks aloud about those details of its masters' life that they would prefer to conceal. He is punished by depriving his ability to speak
Certain stars or constellations are interpreted as hunters, their dogs and game which the hunters pursue

motif_title: Blood or fat drops to earth
motif_gloss: Hunters pursue a bear across the sky, kill it in August – October. Its blood or fat drops to earth as a dew or painting leaves of the trees in red
In the cosmic hunt tale the game pursued by the hunters is an ungulate (elk, deer, mountain sheep, etc.)
In the cosmic hunt tale the game pursued by the hunters is a bear
In the cosmic hunt tale the game pursued by the hunters is a tapir
In the cosmic hunt tale the game pursued by the hunters is a rhea bird (Rhea americana)
Ursus major (seven stars or only four stars of a dipper) is identified with an ungulate (elk, deer, mountain sheep, etc.)

motif_title: The object of cosmic hunt is the Belt of Orion
motif_gloss: The object of hunt in the cosmic hunt tale is identified with the Belt of Orion

motif_title: The object of cosmic hunt is the Lady in the Chair
motif_gloss: The object of hunt in the cosmic hunt tale is identified with the Lady in the Chair
In the cosmic hunt tale either hunters or game is identified with the Pleiades

motif_title: Animal is the dipper, hunters are the handle
motif_gloss: Stars of the handle of the Big Dipper are identified with the hunters, the dipper itself with the game (bear or elk)
Hunter identified with Mizar (the second star of the handle of the Big Dipper) carries a cooking pot identified with Alcor (weak star near Mizar)
Every one of three (rare: four) hunters who pursuing an elk get to the sky and become stars is identified with a person of particular nationality

motif_title: The boaster and the hurried one
motif_gloss: In the cosmic hunt tales according to which stars of the handle of the Big Dipper are three hunters, each of the hunters demonstrates particular psychological characteristics (one is a boaster, another is a hurried one, etc.). Usually these hunters are identified with peoples of different ethnic groups or with different species of birds
Constellation of Orion or the Belt of Orion is identified with only one male person, usually with a warrior or hunter
Certain constellation is a male person whose back is broken or wounded
Ursa major is identified with a fisher (mustela pennati)
Ursa major is identified with a bear
Ursa major is identified with a carriage, a cart

motif_title: The Belt of Orion: one runs after another
motif_gloss: Three stars of the Belt of Orion are three persons or animals who pursue each other
Ursa major or Polaris are identified with a middle size animal (ermine, fisher, woodchuck) or person (identified with an animal?) hit with a dart or arrow

motif_title: Ursa major is a big mammal
motif_gloss: Seven main stars of Ursa major are interpreted as a figure of a mammal: bear, deer, mountain sheep, camel, dog
Parts of the body of the primeval person or creature are transformed into different elements of the landscape and parts of the universe

motif_title: Council on seasons: units of time
motif_gloss: The number of discrete units of time in a certain calendar period of time is discussed

motif_title: Council on seasons: toes, claws, hairs, feathers
motif_gloss: Toes, claws, feathers, hairs, color stripes, etc. are counted and compared to establish the number of period of time or particular way of alternation of periods
It is discussed if darkness or light, cold or warm periods should exist

motif_title: Black-an-white animal is night and day
motif_gloss: There are both night and day because spotted (or otherwise black and white) animal has been killed
Participants of the discussion concerning number of the units of time, etc. are animals (rare: animals and elements, in particular Wind)
In a dispute about should it be dark or light, Fox stands for light
A coming of warm (light, abundant, etc.) or cold (dark, barren, etc.) time is related to the marriage of certain person
Bull or cow are related to winter and cold, responsible for existence of the cold season
Every star of the Ursa mayor is a separate person. Usually the constellation represents seven men, rare it is seven women or seven persons and animals
The seventh star of the Pleiades was abducted by stars of Big Dipper and now is seen among them

In former times or regularly the Pleiades or other group of stars produced or produce till now severe cold. (The heliacal set of the Pleiades is in May-June while in the Northern Hemisphere they are seen best of all in the winter time)
Cow steps on the stars of the Pleiades which were dangerous being and lived on earth. Some of these stars slipped through its split hoof
Weak or herbivorous animals were dangerous predators but have been transformed
Particular pieces of flesh or inner organs in the bodies of animals, birds, or fish originally belonged to other creatures
Some game animals have a piece of human flesh in their body that remained since the time when these animals were anthropomorphic

Animals of particular species do not hear well the instructions concerning their way of life or the ask God for some benefit but muddle their request. Thanks to this they acquire their present habits. (In the Toraja tale the motif is used to explain the mortal nature of human beings)

motif_title: How many cubs in a year
motif_gloss: Mighty animals lost opportunity to have many children and now give birth only once in several years

An insect feeds on human blood (flesh). Dangerous person asks it where it got to suck blood or whose blood (flesh) is the most delicious. The insect lies or cannot answer (its tongue is cut off). Thanks to this dangerous person attacks certain plants or animals and not people
Bloodsucking insect does not tell thunder that it has sucked human blood

Swallow does not let snake to destroy people. Usually the snake sends mosquito or other bloodsucking insect to get know whose blood is the most delicious. The insect flies back to report that human blood is the sweetest. Swallow bites its tongue off and the snake gets to pull off feathers from the swallow's tail
Flying above the earth and flapping its wings, a bird (usually a vulture) makes it dry after the flood or otherwise creates present landscape
Person spits out earth that he swallowed or concealed otherwise. This way the broken landscape is created
When the earth and the sky were created, they p[roved to be of unequal size. The earth was squeezed, this way mountains appeared

motif_title: Creatures or objects from cut off genitals
motif_gloss: Supernaturally big genitals are cut off and turn into snakes or other creatures and objects
Chips of wood, branches or pieces of bark thrown or fallen into the water turn into fish and/or aquatic animals
Fish grows on branches of a tree or leaves of a tree turn into fish

After the crocodile or caiman swallows or loses fire (that he possessed before), he remains without his tongue; or the crocodile's tongue is cut off to make something related to celestial fire (thunderbolt, sun beams, etc.
When some person or animal is killed, blood paints the sky or vegetation (origin of the sunrise or sunset, of reddish colors of Aurora borealis or of the red color of the autumn leaves)
When person gets to see that the sky becomes red he or she understands that another person's blood is shed or that another person spilled a red liquid

After the original fire is stolen by the ancestors, a partridge size forest bird (Penelope sp.; Anhima cornuta; etc.; jacu, paujil) swallows burning coal and (besides the Andoque) its neck becomes red

motif_title: A groups of dancers ascend to the sky
motif_gloss: A group of people (usually children, brothers or sisters) play, dance, ascend to the sky and turn into Pleiades or other compact constellation

Children conflict with their parents who do not pay them enough attention, condemn their sexual behavior, do not give them enough food, clothes, etc.; the children abandon their parents and become birds, bats, atmospheric phenomena, or stars (usually the Pleiades)
Mole had to support the sky or the Sun that had fallen down. Usually its paw (hand) remained crooked after this
Man thinks that buzzard or hawk has better life than he. They exchange clothes. The bird lives with the man's wife as her husband, the man usually does not enjoy his bird life

Young people, usually siblings, tell other person, usually their mother, that they have been doing agricultural work though it is not the case. When the deceit is discovered, they turn into atmospheric phenomena

Bones of fresh-water fish are result of a fighting or military expedition. The bones are arrows that have pierced the fish bodies (gill openings are pierced by arrows) or the small bones are fragments of originally big ones

motif_title: Small bones: war between fish and birds
motif_gloss: Fish and birds shoot arrows into each other. Since then there are many small bones inside the fish

motif_title: Small bones: war between different fish
motif_gloss: Fish of two species shoot arrows into each other. Since then there are many small bones in the fish or some bones are forked

motif_title: Small bones: fish fall from the sky
motif_gloss: Fish in company of other earth dwellers ascend to fight with the sky dwellers. They fall to earth and break their bones. Since then there are many small bones in the fish
Small bones in the legs of birds of particular species or spots on their feathers are arrows shot into them from below
Person plays imitating other animal person. His belly is cut open as a result and intestines turn into vines
Persons climb to the sky up a rope or an arrow ladder; fallen down rope turns into forest vines
People fell giant tree. The fallen tree and/or its stump turns into mountain(s) or rocks
Hazel-grouse was big and dangerous. He is torn to pieces which are shared between other birds and animals. What remains is the present grouse

motif_title: Chipmunk's back scratched: hence his stripes
motif_gloss: (Animal)-person wants to thank or to punish small animal (chipmunk, ground squirrel, etc.) and scratches or paints it producing stripes on its back
Chipmunk or an animal of similar size (weasel, pika) is engaged into argument with another animal person (bear, elk, puma, snake) if it should be warm and light or cold and dark
Person beats hares, foxes or other medium size animals who became helpless (usually closed in his house). Tale explains why tips of the animals' ears or tails have a particular color
Aurora borealis is spirits (of the dead) who run holding burning torches, play or fight with each other
Children do not give water to their mother or mother to her child. The offended person turns into a bird, usually a cuckoo

(Step)parent does not share his or her food with a child. The child (usually a small girl) asks the migratory birds (swans, geese, etc.) to take her or him with them. The birds give the child feathers (wings, etc.) and the girl (boy) flies away with the birds
Children do not give water to their thirsty mother or mother (step mother, stepfather) does not give water to thirsty child. The offended one turns into a bird and flies away
Person turns into the cuckoo so quickly that one of his or her legs remains bare or one of her braids not plaited. Now it is believed that the cuckoo has different legs or wings

motif_title: The cuchoo: in search of lost horse
motif_gloss: A girl (with her brother; two small brothers) is (are) in search of the horse or cattle or the girl is in search of her lost brother. She (alone or with her brother; both brothers) turns into a bird (usually a cuckoo; or both siblings turn into birds) that cries in specific way

motif_title: The cuckoo: in search of lost sibling
motif_gloss: Girl searches for her lost brother, calls him or brother calls his sister, or they call each other, or two lost brothers call each other. One or both siblings turn into birds with specific cry
Eyes of wood-grouse became red because it shed tears

motif_title: The marriage of the owl and the Moon
motif_gloss: Owl had to separate with the Moon and since then cries when the Moon shines. Usually the (proposed) marriage of the owl and the Moon broke up

motif_title: Sounds of the time of creation: a woman's voice (echo)
motif_gloss: A certain woman lived in primeval time but her voice is still heard (usually she turns into echo)

motif_title: Sounds of the time of creation: a creaking of trees
motif_gloss: Man pushes his mother-in-law or his wife into a tree hollow, she turns into the creaking of trees or into echo

motif_title: Sounds of the time of creation: a murmur of forest and waves
motif_gloss: The murmur of leaves or waves of the time of creation is still heard
Waves of the sea petrified and turned into dry land with mountain chains
Originally the sky was close to the earth, then it has risen up
One or several (animal)-persons push sky up to its present height

motif_title: Sky touched with a long object
motif_gloss: The sky rose to its present height and/or the direct relations of the sky deity with the people were broken off when the sky or the deity was touched or struck with a long object (a pestle, a broom, etc.)

The sky rose to its present height and/or the direct relations of the sky deity with the people were broken off when the sky or the deity was pushed up, touched or struck with a pestle or with a ladle during the preparation of food
The sky rose to its present height and/or the direct relations of the sky deity with the people were broken off when the sky or the deity was pushed up, touched or struck with a broom
Serpent-like creature pushes the sky far away from the earth
When person or creature shakes himself or itself, shakes his or her bed, clothes, plucks birds, etc., snow falls down to earth
From the primeval egg, eggs, or egg-like ball emerge the earth, the sky, sky bodies, different animals (all or part of the items of this list)
In the beginning of time a bird flies, lays an egg or eggs, different objects and creatures emerge from them or a bird drops some solid substance on the waters and the dry land or an island appear
The process of world creation includes the measuring of its size
Creator and his opponent ponder upon should the dog be able to use a bow or fire-arms
Raven or other carrion-eating bird of dark color and a similar size was originally white
Person tries to pick up a small object or creature but it proves to be of enormous size and weight
A female demonic person, usually while she is pursuing a man, dies and her flesh turns into objects that are found on trees, like fungi, pitch, fruits or nuts
Wind is too strong and is pacified
Wind blows in a wrong way, people can get no game or fish. When a hero overcomes it, it initially becomes too calm but the hero creates the desirable balance
Wind was or is in a particular enclosure (bag, cave, etc.). It was released from it or comes out from time to time
To reach the sky, people build a ladder or tower that consists of separate modules (bricks, logs, sticks, etc.). This construction collapses
Alcor (a weak star near the second star of the handle of the Big Dipper) is selected as a particular sky object
Alcor is interpreted as a dog
The handle of the Big Dipper is not straight because a wolf or a bear (identified with Alcor or with the last star of the handle, η) attacked an ox that was dragging a cart
All person's children die. He or she addresses God and asks him why he or she suffers so much

motif_title: Owl as a king of birds
motif_gloss: Owl was or wanted to be king of birds or it behaved itself in a wrong way during the elections of the king. Now it avoids other birds and/or other birds chase it
There is an anthropomorphic patron or patroness of wolves. Usually he or she gives instructions to wolves on particular day of the year
Snail had (the) sharp(est) eyes. Another animal person borrows them and never returns
Person who embodies flint or other hard stone is broken, stones disperse in the world

motif_title: Sky bridge in the mid of summer
motif_gloss: Once a year in the middle of summer sky dwellers or messegers of the deity who are at the opposite sides of the Milky Way come together. Usually birds make a chain of their bodies to serve as a bridge across the celestial river and feathers on the birds' heads become worn down
Trees and (domestic) animals could talk and asked people not to cut or kill them
When a man has felled a tree or is going to cut it, the tree or a bird who lived in the trunk grants the man’s wishes
Human posterior looks in particular way because certain person burned it
Pursuing heroes, a monster falls into water, turns into a big fish or a water mammal
Thankful person decorates a bird who lives near water (kingfisher, loon, goose), thence its appearance (crest, beak, feathers)
Bat becomes outcast among other creatures usually after it makes attempts to join first animals and then birds or vice versa
Bat is in conflict with other creatures because of the incident related to somebody's death or funerals
Person abandoned in a tree turns into a nest of insects
Formerly or in a particular country the sleep was not known;
Angry against the birch, person beats or cuts it, whence scratches and slashes on its bark
Clouds are formed from smoke that ascends from the earth

Person (a devil or a bear) thinks that because the Cornus mas tree (European cornel, male cornel) blossoms before all other fruit trees do, it also brings its fruits early. The cornel fruits become ripe very late, so the person is disappointed and gets no fruits
When a guest comes, a host hides from him a cooked chicken. When the host is going to eat it himself, he finds the chicken transformed into the tortoise (origin of tortoises) or a toad
Father-in-law gets to see his daughter-in-law when she combs or washes her hair. She is ashamed and turns into the hoopoe (origin of hoopoe)
When the sky cock cries, all the cocks on earth cry after him, not before
During a (world) fire oyster was burned, nor now oyster shells are black
Anthropomorphic person broken into small particles turns into the snow that shines under the sun
Person turns into bear (origin of bears)

The present earth or the underworld is the former sky that has fallen down, or the earth turned in the past upside down, or the layers of the universe collapsed in the past one after another, or they will change their place during the future cataclysm
World is destroyed once with fire or draught, another time with a flood or it is destroyed with a flood of fire or boiling water
Two persons meet a woodpecker and as a consequence, the earth burns. The strong and smart person survives, the weak and stupid is burned
The Sun and Moon get into conflagration. The Sun survives, the Moon is burned
During the flood a hole is opened in the arch. An animal stops it up with its own body

motif_title: The flood: fruits fall from a tree
motif_gloss: During the flood or in the beginning of times fruits, seeds or other objects are dropped into water one by one, usually by a person who has climbed a tree. As far as the objects fall, water recedes and the dry land appears
Birds or humans who are later changed to birds are send to explore the earth (is it dry, are any survivals, to bring some dry soil, to investigate why smoke rises to the sky, etc.)
During the creation of the world or after the world cataclysm animals run around making the earth big, reporting about its condition or they are sent to report the size of the growing earth
Persons or animals dive to get something from the bottom of the water body

motif_title: The diver is turtle or frog
motif_gloss: A turtle, a frog, a toad, or an armadillo brings the desired object from the bottom of the water body or from the lower world

motif_title: The diver is muskrat or beaver
motif_gloss: A muskrat, a beaver or a nutria brings the desired object from under the water
An aquatic bird brings the desired object from under the water
Two or more different birds (often a loon and a duck) dive one after another to get earth from under the ocean. Only one of them is successful
Persons or creatures get from the bottom of the ocean or from the lower world small amount of solid substance which turns into the earth
A crustacean brings the earth from the bottom of the ocean or from the lower world
Persons or animals dive to get from under the water a drowned person or creature or part of its body

motif_title: The diver is a wild boar
motif_gloss: A wild boar brings the earth from under the water and/or spills it over the water
An insect brings the earth (from under the water, from a lower world or from a far-away place)

motif_title: Dirt stuck to body turns into the earth
motif_gloss: Bird or animal returns from the lower world smeared with dirt. It shakes itself or the dirt is scraped off. The dirt turns into the earth
In the beginning of times or after the flood a dam of earth, person or creature does not let water to recede. The dam is broken or opened, waters withdraw
In the beginning of time or after the world catastrophe brother and sister or mother and son are the only humans. They marry each other, present people descend from them

Being alone and having no other marriage partners, brother and sister agree to marry each other if a highly improbable event or a series of events will take place. Among the events that take place (alternatively or one after the other) are 1) the siblings let two grinding stones roll from two mountains, the brother's stone falls on the sister's one; 2) brother and sister throw two swords from two mountains, both swords get into one sheath; 3) they throw some objects up, the objects get together; 4) they kindle two fires, columns of smoke get together; 5) they put to grow two stems of bamboo, tops of the stems get together

motif_title: Siblings change their looks and marry
motif_gloss: In the beginning of time or after the world catastrophe brother and sister or mother and son are the only humans. They reject marriage or only the man does not want to marry his sister or mother. After their looks are changed (or only the sister or mother changes her face) they take each other for strangers, marry and beget the new race

motif_title: The flood: people turn into toads
motif_gloss: During a flood or when crossing a river those people who drown (or those who survive) turn into toads
During the flood birds or animals escape to some place (mountain, tree, boat, sky). Tips of their tails or other body parts get covered with water or foam and acquire their present color and form

motif_title: The flood: birds cling to the sky
motif_gloss: During the flood some birds survive clinging to the sky with their beaks
Person uses his supernatural powers to destroy a large group of people who have offended or insulted his son

motif_title: The dog and the world cataclysm
motif_gloss: A dog warns people about approaching flood or world conflagration, instructs them what should be done
In the beginning of time or after the flood man marries a bitch. Present people descend from them.
During or before the world cataclysm (deluge, darkness) or (Suruí) in particular place at night, household objects and/or stones, trees, domestic animals turn into wild beasts and monsters
During or before the world catastrophe (deluge, darkness) wild beasts and monsters attack and destroy people
Monstrous puma or jaguar is imprisoned in a cave or tree trunk
Against person's will, butchered, dried or cooked meat, tanned hides, etc. turn back into animals or fish and escape.
Mistress of animals or fish revives them after being offended
The men of primeval community destroy most of the people and/or themselves in a fire pit or on the bonfire

Certain person hides valuables or the impersonator of the valuables hides himself or herself from the people. To get valuables, the interest of their owner or imperso­nator is attracted or diverted by way of singing, dancing, playing music, provocative behavior, offering of unusual gifts, sex or alcohol
The primeval ancestors acquire with difficulty the hidden or stolen sun or daylight. (for computing all cases for motif C19A are included into C19)
Persons (usually Raven) turns into child, asks and receives to play luminaries or comes to play with a small daughter of the owner of the luminaries

In time of severe drought or the world conflagration birds and animals are sent to bring rain from Thunders who live at the end of the world. Some fail, the last one succeeds. Toad takes important part in the action
Growth and falling of giant tree defines the condition of the sky with luminaries on it (tree eclipses the light of the sun, can destroy the sky, tears the sun off the sky, etc.)

motif_title: The world in danger of falling down
motif_gloss: A tree or pillar supports the sky or the earth. If it collapses, people perish
The destiny of creation depends on a person (usually an old woman) who is cooking soup somewhere outside of our world (in the sky, in the Moon, etc.)
Somewhere outside of our world (in the sky, on the Moon, etc.) certain person is spinning, weaving, plaiting, or embroidering

motif_title: The Bid Dipper and the end of the world
motif_gloss: Change in configuration of the stars of certain constellation (usually Big Dipper) or its disappearance from the sky will be a signal of approaching world cataclysm

motif_title: Guardian at the border of the non-human world
motif_gloss: Monsters or ghosts try to invade our world. Powerful person or creature is on guard and prevents the invasion

A horned monster breaks ice on river or lake. Usually people walk across frozen body of water, get to see a horn protruding from the ice and try to cut it off. The monster breaks the ice, many people drown
A demon obtains valuables essential for another person's (and for all the people) survival but is tricked to return the valuables

People or God get know a secret thanks to listening in its possessor when he speaks aloud with himself or with his relations. Before this the wise person was usually asked to come and share his knowledge but was offended and went away
A hedgehog proves to be smarter than other animals (life on earth is saved thanks to him, he deceives a dangerous person, etc.)
The cut off nails (and hair) have special significance for the fate of the soul in the beyond or for the future of the entire world
A strong man who ventured to confront God is for a long time (for eternity) chained to a mountain or to a post
A strong man is enchained but his chains become ever thinner. When blacksmiths beat their hammers against the anvils the chain becomes thick again
The primordial race perishes when the wind blows for the first time
A supernatural person comes to people who fish. They bury him on the beach or throw him into river or marsh. Somebody saves him. He or his father sends the flood
It becomes known that if the Sun or the Sky marry, great calamity is inevitable. The marriage plans are given up
A zoomorphic person gives wise advise concerning the ways that the Sun should follow. His advise is accepted but he himself is punished by the Sun
Gods fight with their powerful adversaries at the decisive battle that changes fate of the world
A sloth produces the world catastrophe or saves people from it
Fire is personified as an (elder) woman, alone or with her husband, master of fire
Girl marries man whose mother is Fire

motif_title: Mistress of fire carries away woman’s baby
motif_gloss: Because a woman offended the fire, its mistress carries the woman’s baby away

motif_title: The borrowed object is not burned
motif_gloss: House of a person who insulted the fire is destroyed but an object or a child of another person who was nice to the fire has not been burned though it was in the house of the first person
The fire is personified as an elder man (alone or with his wife, mistress of fire)

motif_title: Woman gives birth to the fire
motif_gloss: A woman gives birth to a son who is very hot (usually the fire or Sun)
Fire is stolen from its original owner or brought back to the people from somebody who had stolen it before

motif_title: Moth is sent to steal fire
motif_gloss: Moths try to get fire from people and to bring it to somebody else
Person or people who have stolen fire or asked its owner to share the fire are punished by God
Warm season is obtained from its original owners

Animal-people come to steal summer from its owner. One of them in guise of an elk or caribou diverts the owners' attention or puts to float a log that the owner takes for an elk and pursues. The summer is successfully stolen and brought to the people
Opossum steals fire for people
Coyote or fox bring people the fire, the daylight or the Sun
Dog brings people fire

motif_title: Beaver or fish let themselves to be roasted
motif_gloss: Beaver (in North American) or a small fish (in South America) lets fire owners catch and roast it, then revives and carries the fire away
Hummingbird steals for people, discovers or spreads the fire
Swallow steals fire for people
Beaver steals fire for people
Fire owner, stealer, or stealer's companion is a rabbit, a hare or (among the Ofaie) a guinea pig
Dear steals fire for people
First fire is sent to earth from the sky or the ancestors ascend to the sky and bring from there fire or warmth
Person comes to the owners of fire or light. They feast and dance. He joins them and in a proper moment carries away the valuables
A boy or (among the Kutenai) a woman weeps, asking for an element that is absent, i.e. for summer, fire, or rain

motif_title: Fire stealer pretends to be wet and cold
motif_gloss: To steal fire from its owner, person pretends to be wet or cold and is granted permission to sit near the fireplace. In a proper moment the stealer carries the fire away and brings it to people
Parrot or parakeet steals fire for people. (Australian data not computed because historically definitely unrelated to the Tropical American data)
Female person is the owner or inventor (but not personification) of fire
First fire was hidden in genitals or anus of a woman
Crocodile or cayman is an original or temporary owner of fire or lighting
Badly burned person turns into caiman or crocodile
Frog or toad possesses the fire, steals it from original owner, tries to extinguish or to save it
Fire or summer is stolen from a big predator: a lion (in Africa), a tiger (in Asia), a bear (in Siberia and North America) or a jaguar (in South America)
Raven or other big dark-feathered bird scavenger is the owner, personification, spouse, obtainer or stealer of fire, daylight, or the Sun
A male and a female persons personify fire-sticks
Before fire became known, people prepared food using warmth of their bodies (usually putting food in their armpits); or a person keeps fire in his or her armpits
First people or inhabitants of a distant country cook food in the sun; or fire owner lies that he or she cooks food in the sun

motif_title: Heat of the sun is enough for cooking
motif_gloss: To cook their food, people use heat of the sun because they live close to its origin

motif_title: Trickster makes his brother’s wife laugh
motif_gloss: Two companions or brothers live together. The elder conceals his wife from the younger. In his absence, the younger tries to make the woman laugh and this way to get know her hiding place
Woman is hidden somewhere inside the house. Man makes her laugh to discover her
Hunters perish because they were laughing at the killed (and revived) animal
Laughter triggers emergence or spread of fire. Usually fire is obtained from a creature when it bursts out laughing
When person laughs, people see his or her monstrous mouth (many teeth, human meat on teeth). They kill the monster or escape from it
Person should not laugh in the world of the dead

motif_title: Not to laugh visiting the dead
motif_gloss: Person who visits the other world should not laugh or demonstrate his surprise seeing strange and funny things
Person knows that the deceiver and trickster has one of his teeth broken. To identify him, person makes others laugh and thus open their mouths
First human beings are made of unstable materials (mud, wax, fire, honey, etc.) and unviable
Certain person is made of improper material and proves to be short-lived or unfit for fulfilling his functions
Certain person is made of human excrement or carrion
First canoes were made of unfit materials
Making people, creator does not reach perfection immediately. First variants of creation are rejected, then proper form and material found
After destruction of previous world, new people (rare: new earth) are made from the bones of the perished race
Supernatural person rubs his or her skin, creates the entire earth, human or other beings of dirt and cuticle

motif_title: Half-made man attempts to stand up
motif_gloss: God makes the first man of clay. The man must wait till he is dried up but makes attempts to stand up before time

First people (or only first men or first women) are not created but come to earth from the underworld or from a small enclosure under the earth or on its surface (tree trunk, rock, gourd, etc.). Many people of both sexes and of different age or people and different species of animals come out together
The first people grew or crawled out of the earth like a grass, mushrooms, worms, etc.
First man or first human couple come out from the underworld or from a small enclosure on its surface (tussock, reed, tree, rock, gourd)
The first people or first anthropomorphic divine beings descend to earth from the sky.
People live underground or in a small enclosure. When they come out they are attacked by monster or dangerous animal. Monster is killed or transformed

motif_title: The two-headed one is not allowed to come to the earth
motif_gloss: First people or animals ascend or descend to earth. The two-headed monster attempts to follow them but is prevented from coming to the earth

motif_title: Because of a woman worlds become isolated
motif_gloss: When a woman of the child-bearing age tries to come from one world to another (e.g. from sky to earth), the communication between the worlds is blocked or broken forever
To reach their present country, people had to pass (frozen) water body. Part of the migrants remain on the opposite side or is drowned

motif_title: Person stuck in a cosmic hole
motif_gloss: To descend from the sky, ascend from the underworld or come out of the cave, people must pass through narrow hole. A person is stuck in the hole blocking forever communication between different parts of the universe
The first people or (the first) woman (wife of a primeval ancestor) are made of wood
Coconuts picked off a palm or fallen to the ground (rare: leaves picked off a tree) turn into women or into both women and men

A man (rare, a woman) lives alone. In his or her absence, somebody puts his or her house in order, prepares his or her meals or (rare) eats food up, makes a disorder. He or she discovers that a woman (a young man) lives unrecognized (in animal form, hiding in an object) in or near the house or comes during his or her absence
Man maries fox-woman
In search of his lost fox-wife man comes to a den. Different animal- or bird-women come out and ask him if he would mary them. He refuses and they let him in
The mysterious housekeeper is a water creature (turtle, snail, shellfish)
Man marries a woman who has a nature of a big non-predatory animal or comes out of its body (elephant, buffalo, doe, elk, etc.)
Man marries dog-woman
Youth gets to supernatural beings, rejects any treasure, asks for a puppy, a dog's skin, a fruit, etc. When he returns home, the puppy (skin, etc.) turn into magic wife
Man maries parrot- or parakeet-woman
Man marries vulture-woman
A man marries dove-woman or a woman marries dove-man; supernatural woman or man takes form of a dove
Man marries swan- (or goose-, duck-, crane-)woman; supernatural woman takes form of a swan, etc.
Man marries monkey-woman; supernatural woman takes form of a monkey or the man pretends that the house-keeper is a monkey
A man or a woman is incarnation of the honey or a bee-person
A lonely woman or married couple surprises birds or animals who live in their house and take their skins off when nobody looks at them. Birds or animals (usually pups) become children
Magic person reveals his true nature and/or remains with the real people after the object responsible for preserving the non-human appearance (usually an animal skin) is destroyed (usually burned)

motif_title: Ritual objects from under the water
motif_gloss: People obtain ritual objects from under the water or brings them back to the underwater world
Rituals are obtains from ghosts
People prepare ritual costumes and masks coping the features from the real demons whom they have killed
People learn from aquatic birds how to make canoes or how to paddle; or the first canoe is a transformed bird or is made of bird bones

motif_title: Breast bone as a canoe model
motif_gloss: Frame of canoe is made according to breast bone of a bird
While man is asleep, birds turn into girls and sew covering of his canoe
Riding in canoe, people first turn paddles edgewise, then learn the correct way to use them

Humans acquire (the idea of) ornamentation of the vessels, baskets, body, etc. after somebody gets to see the pattern on the skin of zoomorphic and/or supernatural creature. Design on the objects copies (is an imprint of) a pattern on such a skin
People learn how to decorate ceramics or baskets (usually learn decorated patterns) thanks to a water creature

motif_title: Origin of drugs: person torn to pieces
motif_gloss: Narcotic plants emerge from the body parts of a person who was torn to pieces by others
Entering water, certain person makes fish die. From parts of his body or from his grave grows plant used to prepare fish poison (timbo)
Child fishes with poison or his or her body produces fish poison. Fish or water snake kills him or her. The perished child is avenged
Getting into the body of certain being, person obtain knowledge of rituals, songs, ornaments, poison or drugs and then brings it to people
A handful of fleas or lice is thrown into people or into particular person. It was the only way to make him, her or them move and live
Human arms and legs become pliant (get joints) when a primeval ancestor(s) fall from height and break his arms and legs
Man fishes with a hook. Thrown on the ground, the fish turn into the first humans or into the women. (Stories about fishing of women in human guise not included).
People emerge from drops of blood that fall from the sky
Two persons (usually Coyote and Lizard) argue if people's hand has to be like a paw or people should have fingers
Person does not have a spouse, uses wooden fakes for his wife or her husband

motif_title: Make-believe spouse replaced with alive person
motif_gloss: Person does not have a spouse, uses wooden fakes for his wife or her husband till alive person comes to replace it
Man makes a wooden doll, makes believe that it is alive. Really it is not or it is half-alive. Usually a real woman takes place of a doll, marries the master

motif_title: Creators and rescuers of a girl
motif_gloss: Several men take part in creation or reanimation of a girl (rare: a bird) or several women take part in the reanimation of a dead man or they differetly express their grief. It is asked whose role was crucial (who behavior more noble) and/or who should be the spouse of the reanimated person
Several women take part in the reanimation of a dead man. They argue whose role was crucial and/or who of them should be the spouse of the reanimated person
First people are born by trees or come out of a tree, flower, reed
People emerge from grains, seeds
Ogre is killed. Musical instruments used in male rituals and taboo for women emerge from his remains
First people or people made by Creator's rival were imperfect, not completely anthropomorphic (often: had webbed fingers)
Human body was protected with a hard layer now preserved only on fingers and toes as nails
Creator takes many small sticks, transforms them into people of both sexes and all ages

motif_title: Woman gives birth to many embryos
motif_gloss: Woman gives birth to a gourd, a bag (with eggs), a piece of meat. The flesh is cut into pieces which turn into people or many people come out of the gourd or bag
After the world cataclysm or in the beginning of times a gourd survives or appears, new people come out of it
A pig is an ancestor of a particular group of people
First people have noses with nostrils upside and are in trouble when it rains

motif_title: First woman is a transformed man
motif_gloss: Woman or female supernatural is created by changing the sex of a man
Child is born from a tumor or swelling on person's body (on thigh, knee, finger, etc.) or is temporarily placed there or child grows from blood that flew out from a cut
In the beginning of times, a particular person or children in general was or were conceived and grown up in pots, heaps of mud, etc. and not in a womb

Person cannot or do not want to give his daughters in marriage to all the men who claim them for wives and transforms animals into girls. (Usually in the beginning of times or after the flood many men come to marry the only daughter of God or patriarch)

Person has to give his daughter or sister in marriage. Having no woman to suggest or not wanting to give her, he makes artificial girl (of wood, snow, etc.), sends servant girl instead daughter, turns into woman himself, or recognizes his fault when he feels that it is save to do so
Woman has no vagina and it is later made by bird or animal
Man takes or attempts to take a wife who is connected with the underwater world (fish, crab, snake, water animal and the like)
Initially women and men live apart from each other. Later they meet each other and become to live together
For different reasons, sexual contact with a woman is deadly dangerous for a man
There are teeth or sharp stones in vagina, vagina is a toothed mouth
Biting piranha is in woman's genitals

Snake or (in Polynesia: eel) is in vagina, vagina is a mouth of a snake$ or a woman with toothed vagina is associated with a snake$ or a snake crawls out of woman's mouth to bite a man during the copulation
There are dangerous insects in woman's genitals
There are small mammals with sharp teeth in woman's genitals.

People are suggested to choose one of two objects, associated with life and death. They choose the object with death
The right way to dispose of container with stinging insects would be to throw it into the river or sea or bury in a far away place, but it was not done
Stinging insects (rare diseases) had been inside a container or some enclosure. They escaped to the world when the container or enclosure was foolishly opened

During the creation of the earth Creator's antagonist demands for himself as much earth as would be enough to put his staff. He thrusts the stake into the ground (rare: pulls out a certain pole). Insects and reptiles come out of the opening and/or the antagonist falls down through it into the underworld

motif_title: Plagues from the body of a person or creature
motif_gloss: Killed and destroyed (often burned) person or creature (usually ogre, fierce animal, powerful shaman) turns into a multitude of biting insects or into other small molesting creatures
A burned person or creature immediately turns into a multitude of mosquitoes or biting flies
A woman is impregnated by an animal, usually by a snake. People of hostile nation originate or receive their culture from her progeny or from her paramour's relatives

Seeing two women who have come together or in succession, man has to choose one of them. Usually he takes the one who is less pretty and smart or more dangerous inflicting troubles on himself and humanity

motif_title: Origin of death: man and celestial bodies
motif_gloss: God summons to him man and celestial bodies and makes the man mortal and others immortal
Supernatural woman comes to live with humans. Thanks to that, food becomes easily available. She is maltreated, goes away, temporal superfertility is lost forever

A small girl or boy who is a child of a deity comes to live with humans. Thanks to that, food or other resources become easily available. The child is maltreated, returns to its own world, human life becomes difficult and scanty
Children walked or could walk from the very birth but this ability was lost or never obtained
A woman did not allow God to throw her baby across a hedge, roof, etc. Because of this babies lost or never got ability to walk from the very birth
Person has a series of suggestions how to make the world easy for living and free of hard work and death. His companion successively rejects them
Rivers were flowing or according to the original plan had to flow in both directions; somewhere there is a river that flows in both directions
Rice could flow arriving by itself to the household

Sky or sky objects were edible or used as medicine but since the sky had separate from the earth this source of food became inaccessible. Inhabitants of the distant land where the sky and the earth come together feed on pieces of the sky
Snow was edible or something edible was falling from the sky instead of the snow
Baskets carried loads by themselves
One cereal grain (cob, etc.) is enough to prepare a meal
Firewood, brushwood arrived to the house themselves, no work was needed to cut and carry them
Human teeth are made of material subject to easy damage (etiology of tooth ache in most cases)
Person is sent by god to bring instructions or certain objects but distorts, forgets or replaces them. This has fatal consequences for humans or for a certain species of animals

motif_title: Origin of death from the falsified message
motif_gloss: Person is sent by god to bring instructions or certain objects but distorts, forgets or replaces them. Because of this people become mortal (do not revive after death)
Chameleon is responsible for introduction of permanent death
Lizard is responsible for introduction of permanent death
Hare is responsible for introduction of permanent death
Rat is responsible for introduction of permanent death
Raven is sent to deliver important object or message. It distorts message, loses object
Raven is responsible for introduction of permanent death

motif_title: Muddled message: how many meals a day
motif_gloss: God sends his messenger to tell people that they should eat only rarely (once in three days or the like). The messenger tells them that they should eat often (three times a day)
Coyote is responsible for introduction of permanent death
Some beings, frog and toad among them, have to overcome an obstacle. This is realized not the way it was planned and as a consequence, people become mortal
Frog or toad is responsible for introduction of permanent death
Goat or sheep is responsible for introduction of permanent death
Lark is responsible for introduction of permanent death

motif_title: Magic device lost by a failure
motif_gloss: Magic object, device that makes hunting or fishing easy gets into possession of a person who is unable to operate it or abuses it. The device kills or injures the failure himself, other people and/or disappears
Person gives a trickster ability to kindle fire easily. He uses it without need, it is lost

motif_title: Charge of skunk used to no purpose
motif_gloss: Person gives a trickster his power (usually skunk gives his charge) but he squanders it all to see the effect. When a real need comes, the device does not work anymore

motif_title: Supernatural person comes after his property
motif_gloss: Supernatural person changes his guise and comes to the hero's children (more rare, to him). They hand him what he asks for and he disappears with his former property is
Snakes drink liquid spilled on earth and become poisonous or immortal; creatures obtain their characteristics (usually becomes poisonous) after drinking or licking a particular medicine

motif_title: Dog is the guard of man
motif_gloss: Dog guards (successfully or unsuccessfully) the (still unfinished) physical body of man
Dog is responsible for people being mortal or imperfect. Usually the antagonist bribes dog with a warm fur and the dog lets him spoil the half-ready human figures

motif_title: Creator goes away for a while
motif_gloss: After creating the bodies of the first people or after getting a conception how to do it the Creator goes away for a while. During his absence another person, because of his or her ignorance or intentionally, spoils the creation or makes himself or herself what the Creator would make in a better way. Usually because of this people are mortal and subject to diseases

motif_title: One creates the body, another the soul
motif_gloss: One supernatural creates the body of the first people, another revives them

motif_title: Broken figure of the first man
motif_gloss: After making human body, creator goes away for a time. In his absence another person makes attempt to break human figure that was not yet alive

motif_title: Figure of the first man smeared with filth
motif_gloss: After making human body, creator goes away for a time. In his absence another person spits on the human figure that was not yet alive, smears it with filth, etc.

motif_title: Sky and Earth divide their children
motif_gloss: Two persons, one of whom is connected with the sky or the water and another with the earth, divide their child or people created by them. Sky or Water takes the imperishable part, and Earth, the perishable
A woman or child demonstrate no respect for bread soiling it with excrements. For this God punishes all the humanity
To punish people, God deprives them of bread but keeps a small part for a dog or other domestic animal. That’s because cereals still exist
Properties of the cereals (usually the size of the spike) are defined by what the dog did in time of creation
The sky (or the earth) is offended by people’s behavior in respect to it and reacts accordingly (e.g. rises higher than it was before)
Diseases are sisters (rare: brothers), usually children of evil spirit
A dog or other animal or bird kills dangerous creature who was going to attack the pet's master or his child. The master thinks that the assailant was the pet, kills it, then regrets his deed

motif_title: Sky god and mistress of the dead
motif_gloss: A couple of deities or ancestors divorces. Man remains on earth or ascends to the sky, woman becomes the mistress of the dead or of the underworld
A horse is associated with antagonist of the God
Person sets off in search of the country where there is no death. He finds it. He decides to visit his home and dies there

motif_title: Wolf is the master of the dead
motif_gloss: Wolf takes part in creation and/or is a brother of the creator who wins demons of the lower world. Wolf is the first person who died and/or becomes the master of the dead
Eyelids or eyebrows of personage hang long down over his eyes. To make him see, eyelids should be propped up with poles, folks, etc.
Person who visits the other world gets to see different people punished or rewarded according to their behavior when they were alive on earth

motif_title: A married couple under one blanket
motif_gloss: Person gets to see husband and wife who pull their blanket from each other or have not enough space for two on their bed
After eating certain fruit, berry, tuber, etc. people become mortal (cf. motif F97: people become sexually aware)
Creatures that produce rain and/or thunderstorms are birds or anthropomorphic beings with wings; or (rare) some or all birds are connected with thunder, lightning or rain though Thunder is not a bird
Lightning emerges from eyes or mouth of the being who is thought to produce thunderstorms
The lightning (and thunder) is (produced with) an object (axe, sword, mirror, belt, stones, skin, etc.) in hands of anthropomorphic being

motif_title: Thunder in trouble: falls to earth
motif_gloss: Thunder falls to earth, cannot return to the sky. Usually a human person helps him to do it

motif_title: Thunder in trouble: fights with his enemy
motif_gloss: A man helps Thunder who fights with his enemy
Thunder-god is temporarily overcome and imprisoned by his ebemy
Thunder’s instrument is stolen from him. He or his helper comes unrecognized to the thief, gets his instrument and kills the enemies
Thunder looks like a quadruped mammal (pig, buffalo, camel, anteater, tapir, dog, cat, leopard, monkey, etc.)
Tapir is associated with the upper world, usually with the thunder
A man gets to the nest of giant birds. When the birds come, they bring with them clouds, rain, hail, etc. Usually, nestlings tell the man what kind of weather their father or mother brings

motif_title: Male and female birds: different kinds of precipitation
motif_gloss: The male and the female birds bring with them different kinds of precipitations (e.g. the male comes with a hail, the female with a rain)
A flying reptile produces rain, thunderstorm
The lightning is associated with a snake
The earth does not fall down or swing because it is suspended to ropes
The sky or the earth rests upon four or five (cardinal points and the center) supports of any kind (poles, mountains, giants)
Only one pole or mountain supports the earth or the sky
One giant supports the earth or the sky

motif_title: A man and a woman hold the earth
motif_gloss: Two anthropomorphic beings, a male and a female, are in the underworld and support the earth
Originally the earth was unstable and swung, then it was fixed up
Four cardinal directions and/or some objects associated with them are associated with different colors
Different sky levels or different categories of clouds have different colors
Particular layers or categories of the earth have different colors
A turtle, toad, or frog supports the earth or is its embodiment
A tree or post pierces and unites different layers of the universe
Giant water-chthonic or sky serpent or dragon has horns or antlers on its head
Snake of natural size has horns on its head
Reptiles possess treasure with magic properties. Person gets or tries to get it. Usually it is a crown, jewel or small horns on the snake's head
Person or creature has no anus opening

motif_title: Eject digested food through the mouth
motif_gloss: No-anus people eject digested food through the mouth or other orifice
Anthropomorphic beings have no mouths
Mouth of human being was first cut vertically

motif_title: Body anomalies of the first people
motif_gloss: First human beings have no mouth, anus or genitals, their women do not know how to give birth

motif_title: Body anomalies of inhabitants of a distant land
motif_gloss: A race of anthropomorphic beings without mouth, anus, genitals, whose women do not know how to give birth lives in the underworld, in the sky, in a far-away land

motif_title: A spouse or husband without anus or mouth
motif_gloss: Person visits people who have no anus or mouth. He or his sister marries or tries to marry a local dweller

motif_title: People inhale the odor of food
motif_gloss: Anthropomorphic beings satisfy their hunger cooking food and inhaling the odor
Race of dwarfs lives in the underworld
Anthropomorphic inhabitants of the upper world are giants
People in the upper world are different than on earth and put their belts not on the waist but higher or below it

motif_title: Red-haired people scorched by the sun
motif_gloss: People who live in the underworld, at the sunrise or sunset (often dwarfs) are scorched by the Sun which moves by at a short distance from them. They are red-haired, dark-skinned, etc.
Souls on their way to the land of the dead, heroes or shamans have to go between moving rocks, trees, river banks, etc. which are incessantly meeting and parting
The sky is constantly moving up and down in respect to earth

motif_title: Birds fly to the outer world
