motif_gloss: Migratory birds fly from our world to the outer world under the edge of the sky which is rising and falling or through a narrow opening. Many birds perish. Eventual details: person who lives at this place feeds on these birds; it can be mistress of birds lives on another side of the pulsating obstacle
The door of a house is opening and closing by itself crashing persons who attempt to come in or out
Snake, lizard or worm is a bridge or a rope over the river

Way to the place of a certain person is guided by dangerous creatures (which often stand on the both sides of the pathway). Person placates them by gifts or nice talk, and they let him or her go the both ways, sometimes being punished for this by their master
Person sees that food put for certain animals is inedible for them and corrects situation (usually gives to herbivorous animals food that was given before to predators and vice versa)

motif_title: Dangers on the way of souls
motif_gloss: On its way to the Beyond, a soul has to defend itself or divert attention of guards who wait for it giving presents to them
A dog is the lord, guard or guide of/to the land of the dead; or dogs live on the way to the land of the dead
Souls of the dead dogs have their own towns in the Beyond or their own paths to travel there
A dog ferries person across a river that forms a border between the worlds
Dogs having spots over the eyes are called the four-eyed and believed to have special properties (e.g. to see ghosts)
Game animals live inside a mountain, in a cave or in the underworld where they often look like humans and have a master
Big game animals disappear under the earth and produce earthquakes

motif_title: Armadillo’s hole leads to the underworld
motif_gloss: Person crawls after an armadillo into its hole and gets into the underworld or digs a hole and gets into the world of the armadillos

motif_title: Master of the dead welcomes women
motif_gloss: Master or mistress of the realm of the dead copulates with every new human soul of the opposite sex who arrives to his or her realm

motif_title: Master and mistress of the dead
motif_gloss: In the Beyond, every soul is treated by the mythological characters of the opposite sex
There is (or was) a tree on which souls of still unborn babies grow, which leaves transform into people, or which trunk is covered with female breasts or flowers that innumerable babies are sucking
When a leave or a fruit of a certain tree drops, one of the people on the earth dies
The ultimate aim of the afterlife journey is to reach certain tree
It is necessary to approach a tree which is surrounded with fire, ejects fire, shoots sharp splints, etc.
Thunder is produced by dragging behind a dry animal skin or (rare) a person (rare) or by shaking clothes
Thunder is produced by an old woman who lives in the sky
Person pretends to be the sky-god imitating rain and thunderstorm

motif_title: Thunder and lightning are two siblings
motif_gloss: Two siblings turn into thunder and lightning or into two thunders or one turns into thunder, another into an animal
Mushrooms are excrements of mythological person
Tree fungi are steps, small platforms, umbrellas, obstacles that make moving easier or more difficult, provide a shelter or cover
Fungi or mushrooms are named “ears”
Tree fungi shout like persons
Some beings are half-men and half-dogs (usually anthropomorphic with heads of dogs)
Dogs or dog-headed men are husbands of human women
Rainbow is a road or bridge by which some ascend to the sky or descend from it
Rainbow is a bow
Rainbow is a reptile (usually a snake) or (more rare) a fish, or it is related to snake, to its tongue, breath, or to scorpion's tail
Rainbow rises from an anthill

motif_title: Rainbow is a pair of creatures
motif_gloss: Rainbow is two creatures or persons, usually a male and a female
Giant reptilian monster (serpent, more rare fish, chain of fish) extends in the sky and/or supports the sky being associated with Milky Way or the rainbow

motif_title: Milky Way is a serpent or fish
motif_gloss: Milky Way is a reptile, fish, or chain of fish
Giant serpent lies on the perimeter of the earth or supports the earth

motif_title: Not to point at the Moon or a star
motif_gloss: Person who points at the Moon or a star or looks intently at them will get sick or die or his pointing finger will rot or wither

motif_title: Not to point at the rainbow
motif_gloss: It to point at the rainbow, pointing finger or entire arm will rot, wither or become crooked
Person who counts stars will suffer diseases and misfortunes
Rainbow is the ornamented part of the clothes, its decoration, a belt
Rainbow is associated with an old woman
Intensity of particular colors of rainbow predicts good or bad harvest of particular crops
Rainbow is a rope to which a domestic animal is tied
Rainbow is a snare, a noose
Rainbow is a flatulence of a demon, a spray of a skunk, is associated with spit, urine, feces, genitals, etc., causes skin diseases
Rainbow is associated with a wedding of foxes or jackals

Certain person loses his or her freedom, is confined to a far away place (often, to the underworld) and acquires cosmic dimensions: supports the earth or the sky and/or his or her movements produce earthquakes or (rare) storms
Earthquake is a person. Whenever he or she runs or walks, the earth trembles

motif_title: Animal with more than four legs
motif_gloss: An animal (a horse, an elk, a moose, a bear) with six, eight or ten legs is described or represented in art
A demon tears off or devours one by one legs of a riding animal of the hero
Big mammal supports the earth
The earth or the sky are identified with a big quadruped mammal or are made of parts of its body
World is supported by fish or fish-like monster or the earth itself is such a monster
The animal or the fish which supports the earth is bothered by an insect. The animal moves and the earth trembles.
Anaconda or a water monster has live fish or animals inside; is father of the fish; all fish emerge from its body
Stars are openings in the firmament; holes in dwelling's covering are thought to be stars

motif_title: Ghosts do not see people from earth
motif_gloss: Person who gets into another world is invisible for its inhabitants and his touch makes local person ill
Thunder's enemies are evil spirits, reptiles, animals living in burrows. They hide from him in different objects, Thunder destroys these objects

motif_title: Milky Way is the way of birds
motif_gloss: Milky Way is the path of migratory birds (especially wild geese)
Milky Way is a trace of people who spilled on their way something related to agriculture (straw, chaff, hay, more rare flour, peas)

motif_title: Milky Way is a seam in the sky
motif_gloss: Milky Way is a sky seam, a concealed fissure or crack between two half of the sky vault

motif_title: Milky Way is a stripe on belly
motif_gloss: Milky Way is a longitudinal streak, associated with a white line, stripe along the middle of a belly of an animal
Milky Way is a trace of spilled milk
Milky Way is a sky river, water body, chain of beings that swim

motif_title: Milky Way is a path of tapir
motif_gloss: Milky Way is a path of tapir, or tapir is seen in the Milky Way
Milky Way is a trace of two (rare: more) animals that were running a race
Milky Way is the path over which souls travel to the beyond or a path of the funeral procession
Milky Way is ashes or smoldering coals
Milky Way is a giant rhea
On a certain day, the sky vault opens and the interior of the sky is seen; usually any wish expressed at this moment will be fulfilled
Shining sky objects or atmospheric phenomena are excrements of sky dwellers

motif_title: Water reptile on plants on its back
motif_gloss: Trees or reeds grow on the back of a monstrous reptile
Stars are plants or roots of the plants which grow in the upper world
Stars are people, ghosts, anthropomorphic beings (interpretations of unique star objects like Venus or Polaris as persons not considered)
Stars (rare: suns and moons) are sparks or burning coals
Stars are shining stones, spangles
Stars are fire-flies, glow-worms
Before present world, several (three or more) other worlds or races of people existed
After certain time a snake or fish turn into a dragon
After certain time a mouse turns into a bat
Powerful person connected with thunder and rain is lame (usually after falling down from the sky)
The earth is square, the sky is usually round
Person gets to the house of Thunder, becomes his servant and breaking certain taboo or instructions, produces extensive thunderstorm or rain
Man meets Thunders and becomes one of them

motif_title: Waters rush down into the underworld
motif_gloss: Waters of all rivers on earth run to the precipice where they rush down into the underworld
A giant crab produces earthquakes or floods, stops or can stop flow of the waters into the chasm
It is tide when a creature belches out the sea water or ousts it with its body and it is ebb when it swallows the water or lets it go back
Morning and/or Evening Star is a male personage
Morning and/or Evening Star is a female personage
Venus or some other bright star seen near the eastern or western horizon is female and wife of the Moon

motif_title: Morning and Evening stars are a man and a woman
motif_gloss: Morning and Evening stars are opposed as a man and a woman or vice versa
It is told about Venus or other star that she sold her mother or father to have a beautiful attire
Birds, first of all vultures and eagles, live in the sky, usually at one or more layers of the upper world

motif_title: Milky Way is a snow-shoes track
motif_gloss: Milky Way is a path of a person who was walking on snow-shoes

motif_title: Son of God frozen to death
motif_gloss: In winter time despite warning son of the sky deity sets off (usually on his snow-shoes) and is frozen to death

motif_title: Polaris is a pole, a nail
motif_gloss: Polaris is a (tethering) pole or a nail
Hoofed animals are walking around Polaris
Polaris is a man
Person gets to the sky and finds there several vessels with different kinds of weather, precipitations, times of the year and the like

motif_title: Hairs into animals, scales into fish
motif_gloss: Master of living beings sends down, hairs, scales, etc. which turn into birds, animals, fish
Snow is created from bird's down when certain bird in the sky shakes itself or certain person shakes his or her clothes made of bird down
Personages use a shelter which proves to be an object related to the world of the giants (a skull, a shoulder-blade, a mitten)

motif_title: Series of creatures ever greater in size
motif_gloss: Personage of gigantic dimensions in respect to normal humans and animals proves to be tiny dwarf in respect to another personage
Two persons engaged into dialogue describe a series of objects and creatures as simultaneously giant and small
Antagonist names numbers from one to seven or nine, every time asking what it is. The hero gives answers that the antagonist accepts as correct ones.
A bull or a horse of a huge length is described (the head in one field, the tail in another; person who is near the head walks a long time till he meets a one neat the tail)

motif_title: Only child was able to pick it up
motif_gloss: Strong men or a lot of people cannot move the corpse of a killed person or creature but a child or a woman does it easily

motif_title: Boaster in search of a rival
motif_gloss: Person boasts how strong he is. His wife tells him that he is not the only strong man. He sets off, meets a person who is much stronger than him
Animals use for a shelter an object like a mitten, skull, etc. that belongs to the world of the people
There is a zoomorphic being with many tails
At night travelers mistake some bright star for Morning Star, set off, take a wrong direction, perish or get into trouble

motif_title: Water body a the base of a tree
motif_gloss: There is a source or body of water at the base of a tree which connects layers of the universe and/or has gigantic dimensions and considered to be the main tree of the world
Person who gets to walk under, over or through the rainbow changes his or her sex
Milky Way is the backbone of the sky or of all the world
The Pleiades are holes in the firmament

motif_title: The Pleiades are a sieve for grain
motif_gloss: The Pleiades are a sieve to process agricultural products
Orion is a balance, scales
Orion is a shoulder-yoke
Orion is a staff, a crook
Rainbow is blood, associated with war and death

motif_title: The Pleiades are a hen with its chickens
motif_gloss: The Pleiades are a brooding hen, hen with its chickens, chickens

motif_title: The Pleiades are a duck’s nest
motif_gloss: The Pleiades are wild ducks, a nest or eggs of a wild duck

motif_title: The Pleiades are boys or men
motif_gloss: The Pleiades are a group of boys or men, or a group of different people but predominantly males
The Pleiades are a group of girls or women (with children)

motif_title: The Pleiades are mother with children
motif_gloss: The Pleiades are a woman with her children

motif_title: The Pleiades are a group of people
motif_gloss: The Pleiades are any people (of any ages and sex, combined data of i99-i100a)
God transformed man into a cuckoo, his wife and children into the Pleiades
The Pleiades or stars in general are associated with kids or lambs

motif_title: Big Dipper is poles, a nailed skin
motif_gloss: Several bright stars of Big Dipper or other constellation are poles which support or stretch an object like skin, shelter, etc.
Milky Way is a tree or a trace of a tree
Sirius is associated with a dog or a wolf
Stars are fragments of broken Moon or (rare) Sun; or stars, the sun and the moon are formed from one and the same primeval person or creature
One of constellations represents a hand with fingers
Ursa major is only one anthropomorphic being, not several persons
Stars are nails in the firmament or pegs, or stars are nailed to the sky
The Pleiades are only one anthropomorphic being, not several persons

motif_title: Milky Way is the path of the Sun
motif_gloss: Milky Way is the path of the Sun and/or Moon
Orion (rare: other constellation) is a plough
(Belt of) Orion is (three) mowers or agricultural tools related to mowing and harvesting
The earth is the body of a crocodile or a dragon
A boat is a fish, a living creature with a mouth, it can swallow people
A pig made of gold or having golden bristles is a treasure

motif_title: Ursa major and the Pleiades as men and women
motif_gloss: Described in one and the same tale, Ursa major is associated with men and the Pleiades with women

motif_title: Orion and the Pleiades as a man and a woman
motif_gloss: Orion and the Pleiades are opposed as a man or men and a woman or women. Orion is usually male

motif_title: Milky Way is the border between the seasons
motif_gloss: The Milky Way is the border-line between seasons of the year or parts of the universe (the wet and the dry seasons, the sky and the earth, etc.)

motif_title: Spider ferries from one world to another
motif_gloss: Spider person raises the hero to the sky, helps him or her to return back to earth or otherwise helps to overcome the borderlines between worlds
Spider-woman (rare: spider-man) is a patron of the hero who lives in her house and marries her daughter
The earthquakes are produced by the dead who are in the underworld or during the earthquakes the inhabitants of the lower world try to come out
Food and clothes are extracted from the horn of a cow or goat

motif_title: Ursa major and Ursa minor as twin constellations
motif_gloss: Constellations of Ursa major and Ursa minor are interpreted as twin objects of the same type (two animals, two carts, etc.)
The Pleiades are a nest, a congestion of insects
Altair or Vega with a weak nearby star are believed to appear on the sky immediately after winter solstice though really it is not so
Ursa major is a boat
The Hyades are a jaw bone or a head of a big animal or anthropomorphic creature

motif_title: Ursa major is a stretcher or grave
motif_gloss: Ursa major is funeral stretcher or a grave
Ursa major is a bed, a bedstead
Ursa major is a dipper, a ladle
When constellation of Heron appears on the sky, the rain season begins
Orion, the Pleiades, Ursa Major or Ursa Minor is a hunting or fishing net
Life of every man is related to certain thread. When the thread is cut, the man dies

motif_title: Climbing a deer antlers up to the sky
motif_gloss: A giant deer’s or deer-like creature’s antlers reach the upper world, a person climbs them to get there
A girl marries a man or is impregnated by man who is or was incarnated in a tree
A woman gives birth to a boy or twin boys after being impregnated without her knowledge when one of the animal persons crawls under the earth to the place where she sits on a ground
Heroes avenge their (grand)father's or uncles' death, not the death of their mother or both parents
Two or several brothers or friends are killed by antagonists. One of them is the father of the young hero who avenges their death or all of them are his uncles
A woman or a girl is in search of her husband, fiancé or kinsmen. She loses her way because certain person changed signs at the crossroad
A woman or a girl is in search of her husband or other person. Bird feathers at the cross-road or near the person's dwelling mark the correct or the wrong way

motif_title: Unborn children talk from the womb
motif_gloss: A woman is in search of her husband or other person or object. Her unborn children speak from her stomach and shows her the correct way

A woman loses her way after being bitter by insect (wasp, bee, ant). She accuses her unborn sons of being the cause of the bite and/or slaps herself on her abdomen to punish the sons or to kill the insect. As a consequence her sons are offended and do not show her the correct way anymore

motif_title: Unborn child asks to pick up some flowers
motif_gloss: A quarrel between a mother and her sons in her womb flares up after they ask her to pick up flowers or fruits (usually the insect bites her when she picks flowers up)

A girl (or two sisters) travel, usually in search of a proper marriage partner who lives far away or who has gone away. On her way or after reaching the place of destination the girl gets to some unpleasant suitors
A girl or two sisters get to old woman who suggests them to marry her son. It is a worm or alive penis preserved by its mother in a pot. The girl (the sister) rejects it, runs away
A suitor or husband is a fragrant Honey person or skillful honey-gatherer
A girl gets to see her bridegroom for the first time at a feast and then sets off to his place following instructions received from him
After a girl marries a valuable suitor, a rejected imposter or his relations kill him
In village where valuable marriage-partner lives an imposter plays the role of a buffoon

motif_title: A valuable partner and an imposter live in one house
motif_gloss: A valuable partner whom a girl (two sisters) should marry and an imposter live together in one and the same house
A murderer of a valuable marriage-partner pretends to mourn over him. His trick is exposed, people chase him
A girl or two sisters marry a valuable partner. His rival kills or attempts to kill him or his wives. As a consequence, the women turn into water birds
Two sisters (if more, only two play a significant role in the plot) travel and meet an unpleasant suitor or get to an ogre
A girl or two sisters walk in search of the man whose beautiful voice or whose flute-play they listen
Walking in search of her husband, boyfriend, kinsmen, shelter woman or girl gets to the house of dangerous creatures where she is injured or killed
Setting off (usually in search of her husband, boyfriend or kinsmen), woman gets to the place of dangerous felines
Setting off (usually in search of her husband, boyfriend or kinsmen), woman gets to the place of female toad or frog
Person perishes because being forced to clean ogre's or animal’s head infected with insects, refuses to bite the insects, spits in disgust or is suspected to do it
Instead of lice, there are other (bigger or dangerous) creatures in the hair of some persons or he or she pretends that his or her hair is infested with them
A woman who is pregnant or has a small child falls from the sky. She or a daughter born by her dies but her (grand)son is grown up

motif_title: Mother is eaten up, children escape
motif_gloss: An ogress devours a woman, gets into her house. Her daughters (daughter and son, one daughter) run away, climb a tree or a rope that hangs from the sky. Ogress pursues them and perishes
When husband o brother leaves home to hunt, an evil spirit comes to his wife or sister. The spirit kills her or carries her away after injuring or transforming her

motif_title: To serve food on the abdomen
motif_gloss: A guest demands that a woman would serve him food on her abdomen
An evil spirit kills a woman burning her belly through

When husband o brother leaves home to hunt, an evil spirit comes to his wife or sister and kills or injures her being able to do it because she has broken taboo to open the door, to look at the guest or to answer him or her
Two men or a man and a woman appear from two halves of the cut in two anthropomorphic body or embryo; or another man appears from part of the body of the first one or from his body discharge
A woman is torn or cut in half, two new women appear
A demonic creature has a form of two women half merged like Siamese twins

motif_title: Two animals from one cut in two
motif_gloss: Two halves of one animal cut in two turn into two new animals or into foreigners
A second person evolves from the placenta of the first one

People disappear one by one. A lonely woman has a baby or finds a baby or she becomes pregnant magically and gives birth to a boy or twins. The boy grows up, exterminates the antagonists, usually revives and releases those who had disappeared
A woman is crying, mucus from her nose turns into a boy who grows up, overcome powerful adversaries
Hero is grounded to powder but resuscitates

Heroes (one, two, one of the two), usually beings still babies or embryos, escape into the water, are carried away into the wilderness or thrown into the water. They are caught (often with difficulty) by some persons or come to them by their own will
Mother dies or is killed. Her (still unborn) baby-son is buried with her. He comes out of the grace, meets people, then returns to the grave but ultimately agrees to remain with the people

motif_title: Babies come out of the water
motif_gloss: Baby heroes or embryos are found in a river or lake or come to people out of the water

One of two small boys (or one of two pairs of boys, two of three boys) lives in a lodge with his (adoptive) father or mother. The young male who lives in the lodge can be also a pup (allegedly) born by the woman. Another boy (or couple of boys) has been thrown away or born by his mother after her death, grows up by himself or is grown up by some spirit, comes to his brother(s) and ultimately to his (adoptive) parent. Usually (adoptive) father or mother catches him and domesticates with much difficulty
One of two babies is thrown away and lives in the water, in the forest, etc., another lives in the house; after both of them become to live in the house, they kills their father

Hero asks how one of his parents died and receives a series of false answers. Usually he successively exposes himself to the same dangers, survives and thus demonstrates that truth is still concealed from him

A youth gets to know that a woman (usually his mother) conceals from him important information about his father, brothers or bride. He causes her pain (usually putting hot scone, handful of hot grain, etc. into her hand) making her tell him the truth
A murdered parent of the hero comes to him as a ghost and informs about the circumstances of his or her death
Before the hero destroys the antagonists or escapes from them, he finds or receives the remains or possessions that belonged to the antagonists' victim
A young hero obtains and uses weapons or other powerful objects which belonged to his murdered father
Somebody regularly steals valuables (horse, hay, apples, etc.). Brothers one by one spy for the thief but only the youngest surprises him
Before passing away a man asks his sons to guard his grave for a certain time or to bring something to his grave. The youngest son goes and obtains valuables

A youth or two siblings live in a house of an old man or woman. To produce a reaction from this older person, they kill a person or animal and stuff its skin with insects, worms, ashes, grass or blow it up

A youth or two siblings live in a house of an old woman. they kill her a person or animal who is her husband and make a dummy of him. The old woman is angry that her husband does not answer her, beats him and understands that it is a dummy
After killing their enemy, heroes have fun frightening their (grand)mother or father with its dummy
A tree-frog kills or neutralizes dangerous person or creature who chases heroes
Hero's parents are killed by turtle who pulled them under the water
A man turns into powerful bird or creates it. The bird carries away his enemy
A mighty bird thrust its talons into a big fish, whale, water monster, etc. Talons get stuck, the bird is either pulled down under the water or makes itself free with great difficulty

Antagonist makes a girl or a woman his or her slave. The slave's brothers or sons secretly come to her, kill for her some small game. Woman tries to pursue the antagonist that she herself killed the game

A dangerous being who lives in the sky carries away a person or many people (or person's cut off head or limb). A young kin of the perished one revenges on the dangerous being and/or brings back the victim (his or her head, etc.)
After the hero comes back after a long absence and finds his parents enslaved, he tells them to demonstrate openly a lack of respect to their masters and punishes those who were cruel with them

motif_title: Foxes jeer at the abandoned person
motif_gloss: When the hero returns home after a long absence, his relation does not believe at first that it is really he because all this time somebody jeered at him or her imitating the hero's voice, telling that the hero is back, etc.

motif_title: Son transforms mother into a bird
motif_gloss: When hero returns, he finds his mother being tormented during his absence and transforms her (and usually himself) into a certain bird

motif_title: Son returns and burns tormentors using magic
motif_gloss: When hero returns and finds his mother being tormented during his absence, he burns the tormentors producing fire and heat by magic
When person comes to the water body, waters are split apart so the person reaches the other bank walking on the dry ground
To kill his antagonists, hero lures them with an attractive object which is delicious to eat and is usually on the other side of a body of water or a canyon
Person or his helper draws his enemies on the unstable bridge and destroys it. The enemies fall into water, into a precipice

Person stretches his or her leg or neck as a bridge across water body. The fugitives or those who walk ahead cross the bridge; the persecutor or those who are behind usually fall because the person takes his bridge off
Antagonist perishes falling into the water or trying to cross a water body
Person ascends to the sky (rare: descends from the sky; ascends the cliff) by a rope, a ladder, etc. Another person tries to follow him or her but the rope (the ladder) is broken or severed
A bean or a pea grows up to the sky and a person climbs by it there
Person ascends to the sky or descends from the sky to earth by a rope. A parrot cuts the rope, the person falls to earth
The Moon's wife or sister tries to follow him to the sky but is unable to do it

motif_title: An attempt to revive the victim
motif_gloss: Twin heroes' parent dies or is killed, an attempt to revive him or her fails
Mother dies when her sons embrace or push her

An attempt to revive the killed father (and uncle) is only partly successful and the revived person is unable to live among the living. The hero decides to abandon him in the other world or to let him die forever

Person or animal is eaten up or destroyed otherwise. His bones are put together and he or it is revived. Because one bone was broken, swallowed or lost, the person or animal cannot be revived or being revived misses some part of his or its body

motif_title: Ladder made of limbs of a girl
motif_gloss: To help a man to ascend a rock, a girl tells him to cut her into pieces, make a ladder of her limbs, then put them together again. The girl revives but a finger is missing

motif_title: Two animal persons and their children
motif_gloss: A strong and aggressive animal person (often a bear) treacherously kills his (or her) companion who is a weaker animal person. The victim's children revenge on the murderer killing his (her) own children

A bear-person (usually Bear-woman) kills her or his female companion who is associated with a weaker animal – not a predator or a weaker predator. The victim's children revenge on the antagonist killing her own children and / or run away and escape
A girl, a young woman, or children who are associated with a hare or rabbit are heroes of the story
Deer person is killed by the stronger animal person. The deer's children revenge on the murderer and (or) successively escape from him or her

motif_title: One of two female companions kills another
motif_gloss: Two co-wives of female companions live together, both have children. Once when they go to work outdoors (usually to gather wild plants), one of them kills and devours another. The victim's children escape

motif_title: The calf and the tiger cub
motif_gloss: Two women (usually female animal persons) live together, both have children, one of them kills and devours another. The son of the murderer kills his mother and becomes a companion of the victim's son, or the victim’s and the murderer’s children escape together

motif_title: Kills own mother to rescue his half-brother
motif_gloss: A hero and a son of the antagonist live together. They are half-brothers friends. When the antagonist makes attempt to kill the hero, the antagonist's son kills his own mother (or his both parents) or helps his human brother to do it
Hero comes across different creatures or persons who do not recognize him. Everyone tells that he is waiting for the Hero to kill him. The hero easily kills or transforms them himself
Twin heroes (or one boy) come to their divine father. He puts them under trials to get know if they are really his children and possess supernatural power
Brothers turn into cooking pots or griddles which are put on fire. Only the eldest is strong enough to stand this trial
A virgin girl is impregnated by the Sun and gives birth to a son or twin boys. When her son (or the twins) grows up, he (they) comes to his father
Persons make chain of arrows or darts shooting them one into another and making a chain or rope of them. Usually, they ascend by this rope to the upper world
Chain of arrows is used to pull or push the sky or the Sun lower or higher or to break a hole in the sky

motif_title: Following arrow gets to the sky
motif_gloss: To climb to the sky, person needs first to shoot an arrow that would reach the sky and stick into it
Shooting and arrow, person flies on it, after it or ahead of it
A woman is impregnated by two different males and gives birth to twin sons who have different fathers
Person is able to move or to hover in the air like a feather or a bit of fluff
An antagonist transforms his victims into stones or (rare) plants, animals, monsters. Hero escapes transformation, revives the victims

Enemies attack household. The master's wife agrees to live with the enemies' leader, her former husband lies outdoors alive but tied up. His daughter refuses to release him, but his son does it. The man kills the enemies, usually cruelly kills his wife and daughter
Person ascends to the sky on a column of smoke (but not being burned in a fire)

A lonely woman with her daughter are the only survivors after enemies' attack. The woman rejects a series of animal-persons who come to ask her daughter in marriage but accept a sky-person for her son-in-law. Children of the sky-person and woman's daughter revenge on the enemies
Hero or his helpers cut or gnaw through bow- and other strings of the enemies, make holes in their canoes, making the enemies unable to fight or to pursue the hero
At night person puts light stones or shells on his eyes. The antagonist believes that his eyes are opened and does not dare to attack

motif_title: One who comes to look at adversary’s bones dies himself
motif_gloss: A man is marooned on an islet, a rock but survives thanks to helpful birds and animals. The next time the hero and the antagonist exchange roles. Usually the antagonist comes to the islet to see the bones of the abandoned man but the man takes the canoe of the antagonist and paddles away. The antagonist dies
Brothers of a man's wife hate him and maroon on an islet
Person is marooned on an islet or on another side of a sea or wide river
A man maroons another because of jealousy or because he plans to take hold of his wife
Hero turns into stag or creates a stag to charge his kinsman who sent hi into a trap
Person is imprisoned in a tree-hollow or inside a rock and is released by somebody who makes a hole from outside

motif_title: Tree to descend from a rock
motif_gloss: A tree or vine quickly grows up near the rock or in the bottom of a pit where the hero was marooned. He gets to the ground climbing down (or up) this tree (vine)

motif_title: A marooned man returns home before his adversary
motif_gloss: A man marooned on an islet or rock in the sea turns into a bird and flies home. When the man who marooned him comes home, the hero is already there

Hero climbs up (e.g. to a tree) or down (e.g. into a deep cave) by ladder, rope, from branch to branch, etc. The rope etc. breaks or is intentionally destroyed and the hero cannot return to the ground. (all cases of motif K2A are also computed together with K2)

A man descends down into the well, precipice, etc. Saving a girl or girls, getting treasure etc. he sends them up. After receiving girls and treasure, companions cut the rope and the hero remains below
Hero climbs up a tree or rock to get eggs, nestlings, fruits, honey, etc. Another person makes the tree (rock) grow higher or thicker and the hero is unable to descend back

Person climbs up a tree or rock or descends to a cave to get eggs or nestlings from the bird's nest. Another person remains on the ground. They get into conflict and/or the first person is unable to get back to the ground
To lure the hero into a trap or to send him far away, the antagonist makes a bird or nestlings of excrements or guts
A vine grows from person's or animal's tears, mucus, urine, etc.
Hero compares something with pubis of another man's wife or sister. The insulted man maroons him in a tree or rock.

Person gets into the belly of water being or into the belly of giant creature which appearance and living place remain vague. He kills the monster from the inside and/or returns to earth by himself (i.e. not extracted by other people)
Person gets into the belly of a giant bird. He kills it from the inside and/or returns to earth by himself (i.e. not extracted by other people)

motif_title: Woman is soul of a whale
motif_gloss: Raven gets inside a whale where he sees a woman who asks him not to touch an inner organ of the whale (usually its heart) or a burning lamp. Raven touches it, woman disappears, the whale dies
Person gets into the belly of ground animal or bird. He kills it from the inside and/or returns to earth by himself (i.e. not extracted by other people)

motif_title: First swallowed by herbivorous animal and then by wolf
motif_gloss: Tiny boy is first swallowed by chance by a big herbivorous animal and then carried away by a wolf who began to eat the animal's offal
Person (often an animal-person) gets into the belly of anthropomorphic being. He kills it from the inside and/or returns to earth by himself (i.e. not extracted by other people)
Person or animal gets into another being through its anus
A swallowed up person finds alive deer in the belly of the monster

motif_title: God’s wife thrown down from the sky
motif_gloss: The sky chief discovers or thinks that his wife, sister or lover is untrue or incestuous. He throws her down from the sky. She becomes the mistress of the lower or middle world or a part of it or one of her sons gets power over the lower world

motif_title: Battle with a bird: a shelter
motif_gloss: Heroes kill a dangerous bird. During or before confrontation they hide inside a shelter (hut, cage, vessel, bag, hollow log) or cover themselves with a protective object
A giant bird carries away to its nest a cage or bag with people inside

Hero (or twins) hangs on his body a bag with animal bowels full of blood. Breaking them with its claws, the bird thinks that its victim is killed and brings the man to its nest. He kills the adult bird, kills or transforms its nestlings

motif_title: Bird carries man to an island
motif_gloss: A flying monster carries a man to a far away island. There he gets to kill the monster. To return, he uses a boat, a bridge or a rope made of parts of the monster's body
Getting to a nest of a monstrous bird, a man finds there kidnapped people, helps them to return home
Hero transforms nestlings or monster bird into common eagles or owls
Feathers of giant bird turn into different present day birds
A rival or adversary kidnaps man's wife or bride or takes her sending her man off. The man gets her back
An unrecognized hero comes to a place where his bride or wife has to marry another man or is tuned into a slave. Despite expectations, he gets to strain a tight bow killing his rivals

motif_title: Person with cut off leg ascends to the sky
motif_gloss: Certain person's leg or (rare) both legs are cut, torn, or bitten off. He ascends to the sky, usually becomes a constellation or a luminary or gets to the luminary
A caiman ferries a man across water body, bites his leg off. The maimed man is transformed into a constellation or into an animal

motif_title: Ogress’ daughter avenges death of her mother
motif_gloss: A man marries an ogress' daughter, kills her mother. The wife revenges on him, gets to cut off his leg
A group of boys gets to the sky. The leg of the last one is cut or torn off
A man gives his last money for simple advices. Each of them saves his life or helps to achieve success or he does not follow the advices and gets into trouble
An antagonist orders to kill the first one who will come in the morning to a certain place. The hero becomes late by chance, the antagonist or his wife or son come and are thrown into the fire
Hero substitutes powerful person's weapon with a fake

Because containers with alive and dead water (one makes one stronger, another weaker) are imperceptibly exchanged, during the battle the hero drinks the alive water and overcomes his enemy who drinks the dead water
The owner of the stone (ice) clothes kills people. The hero hides his stone clothes and kills him

motif_title: Girl’s pet turns into a young man
motif_gloss: Disguised as a bird, small animal or insect, the hero lets himself be caught by a girl to have sex with her or to steal valuables possessed by her family or he lets himself be caught by the girl's father to receive opportunity to get to his daughter

Being eager to show that he is a successful hunter, a man walks in front of a girl carrying a game (deer, birds). The girl makes him slip, he drops the false game that proves to be a dummy stuffed with ashes or a termite nest
Ornithomorphic hero impregnates a girl magically or imperceptibly for her

motif_title: Infant picks out his unknown father
motif_gloss: To get know who is the father or (rare) mother of a small boy, many people come together. Everybody is eager to be recognized as the boy's parent but the boy points at his real father or mother

motif_title: Infant takes father’s bow and arrows
motif_gloss: When a small boy has to recognize his father among many men, he comes to him and takes father's bow and arrows
A baby boy has to recognize his father or mother among many people. When his parent takes him, the boy ceases crying
A baby boy has to recognize his father among many men. When his father takes him, the boy urinates at his arms
A man maries a star-woman
A woman maries a star-man
During the day time a man hides his star-wife in a bag, gourd-vessel, and the like
When a man who has married a star gets to the sky, he suffers severe cold and dies either of cold or after touching a forbidden fire

When a woman or two sisters descend from sky back to earth, they get to the top of a tree. Some animals who walk by cannot help them or do not want to help. Wolverine gets women down because he plans to marry them but they escape from him
Star person or persons descend to earth to work at the garden plot

motif_title: Two stars of different color and brightness
motif_gloss: Two stars are men, an old and a young ones. They look different as about their color or brightness but these characteristics do not correlate (the bright star can prove to be an old man and vice versa. Usually two girls wish these stars for husbands and express different preferences (one prefers bright blue star, another wants small and red one, etc.)

motif_title: Wish for star-husband or wife realized
motif_gloss: A human person admires a star or (rare) the Moon in the sky, wishes for a star. The star descends to him or her or takes him or her to the sky

motif_title: Woman descends from the sky by rope
motif_gloss: A sky-dweller marries a woman. Being eager to return to the earth, she secretly climbs down to earth by a rope
Different from (common) people inhabitants of a distant land fight with non-human enemies who periodically attack them
Birds or other creatures which not dangerous for common people attack dwarfs who live in another world

motif_title: Humans in the south, birds in the north
motif_gloss: A man gets to the country inhabited by migratory birds. They have there human guise but turn into birds going back to the north

motif_title: Man helps inhabitants of other world
motif_gloss: Inhabitants of a distant land who have different nature than (normal) human beings struggle from time to time with some non-human enemies. Man helps local dwellers because their enemies are not dangerous for the human beings
Inhabitants of a distant country suffer from periodic assaults of the enemies which are not dangerous for common people. These enemies (and sometimes the inhabitants of the country too) are birds
Birds attack the inhabitants of a distant land or a man who had got to this land
Birds use their feathers as arrows or their arrows and down stick mouth openings of them enemies

Women who possess supernatural power and usually come from a non-human world (from sky, from under the water, they are winged beings, bird- or animal-persons) take off their clothes (feather skins and the like) or part of it. After the man hides clothes, their owner has to marry him or help him

motif_title: Supernatural male hides clothes of human girl
motif_gloss: Supernatural male person (often a snake, a dragon) hides clothes of a human girl or sits on it. To return her clothes she had to become his wife

motif_title: To dance in her magic clothes
motif_gloss: Magic wife gets her wings back and flies away after she pretends that putting her real clothes she would be more beautiful, a better dancer, etc.

motif_title: Woman from sky-world marries mortal man
motif_gloss: A man gets a woman connected with the upper world (bird-maiden, sky fairy, star-woman, etc.), she becomes his wife or (rare) adopted daughter

Magic wife abandons her mortal husband when she finds her clothes (often, her feathers if she is a bird-woman), makes herself the new clothes, receives them from her kin or her husband gives her her clothing believing that she will not abandon him. (Versions with magic wife abandoning her husband because she feels herself offended is not alternative to the “found clothes but in most of the texts these motifs are not combined)
Magic wife flies away or makes attempt to fly away when her bird relatives throw down her feathers (wings)

motif_title: Woman pursues a porcupine and gets to the sky
motif_gloss: Pursuing a porcupine, woman climbs a tree and gets to the upper world

Digging roots or gathering sea food on a beach, a woman finds baby-boy. Usually her mother warns her not to dig a certain bulb or not to do it in a certain way. Breaking taboo, the woman finds or conceives baby-boy

Person gets to the sky, makes hole through the firmament digging out a root. Usually woman's husband or his kinsmen warn her against digging out a special bulb or tuber; breaking taboo, she gets to see the earth, decides to descend
Finding a hole in the ground or making it, person gets to see below another world. Usually the earth is seen from the sky

motif_title: Sky opening covered with a stone
motif_gloss: Opening in the firmament is covered with a flat stone. When person puts the stone aside, he or she gets to see the earth
An ordeal: to survive frosty night outdoors or in chamber with ice
An ordeal: to smoke a huge or poisonous pipe or to remain alive in poisonous smoke
An ordeal: to remain alive after contact with sharp points or blades
An ordeal: to remain alive in a closed room full of beasts of prey, poisonous or other dangerous creatures
An ordeal: to eat or drink much or eat or drink poisonous beverage or food

motif_title: Difficult task: to build a bridge
motif_gloss: A task-giver asks to build a bridge (usually of gold etc.) during a very short time

motif_title: Ordeal: to bathe in boiling water
motif_gloss: Person is ordered to bathe in a boiling liquid or to jump into fire but he remains unharmed. Usually the adversary attempts to repeat the trick but dies

motif_title: A task: to carve a bench
motif_gloss: A task: to carve a bench decorated with representa­tion of the head of the father(or mother)-in-law that is always concealed
A task-giver asks to sort a large amount or small particles of different kind (usually seeds of different plants) mixed in container or to count such particles or to pick up the spilled grains

motif_title: Task: to dry a body of water
motif_gloss: A task: to dry a body of water
A contest: to dive deep or for a long time

motif_title: Task: to get object from bottom of body of water
motif_gloss: A task: to get an object from the bottom of a water body
When hero dives, the antagonist covers the water surface with ice or net

motif_title: Task: to kill an animal of unusual color
motif_gloss: A task: to kill an animal of special (often unusual) color or form
Father or other kinsmen of hero's wife or bride try to kill or test him and/or suggest him difficult tasks

motif_title: Task-giver is a king or a chief
motif_gloss: Person who gives difficult tasks to the hero is a prominent figure in social hierarchy, i.e. a head of political unit of community- or higher level and not a mythical being
Not the powerful person himself but his official or adviser tries to get rid of the hero and suggests that the person should give the hero difficult tasks
A contest: ball game

motif_title: Antagonist mourns loss of his helpers
motif_gloss: The antagonist sends the hero to the place where he is attacked by dangerous creatures. The hero kills them and brings to the antagonist. The creatures are the antagonist's relatives, pets, or helpers, therefore he or she mourns their death or revives them
Antagonist asks the hero to kill or to tame a dangerous animal or not to kill certain animal during a hunt. This animal is the antagonist himself (or his daughter or wife)

motif_title: Task: to bring milk of dangerous animal
motif_gloss: A task: to bring milk of dangerous animal
To visit the world of the dead
Contest: a race
A mighty man has to wrestle or race with an old woman who proves to be very strong
A contest: to climb a pole or tree
Hero and his adversary play hide-and-seek. The hero finds his adversary but the adversary cannot find him

motif_title: One day from conception to birth
motif_gloss: A demand is brought up that a baby would be born the next day after conception or would talk immediately after the birth
A task: to hit with an arrow or a stone an animal, a bird, or object (usually placed at the top of a tree or pole)
A task: to bring objects (usually fruits) that act like people, i.e. dance, sing and the like

motif_title: Monster brought by the hero kills the task-giver
motif_gloss: Task-giver asks to bring him dangerous being or object possessed by a moster or deity. Hero fulfills the task. The beast, monster, deity or the object itself kills the task-giver

A man marries a non-human woman. In her world, she has another husband or suitor. She returns to her world, human husband follows her. He stands tests and/or fights with local inhabitants, gets his wife back

Hero receives a difficult task (usually to bring an object or creature that have no particular indications and properties) and comes across an invisible person who is a powerful and well-disposed servant to anybody who becomes his master. The hero is kind with him and the person helps him

motif_title: To steal an egg from under a bird
motif_gloss: Person is able to steal an egg (a nestling, to put it back) from under the bird (to change the bird’s feather; to steal an embryo from animal’s womb, etc.)

motif_title: The man persecuted because of his beautiful bride
motif_gloss: A powerful person coverts a beautiful bride or wife of a man and gives him impossible tasks to get rid of him

motif_title: To climb a tree with a full glass in hand
motif_gloss: Person must climb a tree (pole, rock) with a full open vessel in hand and not a drop should be spilled

motif_title: To get material for making bow and arrows
motif_gloss: Hero is sent or sets off by his own will to get two or more different materials needed for making bow and arrows (wood or reed for shafts, feathers, tendons for string, flint for points, paint to paint the shafts, gum to stick points to the shafts)

motif_title: To get a bird from a tree
motif_gloss: Hero is sent to a dangerous tree or rock to bring feathers, nestling, fruits, bark, etc.
Confrontation between the hero and his antagonist has a from of a game of chance

motif_title: Not to take a cage, a bridle
motif_gloss: Trying to steal a wonderful bird (horse), hero breaks his helper’s instruction (usually not to take anything else besides the animal or object itself) and is caught but released on condition that he brings another wonderful object. Situation is repeated and the last task is to bring a girl. Ultimately the hero gets both the girl and all the objects

motif_title: Wife gives birth to her husband’s son  while husband is absent
motif_gloss: A man who is far away from his wife visits her using magic or a wife visits her husband incognito. She gives birth to his son but people believe she was untrue to her husband. Ultimately her chastity is recognized
A man trains a cat (monkey, dog) to hold lighted candle (lamp) on its head. When a mouse (a rat) runs through the room, the cat drops the candle and chases the mouse

Person always wins a game thanks to a cat (or a mouse) who carries the lamp (or puts the light out in a certain moment). The hero releases a mouse (or correspondingly a cat), the cat runs after it and the person loses the game

motif_title: An agreement to marry the would be born children
motif_gloss: Two men agree to marry their future children if a girl and a boy will be born. The boy is poor or he loses his former status after his father’s death, the girl’s parents decide to evade the given obligation. The boy grows up and finds his bride

Being a victim of the injustice and after much suffering a young woman tells about her fate to certain inanimate objects (often it is “the stone of patience”) or her story is told by her husband. The woman is rescued and the justice restored

A married man marries another woman who is a transformed ogress/witch. Thanks to her intrigues other wives (the first wife) are blinded and/or confined in an underground hole. A son of one of them overcomes the ogress, returns sight to his mother and her sisters

motif_title: Father or uncle is rival and enemy
motif_gloss: Maternal uncle or father (or grandfather if he replaces father who is not mentioned) of the young man is his rival or enemy and tries to kill him
Hero demonstrates his supernatural abilities remaining alive in a burning hot chamber, stove, bonfire, among burning vegetation
Hero is asked to climb into a hole or pit. When he does it, they fill it with soil or throw down a post, a stone, etc. The hero demonstrates his magic capacities coming back uninjured

motif_title: Brings tree that was fallen on him
motif_gloss: To kill a strong man, others fell a tree and hope that the man will be crashed when it falls on him, or they tie him to a tree. The man remains unharmed and brings the tree home
When water in a spring is replaced with alcohol, a big animal becomes drunk and is caught
Flying person or creature abducts a woman but is ultimately killed or the woman escapes from him
Wife of a chief abandons him with vultures (usually by her own will being untrue to her husband). The chief (Witoto: her own brother) brings her back
Person makes a sea mammal or fish of wood, it carries another person or persons into the open sea or kills him or them
An ugly, old, lazy, etc. woman or a male trickster comes to man under disguise of his wife, bride or (more rare) sister who is driven out, confined to the underworld, killed, etc.

motif_title: Husband goes away for a moment
motif_gloss: Man travels with his wife. The imposter replaces her when her husband goes away for a short time

motif_title: Mother substitutes daughterMother takes the appearance of her daughter to replace her

motif_gloss: When the imposter takes place of the real wife, the latter turns into owl

A girl (rare: boy) is walking to her or his relations or to her bridegroom. On the way the imposter lures her (him) to exchange clothes and takes her (his) place while the real girl (boy) is sent to look after crops or domestic animals. People hear her (his) song in which all the story is told. The deception is disclosed, the imposter killed

motif_title: Ones of gold, of silver, of wood
motif_gloss: Negative person or place is contrasted with one or two positive ones as wood with silver and gold
An evil spirit abandons a girl or a young woman in a tree or islet. She takes care for a nestling of bird of prey, he grows big, rescues her
To punish an antagonist, he or she is tied to a horse (camel, bull) or to several horses (camels, etc.) who torn him or her apart
To punish an antagonist, he or she is buried alive

motif_title: Two sitters at the bed of a sleeping prince
motif_gloss: A girl finds a body of a sleeping youth who will wake up at a certain time and marry  the girl who would sit nearby. Usually at the last moment the girl goes away for a time and the impostor takes her place.

A young woman is transformed into an animal, pushed into the water, into the underworld or she herself has to plunge into water. She is not dead, answers a call, comes out to nurse her baby, to help her children. In most cases her husband discovers her, brings her back to earth or helps her to acquire her human form

Siblings (most often younger brother and elder sister) leave their home. One of them (most often the brother, most rare several brothers) turn into animal (usually an ungulate) or (rare) a bird but (in the most cases) ultimately acquires his or her human form again
Pregnant woman is thrown into a well (pond, hole, etc.) where she gives birth to a son (children). She and her children brought alive

A girl goes with her friends to a river, into a forest, etc. Other girls return home but the heroine has to remain or to go back to the forest, etc. She has a narrow escape from a dangerous creature. marries a supernatural being or a chief, or dies but is avenged
Young man gets a girl who is inside a fruit or a flower
A man discovers that a beautiful girl hides herself under a guise of an ugly and dirty servant, under a skin of an animal or in an object that is brought into his house
Babies disappear but are ultimately returned to their mother or father grown up and in good health

motif_title: Basin of honey and basin of oil
motif_gloss: Person promises to fill one basin (fountain, dry river-bed, etc.) with honey and another with oil (milk, etc.) if his wish would be granted. He fulfills the promise either really or formally (honey etc. from broken containers is spilled on earth)
One who eats certain fruit (leave, etc.) gets horns (long nose, etc.) or turns into an animal. After eating another fruit (leave) person recovers his or her normal body

motif_title: The cat, the dog and the magic object
motif_gloss: A man obtains an object that fulfills desires. The object is stolen but brought back by the animals which had been formerly saved by the man
Person kills others inviting them to sit on a swing and launching them into water, on rocks, etc.
Imposter takes appearance of the hero to take his position and/or to marry or to violate a woman

Person who is an excellent food provider or warrior agrees to let the others material proves of his exploits (the killed game, etc.) for the right to brand them or injure their bodies in a certain way or to take from them objects that they should not give off

Hero gives his rivals the food provided by him by order of the king but the king finds this food poisonous, useless or tasteless while the food presented by the hero is excellent even if it looks not so good
An ogre (a dragon) kills everybody who comes to him. The hero is not killed but receives a reward because he greeted the ogre and/or gave a correct answer to his question

motif_title: Герой (героиня) временно превращен(а) в животное (обычно в собаку/койота или в осла и т.д.). Обычно когда ему или ей помогают вернуть прежний облик, в животное превращен антагонист. В части текстов метаморфозу испытывает либо только герой, либо только антагонист
motif_gloss: Bewitched into animal

motif_title: To recognize his own among several identical ones
motif_gloss: To return or to get his or her son, wife, husband, domestic animal or (rare) object, person must recognize her, him or it among several identical persons, animals or objects
Person must recognize her (or his) son or husband among several identical persons or (if the son or husband is temporarily transformed) animals

motif_title: To recognize an object or an animal
motif_gloss: Person must recognize a particular object or animal among several similar objects or animals
Person does good to nestlings of a powerful bird, the grateful mother bird helps him

Getting to the underworld, hero should take a white ram (horse) which would carry him back to earth. By chance, he takes the black one which carries him even deeper to the lower level of the underworld
A serpent or water monster regularly devours or injures children of powerful being (almost always: nestlings of giant bird). The bird has no power over the serpent but hero kills the monster

motif_title: Bird steals colts, hero kills the serpent
motif_gloss: Every time when a horse gives birth to wonderful colts, they are stolen by a giant bird. A hero goes to get the colts and kills a serpent that regularly devours nestlings of the giant bird

motif_title: Birds carries hero to its place, hero kills the monster
motif_gloss: Bird carries a man to its place where he kills a monster who regularly devoured the nestlings

motif_title: Bird carries hero to his destination
motif_gloss: Hero helps a powerful bird (usually does good to her nestlings), grateful bird carries him to the place where he is eager to get or tells to do it one of her nestlings
A monster blocks sources of water and usually gives some in exchange for human victims or valuables. Hero kills the monster

motif_title: Of copper, of silver, of gold
motif_gloss: Loci or objects of three (rare – four) different materials are mentioned in such a way that all of them have positive connotations though unequal value (copper, silver and gold; silver, gold and diamonds, etc.)
Person travels across a forest with trees of two or more kinds of metal (copper, silver, etc.)
Coming back from the underworld, abducted princess puts objects that she used there (clothes, house, “kingdom”) into a small container (an egg, a ball, etc.) and brings them with her

motif_title: Man feeds his own flesh to his animal helper
motif_gloss: Person has to feed powerful creature (usually a giant bird) giving it regularly pieces of meat. When meat supply is exhausted, he cuts off a piece of his own flesh
Hero sees two persons or creatures one of which laughs and another cries. The one who cries will be eaten by monster today and the one who laughs he will be eaten tomorrow. The hero kills the monster
Thunder or giant bird fights against a reptile, big water animal or other big and strong creature who lives in water or under the earth
Bird-woman is energetically searching a man whom she likes, takes him by force for her husband. Turning into a monster, she kills men but is ultimately destroyed
People abandon a boy, a girl, brother and sister, a group of children, or a young family without fire and food. A compassionate person conceals hot coals for the outlaws in the abandoned camp

People abandon a boy, a girl, brother and sister, a group of children, or a young family without fire and food. The outlaws demonstrate supernatural powers or protectors providing food and lodging. While the abandoned persons have plenty of food other people starve. A person (often a bird like crow, magpie, sea-gull, etc.) visits the abandoned ones and brings from them some food home. This way people get to know that the abandoned ones prosper
Abandoned children are tied to a tree. Helpful dog or other animal unfastens them
Spirit or animal person steals a boy, tells him that she or he is his real mother or father. The boy gets to know the truth, leaves the false parent
An amphibian (frog, toad, rare newt) steals or finds a boy, lies him that she is his real mother
A man throws a woman into the water. She tries to snatch at something, he cuts her fingers off. Usually the woman or/and the cut off fingers turn into water creatures

motif_title: Woman throws herself into the ocean
motif_gloss: Giving way to a burst of horror or shame, woman or girl runs to the ocean, throws herself into the water or remains on the beach. Her husband or suitor pursues but cannot catch her
A woman takes a dog paramour, marries him, gives birth to his children. The puppies turn into human children and usually become ancestors of some groups of people
A girl marries a handsome man whom she had first seen in guise of a dog
A woman marries a dog, gives birth to the ancestors of present dogs who are people's helpers and friends
A girl marries a dog because only the dog fulfilled the condition of marriage put by the girl's father
Hero has or obtains an unusual bird. An imposter steals it, takes the hero’s place but the bird is mute or cries differently. The hero returns, his bird sings again
Alive birds and beasts decorate hero's costume and headgear. Imposter steals hero's attire, takes his place but the birds and beasts are mute or cry differently

motif_title: Dead mother returns to nurse her baby
motif_gloss: Dead or driven away woman returns to the human world to her baby that needs mother's care
A man disguised as a woman comes to his enemy and kills him at night (usually cuts off and carries away his head)
A Man disappears or goes away for long time. His wife sets off, comes to a house where her husband lives now or first sends her son there. She gets to know that he has married another woman
The abandoned wife comes to the new one when the husband is not at home. She kills her rival pushing her head into boiling liquid or pouring it into her ear

When a woman or a lad comes to the sea bank, she or he is carried away by sea predators (killer-whales, sharks, swordfish). Man descends to the bottom and rescues the woman or lad using his shaman's power
A man descends to the bottom of the sea to rescue his wife. He makes arrangements with a slave who pours water on fireplace producing steam. Hidden behind the steam, the man escapes with his wife
A man comes to the non-human beings to get a woman. He secures the help of a slave repairing his adze or axe
Person temporarily turns into a bird or an animal putting on corresponding skin or animal skins are amulets that become alive and help the person
A man meets a dangerous giant (or serpent) who proves to be friendly to him. When another giant fights with the first one, the man helps his friend
A man and a friendly giant live together. The friendly giant fights with another one and asks the man for help. This help proves to be crucial because the man badly injures a foot of another giant

A powerful supernatural wants to check if his guest made love with his wife or daughter. The person is impotent or (successfully pretends to be) chaste and is rewarded or at least gets no harm. Usually the same episodes repeats with another person who is dissolute or unable to control himself. This person is punished

A girl or a woman meets powerful person, behaves herself in a right way and is successful. Another (or two others) behaves in a wrong way and suffers a reverse (is punished or not rewarded). Rare: the protagonists are a stepchild and a family child of different sex

motif_title: The unworthy girl fails, the worthy one succeeds
motif_gloss: Two or three sisters are sent in succession to powerful person. The first or the first and the second sister behave in a wrong way, perish or do not succeed. The last one behaves correctly, gets a reward
Two or three girls in succession become brides of the dog. The first one or two act in a wrong way, perish or do not succeed. The last one behaves correctly, gets a reward

motif_title: Mother-in-law helps the girl to fulfill a task
motif_gloss: Coming to powerful man, a girl must make work that she is unable to do. His mother makes the work for her, and she marries the man

motif_title: If asked to do in a bad way, do otherwise
motif_gloss: Person (usually a girl) gets to the powerful person (usually an old woman) who asks her to act in a strange and harsh way (to put room in disorder, to bring unclean water, and the like). The person does not according to order but in a rationale and polite way and is recompensed. Another person acts according to the direct sense of the words and is punished

motif_title: Not to fix laces on clothes and shoes
motif_gloss: Though laces on her clothes or shoes get loose, a girl on her way to the powerful persons or back should not tie them up
When the kind girl returns home, a dog barks saying that everything is well with her and when the unkind girl returns (or her dead body is brought home), the dog barks that everything is bad

motif_title: Old woman becomes a young beauty
motif_gloss: An old or ugly woman is transformed into a young beauty. Usually another old woman tries to imitate her but dies or suffers a reverse
On the way to the non-human world objects ask a child to taste certain food or to fulfill some work. The child does what was asked and is rewarded
In the winter time a girl (rare: a boy) is sent to bring something that is available only in summer. She brings it
A girl marries an animal or brings an animal to her home that turns into a handsome man. Her sister or friend tries to do the same but perishes or suffers a reverse

motif_title: Kind girl returns with a handsome man
motif_gloss: One girl goes to the other world, acts correctly and brings back an animal or a box with a handsome man inside. Another girl acts wrongly and suffers a reverse

motif_title: The worthy man is rewarded, the unworthy punished
motif_gloss: First one, then another man meets a powerful person or persons. The first man is worthy and rewarded with treasure, prestige or the like. The second man (or two men) follows him, behaves in a wrong way and is punished

A man loses an axe. A spirit or a powerful official suggests him a golden axe but the man does not accept it. The spirit (official) gives him axes of gold and silver as a reward for his honesty. Usually another man intentionally loses his axe, claims the golden one but receives nothing
A man cures injured bird, it brings him a seed from which something valuable grows. Another man intentionally injures and then cures a bird, kit brings him a seed from which something harmful grows

Two men have a similar defect (a hump, a lump). One spends a night in a place where spirits free him from his defect. Another comes to the same place but spirits double his defect giving him what they had taken off from the first man

A man divides a cooked chicken (goose) according to social ranks of the people (e.g. head of the household gets chicken’s head, his daughters get wings, etc.), takes himself not prestige but meaty parts and is rewarded. Another man brings several chickens but is unable to divide them in a proper way. The first man is called again, divides chickens with ingenuity and is rewarded again

A girl who conceals her beauty and/or is poor and oppressed by her stepmother puts on a splendid attire and comes incognito to a feast where a man of high status falls in love with her. He marries her after identifying her by an object given to her or lost by her or (rare) seeing how she changes her clothes

motif_title: Construction of watercourse: a tragic love
motif_gloss: Person builds a watercourse as a condition of marriage. When the work is fulfilled, the woman breaks her promise. She or her bridegroom usually die
Person brings water or a river with fish to the place where a girl agrees to marry him and does not do it if the girl is unwilling
One man puts another into a box, closes the lid (or ties him to a board, to canoe, etc.) and puts the box adrift. It floats to another land, man is released there, returns home, revenges on his enemy
Person lets be firmly tied up when another one say that it's only a joke (e.g. a test to see can the first one break bonds)
Person is lured into a trap being invited to lie in a box or a hole to measure it. Being unable to liberate himself from the box etc., the person remains in power of his enemies

motif_title: Touchy with king, patient with stableman
motif_gloss: King’s wife is extremely touchy and cannot suffer a slightest pain. She does not say a word, however, when her lover who is a servant or a demon is beating her

To get know the precise number of certain units, to select certain object among many others, to get know a name of particular person or a reason of particular phenomenon, person tries to surprise the possessor of the knowledge who becomes to speak aloud and unintentionally names the corresponding number, specifies the object, etc.
Person is eager to get know names of several strangers. He hides himself and creates situations when the strangers call each other by name

A demon suggests to fulfill a difficult work if the person tells him his name after the work is done. At the last moment the person gets know the name by chance, the demon disappears and the person rewarded for being such a good worker. Or the demon comes to take a child but agrees to give it back if the parents guess his (the demon's) name

Young woman’s bridegroom or husband gets to believe that she is extraordinarily industrious. To conceal the deception, she herself or somebody else makes the man believe that because of hard work women become ugly or change into animals. The man prohibits his wife to work anymore

motif_title: Woman rewarded for making a person laugh
motif_gloss: When a powerful (supernatural) person gets to see a woman in a ridiculous situation, he or she becomes to laugh (and thus cured from his disease). The woman is rewarded, saved from a danger
The war between animals and birds begins because a mouse (rat, mole, etc.) and a small bird cannot divide supplies for winter
A man gets to a country which inhabitants hunts of fish people whom they consider wild and equivalent to the real game or fish
Person gets into dwelling of master of animals or monstrous shepherd. The host can kill him. The hero escapes sticking to hair of one of the animals who are going out
Person blinds sleeping ogre and escapes from him
Hero's adversary provokes him to touch an object that proves to be sticky. The hero sticks to it, sometimes has to cut off his finger
Being thrown out, put into certain places, born by primeval couple some beings turn into spirits of particular loci
Being thrown down (usually from the sky), some beings get to different places and turn into spirits or animals with particular functions and names

Spirits or unpleasant animals (reptiles, worms, etc.) are (often: concealed from the eyes of God or deformed) children or miscarriages of the same human couple or the same primeval ancestor who produced first human beings
A woman gives birth to many children but conceals part of them (rare: all) from God. The concealed children become poor people or non-human beings

motif_title: Separating the rich from the poor
motif_gloss: A woman gives birth to many children but conceals part of them from God. The concealed children become ancestors of the people of the lower social status while those that had been shown to God become ancestors of the high status people

motif_title: Wrong marriage ritual and the birth of spirits
motif_gloss: The primeval couple is married. First wife has miscarriages or gives birth to spirits, worms or other unpleasant animals. Later, usually after the proper marriage ceremony is organized, she becomes to give birth to real human beings or gods
Several companions have extraordinary abilities (one who runs fast, one who eats great quantities, one who produces or can withstand severe frost, etc.)

Two men spend a night in a forest, take their moccasins or clothes off usually to dry them near the fire. One plans to burn the moccasins or the clothes of another at night. The latter imperceptible interchange their things and the first man burns his own property
A socially weak man is a nuisance for stronger persons. He gets to know that they plan to drown him and tricks them to drown instead one of them or their own property

Person of a low social position (who has no supernatural abilities) agrees to a contest with a person of high social position (or with an ogre, etc.)that whoever becomes angry first must suffer a severe punishment. The weaker person abuses the stronger one until the latter erupts in anger.
A weak man abused by a strong one (often his son-in-law) brings home a clot of animal’s blood, from which a child is born. The blood-clot boy avenges the old man

A group of persons decide to go to the end of the world to meet the Sun or other supreme god. One (or several) of them perish on their way, some reach destination, at least one returns home using the shorter way than the one they have took before

motif_title: Two wives: the woman and the frog
motif_gloss: One brother takes a girl, another a frog or toad for a wife, both bring them to their parents, or one man takes two wives, a woman and a frog. Both wives are suggested to pass a test. The girl’s behavior is approved, the frog’s poor qualities are revealed

motif_title: Coyote first betrays and then saves his brother
motif_gloss: Coyote's brother is victorious against numerous enemies as far as Coyote does not break some taboo. Enemies kill the brother. Coyote gets his remains, escapes, revives him

Powerful person listens in conversation of three or two women. Each one say what she would do if the person marries her. One promises to bear his son who would have wonderful qualities (or a son and a daughter), two others promise to practice some work or marry other people
A young woman promises to bear a wonderful child. In her husband's absence other people (co-wives, mother-in-law, etc.) try to kill the mother and/or the child, usually slandering her
Rivals of the beloved wife hide or throw away her baby and substitute it with an animal (usually with a pup) or object
Rivals of the beloved wife hide or throw away her baby and substitute it with a broom, stone or other inanimate object
A woman who was falsely accused of killing her new-born child or giving birth to pups and the like is punished in such a way that she must suffer from filth and be taunted by passers by

motif_title: Bird carries baby-girl to its nest
motif_gloss: A bird carries away a baby-girl, brings her up in its nest, the baby becomes a beautiful girl

motif_title: A younger daughter instead of a son
motif_gloss: A man who has only daughters needs a son to fulfill the task fit for men (usually to send a son to a prince who needs a soldier). His daughters in succession disguises themselves as men. The elder are scared by dangers and come back but the younger resolves the task. (In Balkan and Caucasus tales the father meets daughters disguised as a robber or a predator animal). See motif F70E

motif_title: Hero, his companions and a dwarf
motif_gloss: The hero and his companion or companions live together. Every morning one stays at home while another or others go to hunt, etc. A demonic person comes, eats up all the food and beats the cook. Or the man who remained at home comes to the demon himself in search of fire and is maltreated by him. The hero kills or neutralizes the demon

motif_title: Demon claims food and is wounded
motif_gloss: A demonic person comes to the hero and claims food that the latter possesses or cooks. The hero overcomes and wounds him, follows his trace and comes to his world

motif_title: Bridegroom of the youngest daughter (The loathsome bridegroom)
motif_gloss: A girl (usually the youngest of several sisters) does not reject but marries a poor, sick, dirty, old, too young, non-human, etc. man who later demonstrates his supernatural qualities

motif_title: Thrown apple hits the chosen one
motif_gloss: Boy or girl selects one person among many throwing an object (usually an apple) into him or her. This way a girl makes a choice of a husband, a young man of a bride, a boy identifies his father

A boy or (rare) a girl born in family or found by his adoptive parents has strange guise (ball of meat, nut, bag, half of a man, an animal). He or she possesses magic power and usually marries a princess (a prince)
An (adoptive) son is a frog. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.
An (adoptive) son is a snake. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.
An (adoptive) son is a gourd. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.
An (adoptive) son is a hedgehog. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.
An (adoptive) son is a pig. He marries a princess, turns into handsome man.

motif_title: Small objects and animals defeat the ogre
motif_gloss: Small objects and animals (rare: animals alone but including harmless and passive ones, e.g. on the dry land fishes) revenge on a powerful enemy making attack on him in succession (usually they hide in his or her house); the enemy is badly injured, runs away or dies
