Domestic animals get to a place where they meet predators. They frighten them making them to escape
A predator animal asks a goat (a ram, etc.) about a purpose of certain parts of his body. The goat describes every part as a weapon able to injure his opponent or the goat really possesses weapons

motif_title: Ones who hide in a house frighten dangerous enemy
motif_gloss: Objects and/or domestic animals live in a house. When dangerous enemy comes, they attack him, he dies or escapes (all texts with K77A and K77B included)

An ogre (an ogress) swallows people, is killed but the people are not found in his or her belly or are found dead. Only when the ogre's finger is cut off, the hero finds a remedy to revive the people or the swallowed up (the swallowed hero himself) come out alive from the finger of the ogre

motif_title: Snake serves an example of resuscitation
motif_gloss: Person in a desperate situation gets to see how a snake or other small animal uses remedy to revive or to cure itself or other animals. The person uses the remedy, succeeds

Person turns into different objects which another person tries to destroy. Every time a particle of an object remains and undergoes a new metamorphosis. In most case an imposter replaces the true wife or bride and attempts to destroy her but her vital essence passes to different plants and objects. Ultimately the woman acquires her human image again

An object or a creature that emerged from remains, decorations, etc. of a killed person tells about his or her fate. Usually a reed grows from the person's grave and a pipe made from the reed tells the story

motif_title: Killed by the stepmother, eaten up by the father,
motif_gloss: The (step)mother kills or orders to kill her small (step)son, eats him or feeds his flesh to her husband. The son revives, usually in the form of a bird who tells about the crime.

Person becomes a victim of a murder. Just before dying he or she calls on some birds (animals, celestial bodies, etc.) to bear witness for the crime. Getting to see these birds (the animal, the Moon, etc.) the murderer reveals himself without thinking. Or the birds, being the only witnesses, bring the investigators to the murderers
Person is bewitched (transformed into a bird, faints) when a pin or other sharp object is stuck into her (rare his) body

For minor offence or because of a false accusation a man maims (rare: kills) a girl or young woman and drives her out of his house or (rare) the girl maims herself. The maimed person magically obtains her body integrity (the dead revives) and is happily married
Wife of a man or wives of a group of brothers envy his (their) sister and tries (try) to destroy her

motif_title: The sons on a quest for a wonderful remedy for their father
motif_gloss: To cure his father (father-in-law, sister) or to make him young again hero must bring a remedy from a distant country. He fulfills the task, the sick person is cured (becomes young)
Several sisters marry different animals or demons. Usually their husbands help their brother
An antagonist possesses a horse which can overtake any other. Hero obtains the brother (sister) of this horse who is the only one to win the race with the antagonist's horse
Because a small child is ignored or punished by its parents (usually it cries late in the evening), bush spirit or animal carries it away
A forest woman receives or steals a small boy and brings him up to make him her paramour
Gathering berries a woman steps into bear's dung and curses bears. A bear abducts her and marries her. Her human husband, her brothers, or supernatural person kill the bears
For minor compensation or because of deceit person lets another one to make him blind

motif_title: A girl and a witch: presents of kinsfolk
motif_gloss: A girl and a witch marry two brothers. Both daughters-in-law have to bring presents from their kinsfolk. The girl finds her brother, brothers or sister whose disappearance was described in the beginning of the tale and receives treasure. Presents brought by the witch worth nothing

motif_title: In search of the place to abandon the sister
motif_gloss: A girl with her maimed sister or brother escapes from a danger. The sister (brother) rejects some places where the girl wants to abandon her or him but agrees with her last suggestion

A girl becomes separated with her brothers (or brother) who die, remain in a tree, on a hill, ascend to the sky, etc. After being happily married, the girl once again meets her brothers who have acquired a non-human nature

motif_title: Helpful brother is married to bear
motif_gloss: A girl parts with her brother or sister who marries a bear and helps the girl

motif_title: The black and the red ones
motif_gloss: A man gets to see two fighting monsters or animals of contrasted colors (red and black, black and white). He helps one of them and/or one of them helps him

motif_title: Stag antlers stuck in serpent’s throat
motif_gloss: Antlers of a stag or tusks of an elephant who a serpent tries to swallow are stuck in its throat

Hero's dogs or horse or (rare) he himself fight with his adversary in the underworld (under the water). Those who are waiting for the outcome of the combat understand who overcomes whom by the color of water or foam that rises to the surface

A man puts his children questions that seem easy to answer (how they love him, who is the elder in the family, etc.). The elder children flatter, the youngest daughter (rare: son) is reserved and her father drives her away or deprives of inheritance. Later her noble nature becomes evident to him

motif_title: The princess responsible for her own fortune
motif_gloss: A girl driven away from home or married to a poor man become prosperous

A girl answers her father (rare: brother) that she loves him like she loves salt (or that salt is the most valuable, etc.). He becomes angry (usually drives her away) but later satisfies himself that she was right
A twin brother or the best friend follows hero's trace and spends a night in his wife's house but rejects to have sex with her
Sleeping in one bed with a woman, man puts a sharp or thorny object between them as a sign of chastity
Person eats magic bird, fish, small animal, or fruit and becomes prosperous and powerful
Two persons (usually two lovers) are buried in one grave or not far from each other. Two plants which grow on this place interweave or smoke of two funeral pyres is merged
Many brothers marry or have to marry in such a way that all their wives are (were) sisters

motif_title: Now you are grieved as I was
motif_gloss: A man is going to kill but spares a giant bird. Later when the bird carries him high in the air he pretends to drop him or to abandon him on a rock. This way the bird wants him to feel the same terror that he felt when the man was going to kill him. Or it is the bird that first drops and picks up a man who later makes the bird feel a similar terror
An animal or (rare) a person that gave birth to the hero or supported him for a long time asks his master to kill him. Its remains turn into a house with a household where the hero can live

A young man or (rare) a girl has a (day-)dream that predicts his or (rare) her future triumph. The dreamer either conceals or reports its contest to his family and in both cases is punished for too high opinion of himself. In the beginning the dreamer sometimes sells his dream to another young man, who becomes the protagonist of the tale. Adventures that follow explain the contest of the dream. The youth becomes rich and happy (e.g. marries heiresses of two kingdoms, that in the dream were symbolized by two suns or a sun and a moon), the girl marries king's son

motif_title: Father will be attending to his son
motif_gloss: A man is told that he will be attending to his son or daughter. He drives his son (daughter) away but the prophecy is fulfilled
At night a girl’s lover has to carry her away but falls asleep or is late. She is carried away by another man who happened to be on the place

A man gets to know about dangers that threaten his master or his friend of a higher status. He helps his master (friend) to escape the dangers though his own behavior seems strange or hostile. Facing an alternative to be executed or to turn into stone because of revealing the secret, the helper opts for the second. In many cases the master’s child has to be sacrificed to turn the statue back into the man

A young man lets free a fish or an animal that was caught or he or his father renders a help to somebody. When the young man sets off for a journey, the grateful creature or person in guise of a stranger becomes his companion and protector

A young man helps to bury a man and / or pays the debts of the dead man lets free a fish or an animal that was caught or he or his father renders a help to somebody. When the young man sets off for a journey, the grateful creature or person in guise of a stranger becomes his companion and protector

Person (usually a young woman) does not know that a snake lives inside her or him and makes her or him ill or dangerous for other people. {Motif K100C is pretty similar to F9f1 but F9f1 links to a cluster of etiological/cosmological motifs related to the idea of a dangerous woman while K100c is related to adventures}
Helpful animal (horse, lion, etc.) asks the hero to kill him and becomes a prince who was this way disenchanted
Stories become harmful because they think that a certain person does not treat them in a correct way
Every morning girl' or (rare) boy’s clothes are in disorder, the boy looks very tied. People spy on her (or on him) and discover that she or he spends nights in the non-human world

motif_title: Demonic paramour of mother or sister
motif_gloss: A woman who initially is a friend of the hero (his sister or mother) tries to kill him when she becomes allied to a demon whom the hero overcame or (rare) a man who tries to get rid of the hero
A man tells his son to kill his sister, mother, or wife. The young man does not fulfill the order but later regrets about it

motif_title: To ride for the last time
motif_gloss: A boy or a girl asks permission to ride for the last time his or her favorite animal; then he or she rides away saving his or her life
Cow (ox, bull) helps an orphan child or a young woman who got into trouble
The youngest of several brothers remains at home, wounds a red swan or duck, goes away following the bird's trace
A despised wife gives birth to wonderful human children, other wives give birth to animals
To get rid of a baby child or of the magic cock, they throw him into enclosure for animals, but cows or other animals do not trample the child or cock down
A woman is abandoned by her magic husband. She finds him and becomes his wife again

motif_title: Iron shoes to be worn out
motif_gloss: Wandering to the purpose of her or his travel person has to worn out her or his iron shoes or staff

motif_title: A revived wife betrays her husband
motif_gloss: Wife dies, husband revives her, she abandons him for another man and is punished

A man is advised to ask for his service rendered to a powerful being a puppy or a small object (a beaker). The puppy or object turns into beautiful girl who is a daughter of a deity. Other person makes attempts to take the woman away
Person must get a treasure from the bottom of water body. He understands that what he sees is a reflection in water while the treasure is high in a tree

motif_title: Animal suitors rejected, a man from the sky accepted
motif_gloss: Mother of a girl rejects in succession birds (and animals) who come to ask her daughter in marriage, but accepts a man from the sky (the Sun) as her son-in-law
A poor man condemns the Sun and other supernatural personages responsible for weather, wild animals, etc. that because of them he lost his property. He finds them and punishes them

Several young men (usually three brothers) find wives (usually shooting arrows or throwing objects on the off-chance). The wife of the youngest initially is ugly or non-human (a frog, a snake) but proves to be beautiful enchantress. She and her husband triumph

motif_title: To take wife where arrow falls
motif_gloss: A young man shoots an arrow or throws an object on the off-chance to take bride where the object falls

motif_title: Brothers leave home after their sister is born
motif_gloss: Several brothers leave home immediately after their mother gives birth to a girl. Usually they do not want to have another brother and hope that this time a girl will be born but chance or by evil intent a signal is given that not a girl but a boy is born again. The brothers are disappointed and leave, the girl grows up and travels in search of them

A man escapes from his (her, theirs) pursuers and hides in a cave. A spider spins its web over the hiding place. When the pursuers see the spider web they think the cave is unoccupied and do not enter it
A woman never laughs. To make her laugh a man commits something that ruins him
A man promises a reward to another man who would be able to make laugh or talk his daughter or mother
Master of the house allows person to enter all rooms besides one. The person breaks prohibition and the master gets to know about it
An animal intends to help a poor man to become rich, gets for him a bride, makes other people believe that the groom is rich. The man becomes prosperous indeed
An animal makes a poor man rich, gets for him a bride. Then the man becomes prosperous, he rejects his helper
A man is going to marry his daughter or sister (often puts certain condition on his future marriage, only his daughter or sister complies with them). The girl gets to escape

In order to delay a wedding with an undesirable suitor (her own brother or father, a monster), a girl asks him to give her a dress (often three dresses in succession) of unusual material (like gold, of fly wings, etc.). He does it but the girl runs away

It is written at a crossroad that following one of the paths person will safely return and following another it will not return (there is often a third path following which person either returns or not). Hero follows the dangerous path

motif_title: Queen of other world comes to identify hero
motif_gloss: Hero gets to the powerful woman who lives in another world, then returns to the world of humans. Imposter claims hero's deeds for himself. The powerful woman comes and finds the real hero, usually punishes the imposter
A youth or (rare) girl offends an elder woman (often breaks her pot). She makes him or her to be overcome by desire to undertake something dangerous (usually to get a particular marriage partner)
An animal killed by a hunter revives. The animal itself or somebody else tells the hunter that there was a greater wonder with such and such a person. The story follows

An enemy asks house utensils or personal objects where their master hid himself or herself or what direction he or she ran away. One of the objects, not treated by the master in a proper way, betrays him or her

motif_title: Wolf pays for the eaten up horse
motif_gloss: A wolf eats up hero's horse but gives him a fare compensation (usually provides a wife)
A girl has many (more than three) brothers, they turn into birds or ungulate animals (rare: they are killed by magic), ultimately become human again
A girl or young woman is bewitched to be mute or must keep silence for a period of time. Just when she has to be put to death, the period of her muteness is over and she is saved

motif_title: Grazing animals to be preserved by a herdsman
motif_gloss: A man had to graze animals or birds. If at least one is lost, the master would kill (not reward) him
Because of the female antagonist, a girl faints and is taken for dead but her body is not decomposed. A valuable marriage partner breaks the charms, she revives
A woman asks if she is the most beautiful among female folk and always receives a positive answer. She tries to get rid of her rival when the answer becomes a negative one

A man on a journey meets tree or two persons who are quarreling over the division of magic objects (a flying carpet, seven mile boots, etc.). The man promises to render a judgment, but he  asks first to try our the objects or suggests the owners to run a race and uses opportunity to escape with the objects

motif_title: Hero settles an argument of animals
motif_gloss: Several animals (often a lion, an eagle, an ant) argue because of an animal carcass or a living place. A man settles their argument, they give him capacity to acquire their form (their qualities)
Person of a small size (often a chicken) overcomes powerful adversary despite all attempts to destroy him thanks to objects and animals met on the way and preserved in his bag or inside his body
Husband (rare: wife) sends his cock to earn money and the cock brings it. Wife (husband) sends her hen (cat, her half of a cock, etc.) and it brings filth
Every morning a horse is exhausted because animals or demonic creatures ride it at night
To accuse a guest of theft, a host plants a treasure into his guest’s bag
A weak and timid man or boy overcomes accidentally powerful enemies and gets high esteem
A lad becomes a master and a leader of great amount of cattle (cows or buffaloes). A princess finds his hair fallen into a river, the lad and his cattle are called to the king

motif_title: Hair picked up from a river
motif_gloss: Person finds a hair that was carried by water and decides to marry its owner
Person finds precious stones (usually in a river) and gets to know their source
Every time when a demonic person goes away he kills or puts asleep a woman reviving her when he comes back

motif_title: Sister tricks women to come and revive her brother
motif_gloss: When her brother is killed, a girl puts on his clothes and in a guise of a man wins competitions and gets women who are able to revive the dead. She puts the clothes back on her brother and the women come and revive him taking him for their husband. Or a sister is killed and her brother after winning wives tricks them to revive her

motif_title: Exchange of bodies (king and his minister)
motif_gloss: Person gets an ability to enter a dead body and revive it. His own body remains dead for this time. Another person takes it for himself while the first one remains in an animal’s body
Servant is roasting meat for his master but is so impressed with a girl’s beauty, that the meat gets burnt. The master comes himself and decides to marry the girl
Travelling with his sibling, a youth regularly kills those who help him and save him creating for himself ever more problems
Every one of three supernatural sisters makes harm to people. Hero overcomes them and usually marries them
Person kills several people. asks somebody to bury only one and then tells that the dead man has returned. The grave-digger buries several people but believes that it was one and the same corpse
Protagonist of the story is a bird-catcher or a son of a bird-catcher

motif_title: The predestined death because of an animal
motif_gloss: A certain animal or (rare) man is predicted to become a cause of death of a certain person. When this animal (man) is already dead himself or itself or is faraway, its (his) remains or image becomes the cause of the person’s death

A young woman turns into monstrous bear. She kills most of the people besides her younger sister (Ojibwa: younger sister of her former husband). Their brothers return from a hunt, kill the bear or she dies pursuing them

A young woman turns into monstrous bear. She kills most of the people besides her younger sister (Ojibwa: younger sister of her former husband). Their brothers return from a hunt, kill the bear or she dies pursuing them
To escape from a demonic person, a group of men who are relations of a girl ascend to the sky and remain there
Pursued by a demon, persons hide their younger brother or sister or children in a pit under the hearth
A were-jaguar kills most of the people but is killed itself thanks to a woman who remained alive
A monstrous bird is created from small amount of the flesh of a human being or animal (usually a heart) or from manioc starch
A young woman turns into monster and kills her brothers avenging the death of her husband or lover
A demon takes appearance of a man and comes to his wife or (rare) to other woman. The woman (alone or with her child) runs away and/or kills the monster (herself or with somebody's help)
A woman remains alone and calls for somebody who could help her with her housework. A demon comes, kills the woman or her child

A cannibal, demon marries girls in succession and kills them or kills in succession his sons-in-law. The last of potential victims survives, usually after finding remains of those who were killed before
A monstrous head pursues luminaries, people or sticks to person's body
Rolling head suffers thirst

motif_title: Wife’s headless body pursues her husband
motif_gloss: The beheaded woman pursues her husband while her head pursues her children
A bodiless head, face, or skull is a woman's husband, suitor or son. He is not dangerous but a good provider, saves people from hunger, etc.

motif_title: Elder sister’s head rolls after her younger sister
motif_gloss: Only head remains from a girl. It rolls after her younger sister or sisters or they take it with them. Ultimately the head finds a place to stop

motif_title: Person stuck in an opening, head is torn off
motif_gloss: Two sisters or two brothers get into demon's house. One crawls out through a tiny opening, another sticks there. Brother or sister pulls him or her by the head but tears it off
A demonic being demands that a person would carry it permanently, clings to his shoulder or back
Person that looks weak and feeble asks a man to carry him or her on his back and refuses to leave him
Instead of chasing a person, a bush spirit, a monster or a dangerous animal pursues by mistake an object or animal that moves nearby

motif_title: Sticking demon: first to person and then to animal
motif_gloss: A demon who sticks to other creatures and refuses to get down sticks first to a person and then to an animal or first to an animal and then to a bird
Instead of chasing a person, a bush spirit, a monster or a dangerous animal follows by mistake a gourd vessel that floats downriver
Person's leg is injured intentionally or by chance. The loss of one leg does not bother him. He uses the sharpened bone as a thrust weapon
Person's sharp elbows or (rare) knees are like awls or knives
Person has a sharp axe-like protrusion on his breast
Person has sharp nails or knife-like hands to kill people
A monster kills victims with his or her sharp or stinging tail or protrusion on his or her back

A hunter spends night in a desolate place. A demon comes to his fire. When the demon falls asleep or goes away for a while, the hunter puts his clothes over a log and hides nearby. When the demon attacks the log taking it for the man, the hunter wounds or kills the demon
In a non-human world objects of everyday life have appearance of animals and monsters, mainly fish, amphibians and reptiles
Vultures bring to the sky a being who has lost part of its body members or is reduced to the head or skull
A small creature is found and reared up by people. When it is grown up, it becomes harmful and dangerous
A worm, reptile or a small water creature is brought home and reared up. When big, it goes out of human control or becomes something huge and/or dangerous
The only vulnerable spot of some being's body is his (her, its) limb (knee, toe, finger, etc.)
Person can be killed only with a particular plant that normally is not used as a weapon

motif_title: Deer horn is a weapon against the evil
motif_gloss: During a fight between the good and the evil creators the good one chooses a deer horn for a weapon (because his adversary is afraid of it most of all)
Antagonist asks hero what he is afraid most of all (i.e. what object is mortally dangerous for him). The hero lies and the object used by the antagonist does him no harm at all
Life of a person or creature is preserved outside of his (her, its) body. Person or creature dies after the corresponding object is destroyed
Hero's life is in certain object, usually in his weapon. When antagonist steals the object or throws it away, the hero dies but revives after his friends or brothers find the object and bring it back
A young woman or (rare) a youth falls dead when her necklace (rare: an organ) is stolen from her and revives again as soon as she gets it back or when the antagonist takes it off

motif_title: A burned piece of wood (Meleagros’ death)
motif_gloss: Life of a man depends on a wooden object. When a woman burns it down, the man dies

motif_title: The external soul: three or more objects one inside the other
motif_gloss: A small object that contains the life (soul) of a person is inside two or more creatures or other objects (like an egg in a duck, a duck in a hare, etc.) or the zoomorphic soul container tries to escape turning in succession to other animals – three or more enclosures or transformations
There is a headless anthropomorphic being who has eyes and/or mouth on his or her breast

motif_title: Eyes on a back of the head
motif_gloss: Person or creature has another pair of eyes (or one eye) on the back of his (her, its) head
Person or creature has another face (another mouth) on the back of his (her, its) head
A bird with two or more heads on top of one body is described in tales or represented in art
A being with three or more heads is described in tales or represented in art
Two persons hunt or fish. One of them is or becomes a cannibal. He or she reveals his or her nature eating the quarry raw
A man climbs a tree, throws down bird nestlings to a woman. She eats them raw and then kills or tries to kill the man
A cannibal under a tree plans to eat up a man who has climbed the tree. The man throws down and afar his pray or some object and escapes while the cannibal rushes to this object or is eating the pray
After breaking some taboo, coming across a strange object or person, people fall asleep. They do not feel when at night spirits come and injure or kill them
After breaking some taboo, coming across a strange object or person, people fall asleep and awake blind
Person gets hold of another. Trying to free himself, the latter turns into different materials, elements, animals or orders different dangerous creature to attack his opponent
Demons (or one of them) attack people and return to their den (usually a cave or tree hollow). People make suffocating fire around the den killing most or all of the demons
People adopt a demonic child, girl or woman but discover that this being kills people (in particular babies left in its charge) sucking out their brains or taking out their eyes

During the first initiation supernatural beings teach boys the rituals and kill them for breaking rules related to consumption and distribution of food. In response men kill the supernaturals and reproduce their appearance and/or voices during the rituals
Two girls or young women meet a demon. One or both are not aware of danger. One is eaten up, another escapes

motif_title: One is eaten up, another escapes
motif_gloss: Two or three children get to the house of a demon or the latter comes to their house. They do not know that the person is a cannibal or are not sure about it. The demon eats up one of the children. Another child (children) escapes, the demon pursues him or them and perishes. Usually the demon is a female, and if he is male, his victims do not arouse in him sexual interest
Person who have eaten a prohibited meat or fish turns into monstrous snake or fish

motif_title: Eating of snake meat triggers flood
motif_gloss: A river or lake appear or a flood begins because certain person ate meat of a snake or a strange fish
Person catches fish in a place where it ought not live, i.e. in a forest pond or in a tree hollow isolated from other water bodies. After eating he dies, is transformed and/or attacked by monsters

motif_title: Eating of snake meat triggers thirst
motif_gloss: Person who breaks some sort of taboo (usually has eaten a prohibited food) is thirsty and drinks enormous quantity of water
People against their will must follow an object, a creature, or a person (usually stick to it) who/which leads or carries them far away, usually into the water or to the sky

motif_title: Children carried away to the sky
motif_gloss: An object descends from the sky. Playing children climb on it or stick to it, it carries them away to the sky

motif_title: Reptile carries people into the water
motif_gloss: People find a snake or a turtle on a dry ground. They touch it or sit on it, stick to it, it carries them into the water
Stone swallows, bites or transforms people
Stone chases people to crash them
Trickster takes off an object (often a blanket) that lies on or near a rock or other seemingly inanimate object and that has been presented to it. The object pursues or otherwise punishes the stealer
Person suggests to another who looks like being unable to move (rock, stump, fire) a race competition. The competitor becomes to move, burns or crashes the person or runs away with his clothes
Trickster and rock agree to race down slope. The rock rolls with ever greater speed and crashes the trickster
Rolling rock kills people, hero destroys it
Trickster takes a blanket or decorations which are a property of Rock or other seemingly inanimate object (usually the same trickster presented this blanket to Rock before)
Rolling rock pursues person. The person cries for help, and goatsucker breaks Rock to pieces
A rock or tree kills everyone who names it in a certain way. Person provokes others to do it and devours the killed ones. The last of the invited ones deceives the provoker
Hero kills or injures his enemy putting fire on his or her straw costume, mask, headgear, hair or object on his or her back
At night, a shaman or a bush spirit comes and inserts his hand into the hut to steal food or to make this way love with a sleeping woman. A man who is in the hut cuts the hand off or breaks it

motif_title: Woman attacks man who climbs a tree
motif_gloss: When a man climbs a tree (escaping from persecutor; to get bird nestlings, honey, fruits, etc.), his wife (rare: her brother) kills, injures him or turns into demonic creature who pursues him

motif_title: To get know causes of problems
motif_gloss: On his way to a powerful person (God), a man comes across some persons or animals who ask him to put questions to this person from their part too (usually to ask what is the reason of their troubles)
Person accidentally overhears secrets of animals or demons and thus gets to know the causes of his and other people's misfortunes
Misfortune is a particular being who was imprisoned and sticks to a person who has released him
A demon puts a trap to catch people, hero gets into it
Person sticks to an object, usually touching it one by one with his body members. The object is a trap of demonic creature or is a non human creature itself

motif_title: Person hides in a tree but descends
motif_gloss: Person hides in a tree. Dangerous being gets to see him or her, makes him or her descend and takes to his house or den
A demon comes from the underworld and attacks a man who has climbed a tree
Person discovers (rare: ever fails to discover) another seeing his or her shadow or reflection in water; usually the first person makes the second one to descend to the ground

motif_title: Woman takes reflection of a youth for her own
motif_gloss: An ugly woman gets to see in water a reflection of a youth who is up in a tree. She takes it for her own reflection and thinks that she has become beautiful

motif_title: Absurd actions to lure person out
motif_gloss: Somebody acts in absurd way to lure person out of his or her place. The person does not understand the deception and comes to explain how to act correctly
An ogre or ogress catches a person and carries his or her prey home but the person escapes on the way or immediately after reaching the ogre's house
Hero escapes from the demon's basket or bag letting stone instead of him
An ogress puts her victims into a basket which is filled or smeared with pitch
An ogre or ogress brings hero home where he or she plans to cook and eat him. The hero escapes
An ogre steals fresh corpses from graves and devours them

An ogre's child or (rare) wife believes in what hero tells him (or her) and releases him. Usually the hero kills the child and puts its meat to cook in the very pot where the ogre planned to cook the hero
Person hides from the powerful one now in his house, now outdoors, the powerful cannot catch him

Person escapes from an ogre, runs over frozen water body and spills some blood on ice. The ogre rushes to lick the blood, his tongue freezes to ice. Or the ogre slips on ice, falls, is badly hurt, dies

An ogre catches a person and carries his or her prey home but the person escapes on the way. The ogre comes back, this time carries the person to his home. Or the ogre catches a group of children, most of them escape on the way, one is brought to the ogre's place
Person that has to be eaten up imperceptibly runs away. The master of the house thinks that his wife had eaten the food alone and cuts her belly open

A man (persuaded by his wife) abandons his children (usually a son and a daughter of his former wife who had died) in the wilderness. The children (or at least one of them) survive and become successful
Hero escapes from ogre's trap or hides in a shelter. The ogre or ogress roasts and/or eats insects, snakes, excrements, etc. being sure that he or she eats the man

A man hides in a shelter. An ogre wants him to demonstrate certain parts of his body. The man demonstrates or parts of the body of an animal or some objects. The ogre believes that his adversary is a powerful creature

A man hides in a shelter. An ogre wants him to give certain parts of his body. The man gives the ogre instead parts of the body of a killed animal. The ogre does not understand the deceit, gives in response parts of his own body and dies

motif_title: The blind got his sight, the lame got his legs
motif_gloss: A blind man and a lame man live together and help each other. When they got mortally scared or became to fight, their eyes and legs were cured

An ogre or a stronger animal catches a man or a weaker animal or drives him into a small enclosure and goes away for a time leaving a watchman. The hero dupes the watchman, escapes. (Most, though hardly all American cases can have post-Columbian African origin)
Person ascends, descends, walks head downward or sees the world upside down
Hero's enemy ascends a tree or rock head downward or walks backward letting the hero better possibility to kill him or to escape

A man kills (usually in a tree, on a rock, at the edge of a well, of a precipice) and/or throws down one of his enemies. The other enemies do not recognize their comrade and think that their prey is falling down
Body parts of a person or pieces pf his flesh are thrown down successively. Usually, thows who are on the ground take them for game, honey, fish
An ogre or robber waits for passers-by near a narrow path, distracts their attention and kicks them, usually pushing down into a precipice, lake, etc.
A cannibal, a bush spirit or a dangerous animal throws his victims into the precipice where water creatures devour them

motif_title: Hero escapes from top of a tree
motif_gloss: Hero hides in a tree from an ogre. Before the ogre gets to fell the tree, the hero flies away or a bird helps him to escape
A monstrous animal is killed or neutralized by stones (or pieces of metal, heavy fruits, etc.) thrown into its maw or anus. The stones are usually burning hot
To overcome a disaster, hot stones or ashes are thrown into the water
To kill a dangerous animal or monster, acrid or hot liquid (boiling water, resin, soup, etc.) is poured into one of his body orifices
A monster or a big animal dies when fire is kindled in its belly

motif_title: Person gets his body part back
motif_gloss: Person loses his organ or body part, it is carried away. He finds its new owner, gets his property back

motif_title: Hero’s companion gets his body part back
motif_gloss: When the hero loses his organ or body part, his companion who is weaker and often irresponsible gets it back. The hero is revived or becomes strong again

motif_title: Demon comes to get his body part back
motif_gloss: Person cuts off and uses part of the body of demonic creature. The demon comes after it, kills or maims the person
A man does not share food with his wife or kinsfolk. He or his food is transformed (turns into a bird, into worms, etc.) in punishment
Man's wife, sister or mother eats all the nest food alone, she is transformed in punishment
People who treated badly the hero or his son are pulled into the sea and turn into sea animal or into parts of its body or into parasites on its hide
Two or more sisters pick up a baby boy. In their absence he turns into adult man but when they come back they find him again in guise of a baby lying in its cradle
Person devours his or her own flesh or disembowels himself or herself
Stone man kills people but ultimately is killed himself

motif_title: Person eats with vagina or anus
motif_gloss: Person eats food with her toothed vagina or her or his toothed anus
Person removes part of his or her body (head, scalp, lungs) and then puts it back
A baby or small child proves to be a demon, devours or injures people

A girl born to the family or found proves to be a monster, devours people. Her brother escapes, (usually marries and returns home, finds that everybody had been eaten up), runs away, she pursues him but cannot get

A demonic woman or (rare) her paramour or a monster is going to kill a man usually after driving him up a tree. At the last moment the man's dogs or other animals or birds who are the man's pets come and kill the demon
The eldest of three or more sisters becomes a cannibal and devours her sisters and other people
When the elder sister becomes a cannibal, the younger one (temporarily) escapes. Cf. motifs L1B, L65C
A small animal digs an underground hole to the place where the monstrous stag, elk, antelope, or buffalo lies. Hero climbs along the tunnel and kills the monster

After digging a tunnel under a lying monstrous animal, a small animal (usually a mouse) bites off the monster's hair at a certain place. Hero kills the monster thrusting his spear or arrow through the hairless place into the monster's heart
Person turns into monster at night when he remains alone with his companion in the wilderness

motif_title: Puma rescues man from a monster
motif_gloss: A man is attacked by a monster but puma or jaguar fights with the monster and rescues the man

Person or animal is killed or injured with a heavy object dropped from a tree (or rock, etc.). The person or the animal knows that the objects will fall but has falls ideas about its character and weight

Person has killed an animal. A trickster attempts to appropriate all the meat. The person gets to carry the meat to the top of a tree and helps the trickster (or trickster's child) to get there too to share their meal. After eating, the trickster wishes to defecate or (rare) to drink. The person points to the tip of a thin branch as a right place for doing it. The trickster climbs there, falls and dies
Running away from a dangerous being, person throws objects that turn into mighty obstacles on the way of the pursuer
Running away from a dangerous being, person throws objects that turn into mighty obstacles on the way of the pursuer. One of the thrown objects is a comb which usually turns into a thicket
Running away from a dangerous being, person throws objects that turn into mighty obstacles on the way of the pursuer. One of the thrown objects is a whetstone which turns into a mountain

motif_title: Ogre persuaded to drink a river dry bursts
motif_gloss: A pursuer is advised to drink a river or sea. He or she tries to do it and bursts
A bear or other dangerous being tears off and carries away a hand of a person and holds it at his sleeping place. Another person steals the hand, gives it back to the owner

An antagonist carries away the hero or rips off and carries away his limb and hangs the prisoner or the limb (usually over the fire). The hero is suffering from pain. Another personage saves the hero or brings his limb back
One of twin brothers is evil. Being still in the womb, he does not want to be born in a normal way and bursts through his mother’s side killing her
An ogress attacks her male victim devouring or pulling off his testicles

motif_title: Girl seen as a fruit eaten up
motif_gloss: Person sees or smells people as delicious objects and devours them
Mixed traits of toad and jaguar in iconography; a toad or frog transforms into a jaguar; a toad or frog is a jaguar's mother or wife
A girl marries a powerful benevolent man. His first wife is a monster. The man kills her or is glad that she is killed by his human wife
A demonic person or animal is killed but revives or can revive if a small piece of its flesh or blood goes out of control
Person sets off in search of fire and finds it in the house of a demon. The demon makes harm to the person
Because a girl or young woman offends a cat (rare: a dog), it plays a trick that brings the girl a misfortune (usually extinguishes the fire and in search of it the girl gets to a demon)
Hero’s companions put a sword (sabre etc.) in front of his tent or room. When the hero runs out in a hurry, he is woonded by the blade (usually his legs are cut off).
Intentionally or not, a man burns his foot or his whole body in a fire, then turns into demon
A rolling head or a man who has burned off his foot turns into or produces thunder or lightning
Bush spirits and the like try to cut down a tree. The attempt fails because their axes are good for nothing being made of turtle shells, clay, etc.
One-sided people have one leg, one half of a head, etc. The second leg is not cut or burned off, preserved as a stump but is absent completely
Person is born as half of a child or loses his or her half in an accident. The person does not belong to any category of supernatural beings and usually turns into normal girl or young man

motif_title: Woman gives birth to disfigured child
motif_gloss: A woman gives birth to disfigured child because she offended a powerful supernatural being (Rain, Sun, etc.). Her child is provided with magic power and eventually obtains normal body

motif_title: After coming to the sky, gets normal body
motif_gloss: A man with incomplete or  grotesque body becomes normal after coming to the sky (getting back to the earth)
Person with half of a body is a chicken (sometimes only by name)

motif_title: One leg and one arm: the injured ploughman
motif_gloss: Hero comes across a giant (usually a ploughman) with one leg, one arm, one eye. The latter was injured when he met another giant who was much bigger and stronger than he
A woman turns into demon and pursues her children
Unintentionally, person gets to taste his or her own blood or flesh, likes the taste, turns into a cannibal
A man kills an ogre. When he later comes and touches the ogre's remains, the latter revives
Person transforms humans into monsters or animals secretly putting prohibited meat, grease or eggs into their food or provoking them to use a particular object

motif_title: Mouth from the earth to the sky
motif_gloss: Monster's upper lip (fang, horn, etc.) touches the sky, lower touches the ground

Two or four boys go to war or are on their way home. A long serpent-like creature blocks the passage, they cannot find a path around it and burn it through. One eats its roasted meat and turns into serpent himself or dies
Person escapes to a tree or high rock. An ogre tries to cut it down. An animal suggests the ogre to have a rest, promises to work instead of him but spoils his work
Person escapes to a tree or a high rock. An ogre tries to cut it down. While the ogre has a rest, an animal throws his axe into the water or carries it away
Cunning fox, jackal or coyote saves particular person or many people, helps them
Cunning rabbit or hare saves person, helps him or her
A demon helps a man or a woman or lets him or her free. As a reward, the person is forced to promise to give the demon his child
Water or chthonic demon suddenly appears before a person (often catches a man who bent down to drink from a well by his beard). The person is forced to fulfill demon's wish

motif_title: Coming back to pick up toys
motif_gloss: Person (usually a kid or lad) returns to the former place to pick up the forgotten object (often a toy) and is caught there by a demonic being
A lung or a liver lies on a road or floats in a pond etc. As soon as person touches them, a dangerous demon appears in front of him

motif_title: Sold in animal’s guise and comes back
motif_gloss: Person can transform himself or herself into an animal or an object. Being sold in this guise, he or she achieves his or her aims and becomes a human again
When person sighs or utters an interjection, another one (usually a demon) emerges because his name is spelled like Ahh, Ohhoi, etc.
A human being cannot move because the lower part of his body is rooted into the ground, stuck to it, or is absent at all
Dangerous cannibal or bush spirit who abducts children, attacks people, etc. is associated with an owl

motif_title: Bring me a spit to roast you!
motif_gloss: An ogre sends a man to bring a spit and/or firewood to cook him. The man intentionally does it slowly, brings unfit objects or a an animal helps him to escape
A youth and a girl who run away from pursuer transform themselves into a pair of persons, creatures or objects (pond and duck, church and priest, etc.) in order to escape detection by the pursuer

motif_title: A pursuer throws ahead the transformed fugitive
motif_gloss: A fugitive turns into small object (stick, stone) or hides himself inside it. A pursuer picks it up and throws ahead in anger, thus unwillingly helping the fugitive to escape

A youth and his bride get to escape from the pursuer. The youth goes to visit his home, leaves his bride behind for a time but forgets her (usually after breaking taboo to kiss or embrace his relations). When the youth is about to marry another woman, the forgotten fiancée reawakens his memory by performing magic actions

motif_title: Faithful wife mocks men who come to buy her love
motif_gloss: A woman pretends to be a prostitute. When a man comes to her she uses magic and the man spends all the night in her room being unable to move from the place. Episode is repeated with other or (rare) the same suitor. Usually the first suitor is ashamed, tells the other ones that everything was nice, and they are humiliated the same way

A pretty, faithful wife is courted by one or several men, one of them usually a clergyman. With her husband’s consent, she invites the suitor(s) to a private rendezvous. Before the first man’s wishes are gratified, the next one arrives and then the husband himself. The suitor or suitors are caught in an uncomfortable position and then killed, punished in some other manner, ridiculed, made to pay ransom, to work, etc.

motif_title: Pieces of clothes thrown to pursuer
motif_gloss: Pursued by demonic creature (usually a whale or walrus), people throw behind piece by piece children’s or woman’s clothes. These attract the pursuer’s attention, he loses time, the runaways escape

Seriously of for fun, a girl or a woman names an animal or remains of an animal as her husband or steps on the animal’s bones. The animal (revives and) carries her away. Her human husband or brother comes after her and they run away. Usually the animal husband pursues them but abandons the chase or dies
Treasure, or the like, is thrown back to tempt pursuer to delay
A fugitive turns in succession into different animals or objects. A pursuer does the same, every time becoming an animal or a person who is dangerous for the fugitive in his given guise

Animal, fish or person wounded by hero runs or swims away, usually with the man's projectile in his or her body. Local doctors are not able to cure the wound (usually because they do not see the projectile). The hero or his companion comes to the place where the wounded one lives and cures him or her (usually extracting his projectile from the wound)

An antagonist makes a demand to the hero which is correct in form but really is unjustified. The hero fulfills the claims or is punished. Now antagonist takes an object or animal possessed by the hero, is unable to give it back and is punished

An antagonist makes a demand to the hero which is correct in form but really is unjustified. The hero fulfills the claims or is punished. Now antagonist takes an object or animal possessed by the hero, is unable to give it back and is punished

motif_title: In search of lost object to the other world
motif_gloss: In search of a lost object, usually carried away by water or wind, a girl or (rare) a boy comes to a powerful person, gets the object back and/or is rewarded. The object is related to the everyday life, it has no ritual significance and is not a weapon
Anthropomorphic beings have huge ears (use them for blankets, umbrellas, etc.)
Person is or becomes black and has to sit in the water till becomes white. An antagonist carries him or her away
A predator or ogre swallows people or animals. Goat opens the ogre’s belly open, usually the swallowed ones come out alive
To make himself unrecognizable by the victim, a predator or ogre modifies his throat or tongue mechanically (oils or burns it, asks blacksmith to remake it, etc.)
To make himself unrecognizable by the victim, a predator or ogre demonstrates clothes, limb, etc. that look like clothes or limb of his victim's mother, etc.
Fox has a child or children (usually adopts a lamb, foal, etc.), cares for it. Wolf finds and eats it, the fox revenges on him
A person (a girl, a small boy) gets into the water and remains there. Antagonist lures him out imitating his father's or sibling's voice
A gourd proves to be a cannibal or grows from remains of a monster
A demonic being swallows a multitude of people and animals. When it is killed and cut open, the swallowed ones come out alive or are revived

A demonic being swallows a person or (in African versions) a multitude of people and animals. Hero kills the monster but cutting open its body, injures a person who was inside. Usually this person is offended and finds opportunity to kill the hero
The sky dwellers fish human beings who live on earth with a line and a hook
A boy with defective body (too small, only half of a body, only a head) ultimately obtains normal body
A girl refuses all suitors, at last marries a handsome man and walks with him to his place. Her husband proves to be a cannibal demon

motif_title: The youngest one saves siblings from demon
motif_gloss: A group of young people comes to a demon. The youngest brother of sister or a sick and invalid person who often accompanies the others against their wish saves them all

A member (usually the youngest) of a group of boys or girls gets with them to a cannibal. The cannibal plans to kill people when they fall asleep. The youngest boy or girl every time answers the cannibal why he or she is still awake and forces him or her to be engaged into different activities instead of killing the sleeping people. Brothers (sisters) run away and return home
Getting a task or by his own initiative, person several times comes o the ogre and steals in succession objects he needs

motif_title: A task: to bring the ogre
motif_gloss: Person bring objects from ogre’s house and after this catches or kill the ogre himself

A girl who rejected suitors finds at last a really handsome man. He escorts her to his place and distributes on the way all his clothes and body parts that he loaned before. Only his skull (head) remains
A cannibal (old man, Gipsy, etc.) carries away a girl. He walks from village to village forcing her sing or dance. People recognize her (or her voice) and release her
Hunting a doe (a deer), hero gets to a demon’s place; the does is a bewitched person or demon

When a man goes to marry, an evil spirit joins him, helps him in the village of his bride, etc. but then claims at least half of the bride for himself. (In Gola story a man gets a wife for a spirit and claims a half of her)

(Animal) person provokes another to put his hand or paw into a split log, between two planks, etc. When a wedge is removed, two pieces of wood spring back together and the person or animal gets caught
Hero and antagonist fight in the air tearing off each other limbs. Usually their allies on earth preserve limbs of their leader and destroy limbs of the adversary
Hero listens in conversation of demonic beings who plan to turn into something edible, attractive, etc. and to destroy those who touch them. The hero neutralize the demons beforehand

An animal or ogress turns into woman and marries a hunter to destroy him. Accompanying him to the wilderness, she acquires her real guise, the hunter has narrow escape. Usually the wife asks him what are his usual transformations in case of а danger. The hunter's father or mother stops him before he tells his wife about his last transformation
(Demonic) person is riding a cock
To confuse pursuer, person many times runs away in different directions and comes back

motif_title: Sinew of a killed enemy cuts a tree
motif_gloss: After killing his adversary, person pulls out his sinew (spinal cord, intestine, ribbon of skin) and puts it around a tree trunk. The trunk is cut through. Fortunately for him, the person has not put it around his own waist
A man marries a beauty but catches her in a situation when her not human nature is revealed. After this their marriage breaks down
A small bird makes a powerful anthropomorphic person lose his temper. The bird cannot be annihilated, cries from inside person's stomach, the person suffers or dies
Caiman ferries a person or a group of brothers who later turn the Pleiades
Caiman ferries a monkey across a river. Reaching the opposite bank, the monkey escapes before the caiman gets to catch it
A man descends from top of a tree or rock down a chain of animals or on the back of an animal who climbs or runs down the trunk
Person crosses a water or air space along the chain of many animals, birds or fish
Animal who does not swim well suggests animals who live in water to count their number. For this, they should make a chain and he would run along it. It is but a trick to cross a body of water

Crossing a body of water or descending a tree, person steps on an certain part of a body of an animal or on a certain animal that have made a chain (usually despite warning that he should not do it) and falls down or drowns as a result
Being in a situation when his life depends on a good will of a demon or animal, person either resists or does not resist the temptation to insult or to beat, bite, etc. the latter

A rat or other animal which cannot swim well rides a canoe with other creatures who can swim or fly and unlike them gets into trouble when the canoe sinks. Usually a water creature carries the rat to the shore but the latter defecates on its savior or kills it

A young man or girl spends night in the forest. The forest partridge (Tinamus sp.) provides him or her a fire, a shelter and/or a hammock but takes them away and flies away itself when the person does something wrong

Getting into the lower or upper world, to an island, a country at the horizon, etc. a man is unable to move further and waits for somebody who could bring him to his destination. Some animals, birds or celestial bodies pass by, the last one (often the Sun or the Moon) picks him up and brings to the place he is eager to go
A bird or an animal takes hero into its boat but acquires its animal guise and leaves him alone in water when he breaks a taboo
Non-human persons work hard to destroy a strong and durable obstacle that blocks access to some place or object

motif_title: Birds peck a rock to release prisoners
motif_gloss: Birds and sometimes also animals work hard to break from the outside or from the inside a rock, a tree truck, bonds, etc. to release some beings or themselves from confinement in a small enclosure or trap

motif_title: Birds break an obstacle to get water
motif_gloss: Birds or (rare) animals work hard to break a rock or a cane and get water or honey concealed inside
Birds peck through a layer of clay, wax, pitch etc. with which person’s eyes or anus are stuck up
Birds work hard to peck through the substance that covers some beings' body or to reach its entrails
Person who puts her or his head or hand into a tree hollow or (rare) other hole is stuck fast or falls into the hollow and dies or undergoes a metamorphosis
Person who sucks honey greedily from a tree hollow and/or is stuck in it turns into tree-frog
A girl or a woman who was stuck in a tree-hollow when she tried to extract honey or who was greedily sucking honey otherwise, dies or turns into the honey or into the bee
Person serves people fish extracted from her or his own body
A woman serves a man a good meat cut from her own body and does not do it anymore when the man got to know about the source of the meat
A male person cuts or roasts his own body to extract meat, lard or blood, cooks it and serves to his guest without injuring himself. Such a food is not considered to be unclean

Not to return home empty-handed, a hunter or (rare) a fisherman cuts off a piece of flesh from his body (usually from his calf) or (more rare) extracts his blood or entrails. Usually he brings his flesh or blood to other people pretending that is a good game or fish; or a woman cuts off a piece of flesh from her calf to feed her husband

motif_title: God grants requests to his visitors
motif_gloss: Some persons ask the supreme deity (usually coming to him) to fulfill their demands. The deity does it according to the letter and not to the spirit of the demand
God agrees or suggests to fulfill a demand of a man. As a result the latter is transformed into a stone
To revenge on his wife and her kinsfolk, a man roasts her alive
A girl or young woman is tied to the top of a tree or impaled on the sharpened top of a tree and abandoned by a man. Somebody (usually her brothers) attempt to save her

motif_title: Ugly or sick becomes healthy and handsome
motif_gloss: A wife, bride or mother of a sick or ugly boy or man does not care for him. He becomes healthy and handsome, punishes and/or abandons her
A supernatural helper (usually a loon) makes a blind man to regain his eyesight diving with him into water
A blind man or lad kills an animal. His wife or (grand)mother lies that he has missed, cooks and eats all the meat alone

Person transforms himself into an object of hunting or fishing and provokes hunters of fishermen to catch or shoot him. Arrows, darts, a harpoon stick in his body, he carries them away or he bites off and carries away a fishing hook. Or he fishes by way of turning himself into a hook. Another or (rare) the same person tries to repeat the trick but suffers a reverse (usually is fished out)
Person turns into a fish or game and exposes himself as a target. A lot of arrows, darts or harpoons stick in his body making him no harm, he carries them away
Person turns into a fish to steal fishing hook or harpoon or he turns into fishing hook to catch a fish
Person ties another one (usually a child) to a fishing line to use him as a bait or orders the tied one to catch fish with his hands
Person steals bait or fish from fishhooks. His bill or jaw is ripped off or otherwise injured. Usually the trickster gets the ripped off jaw back
Person is pursued by an enemy. A man or an animal hides him on his own body or nearby

Person is pursued by an enemy. A bird or animal hides him or her in its mouth (under a wing) and  pretends not to be able to open the mouth (to raise a wing) because of a tooth ache, some injury and the like
A long-necked bird living near water (stork, heron, bittern, swan) saves person from dangerous pursuer
A long-necked bird living near water (stork, heron, swan) is a guard in a strange house or land where hero comes
Рerson or creature pretends to be afraid of a particular sort of treatment that really cannot do him any harm
Turtle goes to war and/or is captured by enemies
Turtle goes to war, kills people (usually a woman), is caught and killed but continues to live in its animal guise

To take part in a feast or to visit God or celestial object, person ascends to the sky. To return, he either uses a rope but falls before reaching ground or jumps (falls) down from the sky and is badly hurt, dead, and/or transformed

motif_title: Ducks rise hunter into the air
motif_gloss: Person attempts to hunt ducks or geese catching them by the legs. They rise him into the air, he falls down
A tree or a chain of reeds by which people have ascended to the sky is destroyed. On their way back they fall to the ground. Some of them remain in the sky for ever or longer than others

motif_title: Icarus (failed attempt to fly on artificial wings)
motif_gloss: Person flies on artificial wings or partly turning himself into a bird but falls to the ground or remains in a far away place being unable to fly any more
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is raven
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is fox, jackal or coyote
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is skunk
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is mink
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is wolverine
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is hare or rabbit
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is hedgehog
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is owl
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is hawk
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a water bird

motif_title: Trickster is a turtle, a toad or a frog
motif_gloss: In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a turtle (or tortoise), a toad or a frog
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is an opossum
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a rat
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a mouse
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a ground squirrel (Xerux sp.)
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a monkey
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a spider
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a racoon
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is an anteater
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a porcupine
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is the Moon
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a small ungulate (deer, gazelle, antelope)
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a feline (jaguar, ocelote, puma)
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a hyena
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a badger
In episodes related to deception, absurd, obscene or anti-social behavior the protagonist is a wren

Person or creature who has no wings or is unable to fly on a long distance attempts to ascend to the sky or to fly far away but falls down or, deprived of his wings, remains in a place from which he is unable to return
Trickster who flies over a village falls to the ground. They bind him and defecate on him
Animal person who cannot swim asks a good swimmer to carry him. The latter agrees only to throw his rider into the water
Food or liquid that person swallows are immediately pouring out from his bottom part

motif_title: Eating pieces of flesh that fall out
motif_gloss: Person's intestines or pieces of flesh from his bottom part fall out. He eats them up taking for a good meat or fat
Person himself or somebody else stitches up or firmly stops his anus (with wax, clay, grass, etc.)
An object thrown into person becomes his tail and the person himself an animal
Two animal persons compete to see who could withstand cold all the night. At dawn one is dead

motif_title: Dismantles himself to crawl through an opening
motif_gloss: Person is imprisoned inside a tree, stone, a ball of ice, etc. He or somebody else makes the opening but it is too narrow. The person puts himself to pieces (or turns into fog), inserts them into the opening, outside puts the pieces together again
Person or person's head is split with the blow of an axe. Person remains (or must remain if the procedure is realized in correct way) uninjured

Person sees others act using magic or according to their animal nature. Back at home, he imitates their actions and gets in trouble. Actions are not heroic deeds, competitions or tests and mostly refer to providing and cooking food
Person imitates actions of his son- or brothers-in-law or (among Comox and Halcomelem) of his wives
A rejected wife acts using magic. Other wives try to imitate her and perish

motif_title: Old people forged into young ones
motif_gloss: In forgery person forges old people into the young ones. A smith who has no supernatural power unsuccessfully tries to imitate him

motif_title: Fool takes off boots from animals’ legs
motif_gloss: Two brothers live with their mother. One of them makes stupid actions like (all or some of them): lets free animals that got into a snare but kills his mother; thinks that an animals (reindeer, cow, horse, etc.) does not want to step into the water because they are afraid to make their shoes or clothes wet, cuts their hooves off or flays them; thinks that a certain place on a head of a baby is a tumor, sucks baby's brains out; cuts a cloth into pieces and ties them to reeds of to branches of a tree; hearing a murmur of water throws food into the water; tries to build a hut not on a river bank but in the river
Fool follows instructions that were reasonable in every previous episode but become absurd in every next one
Fool is acting in an absurd way taking instructions literally or being one step behind. One of the episodes is related to treatment of a needle or other sharp objects

Fool kills a person, throws the body into a pond or a well. His relation throws there a dead goat. Searching for the corpse in the pond, the fool asks if the killed person had horns, etc. People see that he is really crazy and do not suspect him of a crime
Fool takes his own shadow for a person who pursues him and gives it his possessions

motif_title: Selling a cow to a lizard (Money inside the statue)
motif_gloss: Fool sells (gives) goods to an animal or a plant and believes that the buyer will pay or he makes a work which nobody asked him to do mistaking an animal for a master. When he comes for the money, he beats the animal or a plant (follows the animal) and finds treasure

motif_title: Fool kills goats for eating pears
motif_gloss: Fool brings his goats to a fruit tree and kills them when they become to eat fruits that he has thrown down from the tree

motif_title: Misunderstood instructions: to cut a road
motif_gloss: A wayfarer asks his companion in an allegorical for to tell a story. The companion takes his words in the direct sense and acts stupidly

A powerful man finds a clever wife for his son or for himself. Being imprisoned by enemies he or his daughter-in-law sends a message that only they two understand. The enemies are destroyed, the prisoner is released (rare: his body is found).

A poor girl agrees to marry a prince only if he learns some craft. He does it, marries the girl and then gets into hands of some criminals. He promises them to produce valuable object that they can sell for good money. His wife or (rare) his father recognize his work (or read signs of the object). He is released, the criminals killed
Person does not put attention to which direction his canoe goes. As a result he returns to his own dwelling, attack its inhabitants killing his own kin
Persons sitting in a canoe paddle in opposite directions and the canoe does not move

motif_title: Pumpkin sold as a donkey’s egg
motif_gloss: A numskull finds or buys an unknown fruit (pumpkin, melon, etc.). He mistakes it for an egg of a donkey (mare. camel, etc.). When he drops it or throws it off he scares a hidden hare (rabbit, fox, mouse, etc.). The fool thinks the fugitive is a young animal hatched from the egg

In succession and unintentionally a man causes damage to others. All of them together bring him to the court. In each case the judge makes decisions that are formally logical but patently unacceptable and saves the man
Asking about minor details of the case, a judge demonstrates that the plaintiff (or the defendant) lies because he does (not) know about them
A weaker (animal) person comes to a wife or a son of a stronger one and tells her or him that her (him) husband or father has ordered to give him food, to make love to him, etc.
Person plays throwing his eyes or (Alaska Athabascans) his tooth up or away. Eyes or tooth first come back to eye sockets or mouth but eventually are lost
Person loses his eyes because of his playfulness or negligence. He makes new eyes of some substance or/and takes eyes of another person
Person (usually after losing his own eyes), makes new eyes of berries and is able to see again
Person loses his eyes, makes new ones of gum and is able to see again (though usually not well)

motif_title: Falling from a bluff, eats his own marrow
motif_gloss: Breaking his leg after falling from a bluff, person becomes to eat his own bone marrow
To kill or catch a monster, human figure of wood or clay or alive woman is exposed as a bait. Usually monster's claws or sharp leg get stuck in the wood

motif_title: Thieves of food: the first people
motif_gloss: Person discovers that somebody steals game or fish from his trap or devastates his garden. He or his guards catch the thieves who prove to be the first humans beings or the first men

Person discovers that somebody steals game or fish from his trap or devastates his garden. He or his guards catch the thieves who prove to be (the first) women or the thief is the water being whom the hero lets go after receiving a woman for ransom

motif_title: Thieves of food: a young hero
motif_gloss: A boy or young man comes to steal food of a person who is elder than he. Usually he is caught but not punished and invited to live with the elder person

motif_title: A predator tricks animals to gather around him
motif_gloss: A predator animal falls asleep or pretends to be dead or sleeping. A lot of animals gather around him, he kills many or they run away in panic
A man falls asleep or pretends to be sleeping or dead. Animals take him for dead: mourn, carry to bury, are going to eat up, etc. The man kills a lot of animals or obtain valuables otherwise
Person turns into baby, is picked up by the owner of valuables, steal the valuables or make love to a woman
Person turns into tiny object or creature. Touching or swallowing it, the woman conceives and gives birth to a baby-boy. The boy steals valuables or make love to the woman
Person turns into conifer-needle, a tiny particle, a small insect. Swallowing it by chance, the woman becomes pregnant and gives birth to a boy

A small child cries and becomes satisfied only when he gets a particular object to play with. This object is of high value and is hidden in the house. As soon as the object is given to the child, the fate of his mother or of whole humanity changes
Punishing a person or animal or restoring his or its body after its disin­teg­ration, a powerful being intentionally or by chance puts head to bottoms

Trickster asks an animal to transform him but breaks condition of transformation and acquires his original guise. Usually he asks a big horned animal (buffalo, elk) to turn him into buffalo (elk) too. Animal charges, trickster is scared. Next time he remains on the place, turns into buffalo but trying to transform the same way another person, turns back into his own self

motif_title: Man in a skin of another
motif_gloss: Hero comes across a (animal-)person from an enemy group and takes his or her appearance, usually dressing himself in a skin of his victim; after this he penetrates the enemy camp

A man tries to join a group of persons who are or become stars (usually the Pleiades) but suffers a reverse; or he pursues the stars to have sexual contact or to be reintegrated with members of his family

One of two animal-persons kills game, another claims it for himself. The weaker one deceives the stronger, carries the meat to a high tree or rock, throws down something inedible instead of meat. Usually this object is sharp or heavy, the stronger one is killed or injured. In some variants meat is carried to a tree not by the person who originally got it but by one who tried to appropriate it)

A small animal (not a predator) or a weak person kills a big game. He asks another (animal-)person to skin or butcher the carcass. The latter is willing but takes or tries to take all the meat for himself

Person invites birds or animals (usually geese and ducks) to dance or stand around him and concentrate their attention on some activity (usually to dance with their eyes shut), kills them, usually one by one. Or (rare) he dances himself with his eyes shut and then kills water fowl who gather around him
Raven tricks seals or other water mammals to gather around him and kills them by deception
Trickster pretends to have songs in his bag

Trickster suggests water fowl to dance around him with their eyes shut, kills them one by one. He warns that eyes of a bird who would open them become red. In some versions, the bird who opened its eyes got them really red
Person creates figures that look like enemies or pretends that enemies come. People run away, person gets all valuables for himself
Person (always a raven) kills a whale. When people come, he tells them about some circumstances that can make the meat dangerous. People do not dare to touch the meat and the deceiver eats it alone

motif_title: Disguised trickster eats up all the food
motif_gloss: Taking part in storing up food, person pretends to go away for some reason, returns disguised as a monster or predator, people are scared and run away, the deceiver eats up all the food but is ultimately unmasked

motif_title: Runway awakes in the same house
motif_gloss: A man runs away from the house of powerful person but in the morning awakens in the same house again

A man or a weaker animal leads the stronger one to a place that is allegedly dangerous (hot coals, ashes, sticks, etc. can fall there at night). When his companion is asleep, man throws sticks, sprinkles hot ashes or coals on him pretending that they fall on them both

A man or an animal beats alligator but it remains unharmed and says that he would be killed if stricken in one special place on his body. The next time the same person strikes alligator this way and kills it
A weak person's demand will be granted if he brings a skin (paw, tears, etc.) of animals stronger than he. He fulfills the task using tricks (but usually does not receive the promised reward)
Person promises to bring a snake. The snake agrees to let him measure it. He ties the snake to a measuring stick or during the measuring finds a vulnerable place on the snake’s body

Person promises to fill container with small flying creatures which are alive. When he expresses his doubts that the creatures are numerous enough to fill the container, they fly in and he closes the lid
Instead of common body discharges man or woman urinates, spits, etc. beads, flowers, gold and other valuables

motif_title: Sweat of the Sun and tears of the Moon
motif_gloss: Beads or metals are discharged by bodies of deities
A domestic animal (ass, cow, horse) defecates gold or food

Person first gets magic objects that bring food or treasure and after this he receives a cudgel (a whip, etc.) that beats people, usually those who have stolen the first objects. (In Greek text the stealer of magic objects is punished otherwise)

motif_title: Plant or trail saves from fire
motif_gloss: World is ablaze, fire pursues a person. Some objects or elements do not resist the heat and cannot hide him. The last named gives protection. Earth becomes cool, person continues his travel
A small animal asks bigger one to bring him across the stream, rejects one by one all possible places to sit; finds the position that lets him kill the big animal after crossing the stream
Porcupine asks other animal to ferry him across river, rejects different places to sit, occupies a place where he can easily kill the animal after crossing the river and really kills him
Hero wounds monstrous enemy, then masks as a doctor, kills his patient instead of curing him

motif_title: Unrecognized hero comes to one whom he wounded
motif_gloss: Hero wounds an animal or a supernatural creature, then masks as a doctor, comes unrecognized to the one whom he wounded, either cures or kills him

motif_title: Herdsman explains how to ferry cattle
motif_gloss: To come unnoticed to his adversaries, the hero takes the guise of a herdsman and before that gets know from the real herdsman how to ferry the cattle across a river
A servant has to lick soles or a wound of his master or mistress. The hero comes disguised as the servant and instead of licking the soles rubs them (rubs the wound) with a cut off animal tongue

motif_title: False doctor: a finished off victim
motif_gloss: The deceiver who promised to cure a sick or wounded person or animal devours him
To obtain valuables person provokes a quarrel between their owners. When the owners become to fight with each other, the valuables fall out

motif_title: Person provokes a quarrel between two birds
motif_gloss: To provoke a quarrel between a gull and another bird, person (always a raven) tells each one that the other was insulting him

motif_title: Person provokes a quarrel between two birds
motif_gloss: To provoke a quarrel between two different stones, person (always a raven) tells each one that the other was insulting him

motif_title: Person provokes a quarrel between two fish
motif_gloss: To provoke a quarrel between two different fish, person tells each one that the other was insulting him
Hero imperceptibly causes detriment to two persons or creatures. They accuse each other and fight

motif_title: Trying to hit the hero hit each other
motif_gloss: Two or more personages direct their weapons against the hero who is between them but hit each other
