A weak animal-person agrees separately with two strong ones to pull a rope with him. They do not know that are engaged into tug-of-war with each other or that the rope is tied to a tree. (In New World motif borrowed from Afroamericans)
Trickster puts on a rotten hide of an animal and, being unrecognized, pretends to be victim of hare’s magic. Animals are frightened and decide not to pay the hare back for his tricks
A weak person makes a separate agreement with two strong ones to cultivate a field. The strong ones do not know about each other, and ultimately the weak one takes all the harvest himself.

motif_title: Every next assistant kills previous one
motif_gloss: Person invites in succession others to help him in his work. Every next one is stronger than the one who came before and eats him up, the last two perish when they begin to fight
Before finding a part of the body that is the best for some particular function, other parts are proven or enumerated
To get valuables (food, fire) concealed by their owner, person pretends that the valuables are already in his possession
Trickster cooks meat got by deception but is unexpectedly jammed between trees or stuck to a stone. An animal (usually fox, wolf or coyote) steals all the meat
Trees squeak in the wind. Trickster hears a noise, climbs up the tree and is caught between limbs
Person kills game (usually by deception), gets to see how thieves carry it away but is unable to intervene
After eating certain plant, small animal, or rubbing it over his body, person suffers from itch, diarrhea, or from breaking wind
Imprudent trickster produces wind that carries him away
Because of his own obstinacy, person suffers of breaking wind permanently and starves because a loud noise produced by him scaring game
A small animals or insects dance or feast inside big animal skull or food is there. Trickster inserts his head into the skull and cannot take it out for a long time

motif_title: An elder person poisons a younger one with intestinal gas
motif_gloss: Old person tricks a young man into smelling her or his intestinal gas
An old woman defecates or breaks wind over a man. He kills her inserting a cutting object into her anus or vagina

Trickster floats down the river or falls from the height and turns into a piece of wood or into a wooden object. Somebody picks it up. Eventually, the trickster acquires his real self, usually in the host's absence

Person puts (for different reasons) his or her hand into the anus of a tapir or other herbivorous animals and is unable to extract it back. Animal starts to run and drags the person behind him for a long time
Two (animal) persons compare their feces or vomits to know about the diet and habits of each other. The weaker one gets to exchange the feces (vomits)

Two animals or persons compare their vomits to know about the diet and habits of each other. The weaker one gets to exchange vomits, to swallow the unusual food before, or to swallow his partner's vomits

An animal person pretends to be invited to be godfather or he gives names to different places along which he travels in a sledge, boat, etc. The names look strange but become understandable when other people or animals get to know that their companion has devoured all the supplies

motif_title: Theft of food by playing godfather
motif_gloss: An animal person pretends that he has been invited to be godfather at a baptism (or invited to a funeral or wedding) but instead eats secretly food supplies

Travelling in a boat or on a sledge, animal person (always the fox) steals food supplies or ruins objects and accordingly to his deeds, names different places. These names seem strange to the person’s companions (“River of broken arrows” and the like)
Person secretly eats up supplies and pretends that the thief is somebody else. To prove it he puts remains of the food or his body excretions near his sleeping companion.

motif_title: Revenge for falling from the sky
motif_gloss: Vulture suggests person to carry him in the sky but drops to earth. The person attracts vulture to revenge on him. Or the vulture drops the person (or abandons him on a high rock) to revenge on him for his attempt to catch him
A man hides in a skin or carcass of a big animal. A bird carries it to its nest without knowing that the man is inside

A man gets to know that a poor boy must inherit all his property or become a king and tries to prevent it, but the fate cannot be changed. The boy marries a rich girl, usually the daughter of his adversary

motif_title: Bird tries to avert predetermined marriage
motif_gloss: When a boy and a girl are still small children, a bird gets to know about their predetermined marriage. All its attempts to prevent the marriage fail.
A man sends another one to top of a mountain or a tree to obtain treasure for him. To go back is impossible but the man survives
A man bereaves vultures of their hunting weapons or amulets

motif_title: Person climbs a tree, leg is cut off
motif_gloss: When a man climbs a tree, a woman cuts his leg off or when a woman climbs a tree, a man cuts her leg off

While person is asleep, another smears with excrements or something that reminds excrements his or her bed or clothes. The ashamed person runs away or agrees to make what the trickster wants in exchange of his silence
A childless couple (old woman, old man) gets for a son tiny boy as big as a thumb. He taunts people, predator animals, ogres
A wee boy is a transformed tail of a sheep or goat
Person joins dancers but then understands that these are trees or reeds moved by the wind
Person insults a partridge-like bird, kills or injures her chickens. The partridge scares him, he falls, usually into a river or lake
A man travels and comes to two or several blind (usually old) persons
A man meets two blind women, makes them see, they are or become birds (geese, ducks, grouses or the like)

motif_title: Not to climb after an arrow stuck in a tree
motif_gloss: Despite a warning not to do so, person climbs in a tree to get his arrow that was stuck and gets into trouble
Getting to the sky or (rare) to the lower world a man comes across one or two blind persons, then returns to the earth. Usually he cures their eyes
A man comes across (often in the sky) one or two blind persons and cures their eyes
An animal person sees that another has something tied to his tail, wants the same tail for himself and has a trouble as a result
Somebody claims that he has been born before present world came into being. His opponent claims the same, and they argue who of them is the older

motif_title: Fox cries for his dead children
motif_gloss: Persons or animals argue who of them is older, some claim that they lived in such and such time, but the last one says that he remembers this day because a certain event had taken place at this time

Two (or more) (animal)-persons agree that whichever of them has the most wonderful dream may eat all the food. The first one tells about a feast that he participated in his dream. His companion answers that he was sure that after such a feast (after getting into the paradise, etc.) the first one would not need the food, so he has eaten it alone
Animals argue who of them gets drunk easier. The last one falls down because he becomes drunk as soon as somebody talks about alcohol
Person, animal or (rare) a fruit is eaten up. After this all bones (all seeds) are put together and the eaten up is revived
Supernatural beings kill and eat a deer, ram, cow or goat, then put all the bones in the animal's skin and the revived animal runs away
Butchered and eaten animal, bird or fish revives after its bones are thrown into the water
A man spends a night in a forest under a tree. He listens how a bush spirit explains to another that he has a guest (i.e. this same man) tonight
A man listens in conversation of trees one of which is mortally ill

An animal person (usually a fox or a jackal) threatens to cut down a tree on which mother bird (squirrel) made its nest unless she will throw down one of her nestlings (squirrel children) or eggs. Another bird lets the mother bird know that the predator is unable to realize his threat
Rock chases or otherwise punishes person who has offended it (usually deceived it or has taken objects that belong to Rock)
Person enters a seemingly empty house and attempts to take certain things. Invisible beings prevent him from doing it or objects themselves hurt him
A man joins a group of dancing women and is killed or injured as a result
Person dies or is humiliated after some object that he or she made of wax, resin, excrements and/or took for something worthy are melted down
Only horned animals are invited to a feast. Hyena makes itself false horns but is disguised

motif_title: To guess of what material an object is made
motif_gloss: Somebody suggests to guess what sort of material a certain object is made of. Another person (usually a monster) gets to know the secret and the hero or the heroin must do what they have promised

motif_title: To marry a man who would give a correct answer
motif_gloss: A girl is promised to a man who would know her name or whose finger would fit her ring, or who would guess a material from which certain object is made or grown. Person finds a correct answer by deception
It should be guessed the nature of a big animal or its skin, the content of a box. The correct answer is that the animal is a louse (o flea), a louse is in the box
Person was wrong being sure that the Sun cannot rise from the West
Person pretends that a person (often his or her mother, spouse or lover) who recently died is alive, claims that the death of the false alive resulted from negligence of others and gets a reward
Person conceals under clothes a bladder with blood or red juice and piercing it, simulates killing or suicide or demonstrates that he can cut his bowels and remain alive
Using trick, a man sells or exchanges for treasure ashes. Another person tries to sell ashes and is ridiculed

Person gets other person’s possessions by trick (or pretends to get it; usually another person is drowned instead of him) and then demonstrates his possessions (usually a herd) and explains that he had received everything at the river bottom. His enemies believe him

Person is put into a bag (a cage, tied up, etc.) to be drowned, burned, etc. He pretends to be in this situation by his own will or because he refuses to marry a princess, to become a chief and the like. Another person is willing to take his place and is killed

After warning his wife about the planned trick, person lets free a wild animal or bird asking it to pass a message to his wife. Seeing the same (actually another) animal or bird in his companion’s house another man buys the animal for a lot of money

motif_title: Pot that does not need fire to cook
motif_gloss: Man takes a pot from the fire but it is still boiling or he cooks the food beforehand and tells that his pot cooks it in no time. Another man buys the pot

Person deceives the other (giving out a corpse for alive person, accusing incent people of murder, etc.). When a shaman (almost) gets to know the truth, the trickster kills her or him and gets to avoid any punishment
Girls stick something red to old man's eyebrows and he thinks it is a fire

Before falling asleep, person tells his eyes (which he extracts and puts aside) or his anus to awake him in case of danger. Eyes or anus do not make an alarm or person himself does not react to it. As a result he suffers a damage
Person punishes the part of his body which he selected as his guard for the time of his sleep or absence (he burns his buttocks, breaks eyes)
Person tricks another to slide down a hill knowing that sharp poles, etc. or an open water are below
Person tricks another to crawl into a basket and closes it. One in a basket is killed or badly injured (usually rolled down a hill)

A weaker person asks the stronger one to bring present to his or her kin and hides himself or herself in a bag. The stronger one brings the bag to the weaker one's relatives thinking that there are but some objects inside
Person does not want to share his meal with his close relatives and pretending to have many guests, eats food alone
Person becomes blind or loses his way. He walks asking different trees their names, makes decisions accordingly to their answers and ultimately reaches his destination

Person reckons up number of members in two alternative multitudes (alive trees and dead trees, men and women, etc.). Numbers prove to be equal but one member possesses the qualities of the both multitudes. Adding it to one of them, person demonstrates his case
Person is going to exterminate birds but decides not to do thanks to a wise adviser

motif_title: Sleep at the edge of a cliff
motif_gloss: One animal-person suggests another to lie asleep at the edge of a bluff or cliff. At night he tells him to move a little, the companion falls down and dies
An animal-person provokes another to jump from of a bluff or cliff because his father (grandfather, etc.) could do it. The one yielded to provocation jumps and dies

motif_title: Who is afraid of whom? (Fox and Bear)
motif_gloss: Fox tells that he is afraid of people, Bear tells that he is afraid of partridges. Fox hunts partridges, Bear attacks people and is wounded or killed

motif_title: Person lets his leg or head to be cut off
motif_gloss: A bird stands with one leg tucked under it, putting its head under its wing; turtle draws its head and limbs under its shell. Person decides that the bird has one leg, no head, turtle has neither head nor limbs, asks to cut him his head and limbs off
Person asks another how her or his children got their pretty colors. Another answers that she or he put them into the fire. roasted, etc. The first person believes, kills his or her children
Person conceals his or her close relatives (children, mother, brothers) and tells another that he or she has killed them. Another believes and agrees to kill his or her own children, mother, etc.
Person conceals his mother or (rare) wife or mother-in-law, tells another that he has killed or sold her, another really kills or sells his mother (wife, mother-in-law)
Person lies that his name is so and so. His enemy, victim or other people, demons or animals understand it not as a name but as a common word and behave accordingly

After doing damage or injury to his antagonist, person lies that his name is so and so. Other demons understand it not as a name but as a common word and it makes them believe that the injured one was the trouble-maker himself

After doing damage or injury to his antagonist, person lies that his name is so and so. Other demons understand it not as a name but as a common word and it makes them believe that the injury had been done so long ago that there is no sense to investigate the case
Person lies that his name is “The Guest” or so and eats all the food suggested to the guests
A smaller animal kills or maims a big mammal (jaguar, tapir) seizing him by his penis
Person suggests to ferry people's property across river but rides away with boat and load
An old couple live alone and adopt a boy (a trickster-animal) as a son. He steals their property and runs away
Animal person advices another animal to put its tail into ice-hole to fish, to get treasure, etc. The tail sticks to ice, to snags, etc.

motif_title: To sit on the ice waiting for food
motif_gloss: An animal suggests another to sit on the ice till some food will fall from the sky. Waiting this way for food to fall down the anima is frozen to the ice

motif_title: Sick animal carries the healthy one
motif_gloss: A healthy animal tricks an injured one (a wolf, a bear) into carrying him on his back by pretending to be injured himself

An animal is tricked to be carried across the water by those who are going to eat or to use as a medicine a part of its body. The animal tells that forgot to take just that part which is needed, is carried back to take it, escapes

An animal person who can climb trees (usually a monkey) suggests another (a turtle, a crab) to harvest bananas. He climbs the banana, throws down but peels, rotten fruits and the like. His companion revenges on him
An animal person refuses to dig or clean a source of drinking water together with other animals or birds but takes advantage of the results of the work

Animal are guarding some food or water or come after water. The deceiver takes what he needs or does not let the others to use the water. Turtle, toad or frog proves to be smarter than the deceived and catches him
When animals build a rode, the mole or shrew refuses to take part in the work and is punished

During the hottest month of the summer or permanently birds of certain species are prohibited to drink from the water bodies and can quench their thirst only from rain drops and dew on leaves. That is why this bird always cries calling for rain
Person is suggested to twist a rope or make other object of sand, ash, smoke, etc.
Person is suggested to make clothes of stone or iron or to skin a stone
Person is suggested to make something and simultaneously not to make it (to come clothed and naked, to stand indoors and outdoors, etc.)

motif_title: To protect from rain by his own body
motif_gloss: Person cannot understand why the clothes (firewood, etc.) of another are dry after the rain – he protected them with his own body
Person claims that chickens can be brooded from the boiled eggs or wants his opponent to grow a hen during one day. The opponent suggests for the first person equally impossible task
Using a trick, person kills dangerous predator. Kinsmen and friends of the killed animal get to know about it and come to avenge its death. The person escapes from them

motif_title: Wisdom of hidden old man saves kingdom
motif_gloss: People are ordered to kill or (rare) mothers or (the Nyoro) to deprive them of power and property). A man conceals his father. Later the old man helps to resolve difficult problem. It is decide not to kill old men anymore
Fox or other predator asks a bird what does it do when the wind blows. When the bird demonstrates how it puts its head under its wing, the fox kills it
Person brings food from or gets shelter inside of a big animal, a tree or inside some enclosure. Another animal person follows him but gets into trouble
Person penetrates into enclosure with valuables after getting know magic words that open the door

Trickster suggests to be a nurse or a shepherd, kills and eats children or animals, demonstrates to the parent (the owner) one and the same child or animal as many times as was their number in the beginning
Somebody dies, animal person suggests to be a mourner, eats the corpse

Trickster sends a woman (usually bear-woman) or two women to pick up berries or an animal allegedly killed by him and suggests to look after their children. He kills the children, feeds their meat to their mother. (The false baby-sitter kills the cabs not because he is hungry and not because of his carelessness)
Two animals agree to care for their children together. The stronger one devours the children of the weaker one and pretends to be angry when the latter asks whose were the lost children
Louse or other tiny creature (flee, tuck) is sent to spy on a person
In a difficult situation animal person asks for advice his tail, anus or some beings that are inside him (excrements, parasites, his "sisters", etc.)
A bird of prey or a carrion-eater (raven, owl, hawk; coyote) marries or tries to marry goose-person or other water bird. This marriage is not realized or is a short one

Raven marries or tries to marry a girl pretending to be handsome chief. They notice that somebody is eating carrion. Usually when everybody have to take off there footgear, raven's three-toes feet are exposed. He is driven away or runs away being ashamed
A man gets a woman thanks to a trick, carries her away in his canoe. She asks permission to go to shore to relieve herself, runs away
A bird-person who usually does not fly away in the autumn makes attempt to fly with migratory birds but is unable to reach destination
Raven is going to marry a girl but is rejected after they see that he eats filth

Person buries a tail or head of a bull or other domestic animal with a tail or horns outside. He explains that the animal sank into the ground and usually asks the others to pull the tail (horns). When they are “torn off”, he tells that people are guilty of the animal being lost

Person lies to another that he is eating his eyes. The companion agrees to be blinded. The first person extracts one of companion’s eye but gives him to eat something delicious instead. The companion believes that his eyes are good to eat and agrees to be deprived of another eye too

Person comes across severed head or skull who speaks and tells others about his experience. When chief, king etc. comes to control information, the skull keeps silence and the man is punished as a liar
Trickster animal has a narrow escape and loses his tail. To make himself unrecognizable among other animals of his species, he tricks them to lose their tails too

motif_title: The quail makes the fox laugh
motif_gloss: Trickster animal asks a bird to make him laugh. The bird sits on the head of a woman (child, cow, etc.), other person tries to kill the bird, hits the wife (breaks cow's horn, etc.). Or the bird distracts person attention to let the trickster steal the person’s food
Animal person attaches a vessel or its part to his body, puts it into the water, the vessel is heavy and drags him into the water
An animal person mistakes an object abandoned by chance or intentionally for an evidence of a danger and behaves inadequately
Hero comes to an agreement with antagonist that he can take animals of particular color. He gets to change color of the animals and takes all or most of them
Father or mother is going to give primogeniture to the son he or she has chosen. Another son comes in disguise of the chosen one, receives primogeniture

motif_title: Fox and bird in one hole
motif_gloss: Fox and bird hide from a hunter together in one and the same hole. The bird makes believe he is dead and escapes (with the fox or alone)

motif_title: Bird helps animal to escape from snare
motif_gloss: A predator animal lures a herbivorous animal into the hunter's trap and hopes to feast on its entrails. A bird advices the herbivorous animal to sham dead and helps him to escape

motif_title: Traitor killed instead of a victim
motif_gloss: A herbivorous animal gets into hunter's trap. A predator animal refuses to free his companion because he hopes to feast on entrails. A bird makes the herbivorous animal free. The hunter tries to kill the bird but hits the predator instead
A stronger (animal)-person gets to seize a leg or tail of a weaker one. To get free the weaker one pretends that his pursuer got hold of a tree root, and the pursuer lets his enemy free
Enemy is ready to cease person who asks him first to throw away his clothes and shoes and exposes his ears. The enemy takes him by ears and throws away, the person escapes
Predator animal believes that an ungulate has dangerous horns and then understands that these are but ears

Cumulative tale: a small bird cuts itself with a sharp blade of grass or a thorn and asks the others to punish the plant. Everyone finds an excuse why they cannot do anything (sheep, wolves, boys, etc.). The last one is the wind, it blows making all other persons act
Animals stand one on another making a tower. When the lowermost moves, the tower collapses
Predator animal/ogre blows and destroys a fragile house but cannot destroy a strong one. Usually two or three weak personages build three houses only one of which is strong enough.
When a predator is going to eat a man, the latter asks permission first to measure him and beats with his (feigned) measuring tool
Eating much, person gets dirty (usually a fox covers his head with a milky substance or dough) but convinces others (a wolf or a bear) that his body looks strange because he has been badly injured
Grain is harvested with inappropriate tools. Seeing sickle for the first time, people take it for a dangerous animal

The stronger predator demonstrates the weaker one the right way to behave before attacking the game.. The weaker one does the same (eyes are bloody, hindquarters trembling, etc.) but instead of killing a herbivorous animal is usually killed himself

motif_title: Human and animal life spans are readjusted
motif_gloss: God originally gives 20 or 30 years to everybody. Some animals refuse some of their years because of their sufferings. Man wants to have more years and takes them from the animals
Fox catches birds, puts them into a bag and goes away for a moment. Another animal-person opens the bag and puts thorns instead of the birds

Trickster pretends to be dead or sick and is picked up by those who carry something edible in a cart (sledge, boat, bag). The trickster secretly eats the food, often after throwing it out of the cart (sledge)
Travelling animals fall in a pit and eat one another up until only one (usually the fox) is left and escapes from the pit
Fox blames his tail for being useless when escaping from the pursuers (usually he punishes his tail and gets killed himself as a result)
Getting into a well or pit and being unable to climb out animal person tricks another to descend and thanks to this gets out while the second person remains below

motif_title: The wasp nest as king’s drum
motif_gloss: One animal person gets to convince another that dangerous or disgusting objects are attractive and delicious (a wasp nest is a drum, a snake is a girdle, a heap of dung is a delicacy, etc.)

motif_title: Burning thatch on the back of a tiger
motif_gloss: A trickster (always hare or rabbit) asks a big and dangerous animal (tiger or elephant) to carry some thatch and puts it on fire. After this the same trickster or other animal gives the victim advice to run not to river but up the slope
A weak animal person demonstrates a strong one his reflection in water. The latter believes that an animal like he contests his supremacy, invites him for a visit, etc., usually jumps in and drowns
Knowing that food is in a trap or is poisoned, one animal tricks another to take it

motif_title: The fox runs in front of the tiger
motif_gloss: The weak animal tells the strong one that all the other are afraid of him, the weak one. To prove it, the weak one walks in front of the strong one and the latter believes that forest dwellers run away seeing not him but the weak one
One animal person persuades another to agree to be eaten up, usually promising a reward after the resurrection. The fool agrees and is eaten up

motif_title: Tell them that I am a stump
motif_gloss: The bear (wolf, lion, etc.) is going to kill a man. Another person or animal pretends not to know about the situation and tells the man that hunters are in search of the bear, have not he seen him? The bear asks the man not to give him out and answer that it is a stump, a log and the like near him. This opens possibility to treat the dangerous animal as a corresponding object (to cut it with an axe, to tie up, etc.)

A man, light-mindedly or against his own wish, makes an agreement with a dangerous predator. He does not want (cannot) keep it or breaks it and the predator is going to kill him. Somebody intervenes and saves the man.
A man tells that there are dangerous animals inside him (or in a box he has) that can come out. A predator who was going to eat the man up (or to bite him) believes him and runs away
An animal person becomes a herdsman but eats the entrusted animals up

Dangerous animal pretends to be an inanimate object, dead or absent. The potential victim sais aloud that the real dead (object, place) has to act in a particular way or to say particular words. The animal does accordingly betraying himself.

Deceived by a weak person, a predator animal or an ogre is frightened and runs away. Another animal is eager to explain his mistake and leads him back. The weak one repeats former trick or pretends to be angry: why the animal (ogre) brought to him is lean (small; only one instead of several, etc.). The predator (ogre) again runs away
Two predator animals (an animal and an ogre) tie together with one rope and because of this are injured or dead during a confrontation with a weak person or animal
Getting to see a donkey or horse a strong predator thinks that this animal is dangerous. His further interpretation of the herbivorous’ behavior supports this impression

motif_title: The donkey and the lion crossing a river
motif_gloss: A weak companion of a big predator pretends to be strong and brave. Almost drowned сrossing a river and saved by the predator, he pretends to be angry (“Because of you I let a fish go”, etc.)

motif_title: Whose voice is louder (the elephant and the tiger)
motif_gloss: The elephant and the tiger (lion) make a competition (usually argue whose voice is louder). The tiger wins and is going to eat the elephant. A small trickster animal saves the elephant

A predator animal wants to eat a horse (mule, etc.). Before the horse will let himself be eaten, he demands (or another animal gives him advice) that the predator look at his hoof (for different reasons) or eat him from his hindquarters forward; then he kicks the predator
The predator wants to eat a person or animal; the victim asks for a favor to let him first wash himself and escapes
Wolf is killed or injured when he accepts a suggestion of the horse (donkey, etc.) to ride it

motif_title: The animal language and the stubborn wife
motif_gloss: A man obtains knowledge of animal languages but if he reveals the secret, he must die. Once he hears animals talking and laughs. His wife thinks that he laughs at her or at her mother. The man is ready to open his secret and either does it and dies or hears how animals (usually a cock) blame him for being so foolish. So he keeps his secret.

motif_title: Sleeping parent covered with a cloak
motif_gloss: A man or a woman falls asleep in the nude or pretends to do so. Only one of his or her children covers him or her with a cloak and is considered to be the most noble

motif_title: The ungrateful one returned to captivity
motif_gloss: An (animal) person saves a dangerous animal from a snare or the like. The saved one is going to kill his savior but the third person saves the second (usually tricks the first one to captivity again)

Person proves the absurdity of the claims of another person claiming in response something equally absurd. One or the both say that a man or a male animal had given birth (or is menstruating) or that a female gave birth to a young of another species or that a woman gave birth to an animal

motif_title: You are hens and I am  the cock
motif_gloss: To put a person into an awkward position, others demonstrate chicken eggs that they prepared beforehand. Having no egg with him, the person says that he is the only cock while all the others are hens

motif_title: To take the one thing she holds dearest
motif_gloss: Husband casts his wife out but allows her to take the one thing she holds dearest. She takes her sleeping or drunk husband with her and thus moves him to forgive her

Two animals (an animal and a person, an ogre and a person, etc.) agree to divide a crop in such a way that one would take what is above the ground and another what is beneath ground. One of them (several times makes a wrong choice (takes turnip tops and wheat roots)

The strongest predator (usually a lion) and two other animals hunt together. One shares the booty and is killed or badly injured by the strongest one. When the third one becomes to share, he gives everything to the strongest one and explains that the injured one taught him the right way of sharing

motif_title: Feelings wounded by deed and by word
motif_gloss: A strong predator animal and a man become friends. The animal hears how the man or his wife complains about him (e.g. criticizes the bad smell of his mouth) and asks the man to strike him with an axe, knife and the like. Later he comes to demonstrate his healed wound and explains that the physical wound can be healed unlike the psychological one
Person gives another (often a fox) a bag putting inside a dog instead of food; or he makes free a girl who was kept in the bag and replaces her with a dog. The dog attacks the one who opened the bag
Person pretends to eat his own innards or flesh and persuades the other to do the same. Other believes and kills themselves
Person pretends to eat his own genitals. Another one believes him and cuts off his genitals

motif_title: Sour sap into the bear’s eyes
motif_gloss: Person makes believe to rub sour berries into his eyes. Another (always a bear) suggests to rub the same sap into his eyes and is blinded. The person kills him
Person gets to a country where rats or mice are a plague and receives a fortune selling a cat

motif_title: All tracks going into the den and none coming out
motif_gloss: Animal person refuses to enter the den of a strong predator seeing that all tracks go into it but none come out
One animal person promises to sew a fur coat (or boots) for another and asks to bring him ever more sheep. He eats the meat and sews nothing

To lure his potential victim down from a tree, a predator pretends not to be dangerous (usually announces that it has been decreed that all animals are united in piece). The victim is dubious and usually asks the predator to announce the same news to the dogs. The predator runs away

motif_title: A tiger taken for a bull
motif_gloss: During the night a strong predator (a tiger, a lion, etc.) and a thief not knowing about each other get into stable to steal a domestic animal. The thief takes the predator for domestic animal or for a person and acts accordingly

motif_title: The tiger who is afraid of Twilight
motif_gloss: A strong predator (usually a tiger) overhears a person saying that he fears something worse than a tiger The word is unknown to the tiger (twilight, etc). Thinking it must be a terrible thing he hides and then runs away
The hare is in despair because he is afraid of all creatures but is delighted when he sees other animals (sheep, frogs, dusks) being afraid of him

In the presence of powerful person one of his subjects is plotting against the other. The other answers that the problem can be resolved if the first one would be maimed (usually a part of his body used as a medicine). The schemer is killed or injured
Animal person pretends to confess his sins and become vegetarian, kills those who believed him
A predator sais that a herbivorous is a great sinner and must be eaten up

motif_title: The successive exchange: from a pea to a horse
motif_gloss: Person or animal stays for a night and the next morning declares that his possessions (which value is none or negligible) are lost. He receives in compensation objects (usually a domestic animal) that has a bigger value, and this way several times till he gets a really valuable animal or a human person
Person or animal gets to exchange less valuable goods for ever more valuable and ultimately gets a bride
Person pretends that he has not a bare should-blade but a good piece of meat, asks people to cook it and then blames them for stealing the meat
Somebody pulls out a thorn from a person’s body and throws the thorn away. The person claims his thorn back and receives something more valuable in exchange

motif_title: The hare makes the lion his horse
motif_gloss: To demonstrate that a strong animal is his slave or his riding animal, a weak animal tricks the strong one to carry him. People believe that the strong one is really a slave of the weak one

An animal person pretends to be dead and lies down on a road in front of a traveler who carries something valuable. The traveler passes by but returns to pick up the animal when he sees another one, i.e. the same trickster who ran ahead. The trickster steals the possessions that the traveler abandoned for a time
A week animal person immobilizing a strong one becomes to eat him from behind and refuses to come to the head where the stronger one can still bite him; or is waiting till the strong animal dies

motif_title: A dead lion behind the hyena
motif_gloss: Seeing a dead lion (or other big predator) behind him, the hyena thinks that the lion is alive and runs away in panic

motif_title: A test: to jump across a brook
motif_gloss: (Animal) persons agree to jump across a brook or streamlet, to cross it walking along a log, a rope and the like. One or all of them fall down

motif_title: But he had no heart at all
motif_gloss: A weak predator eats part of a body of a killed animal and explain to the strong one that this animal did not have such a part at all

A man sends others one after the other to pasture the goat. Back home, the goat always complains it did not get anything to eat. The man angrily sends away or kills his shepherds (who usually are his family members). When he himself pastures the goat he realizes that it lies. He is going to kill the goat, usually skins it, but it escapes

motif_title: A house of bark and a house of ice
motif_gloss: Two animal persons live nearby, the house of one of them is destroyed, he asks another to let him in and usually drives the host out of his house. Strong animals are afraid of the intruder but a weak or small one succeeds to return the house to its original owner

motif_title: The owner driven out of his house
motif_gloss: Using a trick the intruder occupies other person’s house and refuses to let the owner in

motif_title: Fox and crane invite each other
motif_gloss: An animal person invites another and serves his food in such a way that he is unable to taste it. Then the other invites the first animal and puts him in similar situation
An animal person invites another but asks him to wash his hands or feet before dinner. This proves to be impossible and the hungry guest goes away

motif_title: Two companions go to a feast
motif_gloss: Two animal persons are invited to a feast. Both along the way and at the place of destination one deceives another

Person persuades another to mistake unachievable natural phenomena for the objects of culture. Usually he sends the other to bring a fire indicating a false source of it (a sunset, a firefly) and hides or eats the meat to be cooked during companion’s absence

To catch a thief, a deceiver, the owner of property puts a sticky figure to which the thief sticks (usually mistaken it for alive being and usually touching it with all his body members in succession)
Person smears with pitch a domestic animal (or a figure of an animal, some object); wild animals stick to it one after another; are released for a promise of gifts

motif_title: The wild animals on the sleigh
motif_gloss: Wild animals ride on a sleigh, which breaks. To repair it the animals bring unsatisfactory material from the forest. When the sleigh owner goes for good material they eat the horse (or the bull) and build a dummy to replace it

Many animals of one species that all look identical together fulfill the task that would be impossible for any of them if he were alone; the competitors believe that the task was fulfilled by only one animal. Usually a slow and a fast animals agree to race. The slow one puts others who look like him at the finish or along the distance, each one answering the fast one that he is ahead of him. The fast one accepts his loss

motif_title: The slow one is ahead of the sleeping one
motif_gloss: A slow and a fast animals agree to race. The fast one is sure that he will win and is not in a hurry at all while the slow one is moving persistently to his aim and wins

motif_title: On the tail of the fast one
motif_gloss: (animals)

motif_title: On the tail of the winner (all versions)
motif_gloss: Birds, animals or fish compete as about who is the fastest or can fly higher than others. A weak one imperceptible sticks to the body of the fastest or strongest and wins

motif_title: Hedgehog is a participant of the race
motif_gloss: Hedgehog is a participant of the race and wins

motif_title: Snail is a participant of the race
motif_gloss: Snail is a participant of the race and wins
Animal person is highly respected by others after he changes his looks by chance; is smeared with a paint or gets a necklace-like object around his neck which he is unable to pull off
To thread a spiral shell (a stone with tiny opening, a horn, etc.) person ties the thread to an ant and lets it go through the opening
The beaver ferries the porcupine and usually throws him into water or abandons on an island
The fox (who married the cat) poses him as a strong and dangerous animal. The wild animals are eager to get him round but are scared and run away

A carrion-eating animal who crawled into a fresh carcass or put on a fresh animal skin cannot free himself when the carcass or the skin becomes dry. He gets free when is becomes soft again or somebody tears it open
Animal person agrees to put on a fresh skin of another animal or to be tied up with raw straps. The skin or straps dry up making the person suffer

To pass unnoticed dangerous animals on his or her way back, person crawls into a gourd, a big cattle, etc. and is rolling inside it along the road, or he walks transforming his appearance in a bizarre way

Several animals get objects possessed by a person. Dividing their booty, one animal takes all the food for himself giving the others objects that can be used only by people. Animals that received them suffer or die
Person should guess which of two horses is older. He does it considering peculiarities of the habits of horses

A man and his wife make a wager: Whoever speaks first must do certain trivial work or get a bigger portion of some simple food. They or one of them continue to keep silence even being exposed to violence or taken by others as the dead
Seriously or demonstrating absurdity of the situation, a person tries to cook something using a fire (a source of light) that is far away from the object to be cooked

motif_title: The pot has a child and dies
motif_gloss: A borrower returns a cattle (pot) together with a small one, claiming that the cattle gave birth to a child. He borrows the pot again but does not return it, claiming that the pot dies

Brothers (rare: one man) have extraordinary powers of observation and describe objects, animals or people whom they never seen or see for the first time. Investigation confirms that their deduction was correct
Judge tells a story to persons suspected of a crime and finds who is guilty watching their reaction
A king (landlord, etc.) suggests to guess what he has in his hand (in a box). A man gives the correct answer pronouncing by chance the word “grasshopper” (“locust”, “cricket”)
A man or a weak animal and an ogre (giant, devil) have a contest to see which of them  can squeeze a stone. The man squeezes a cheese (egg, turnip) and thus intimidates the ogre
